rows.spanish: Y mientras ellos miraban fijamente hacia el cielo, mientras él se iba, he aquí, dos hombres estaban junto a ellos con vestiduras blancas,
rows.current_english_pob: And as they were gazing intently into heaven while he was going, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
rows.spanish_base_english: And as they were gazing intently into heaven while he was going, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

rows.spanish: Y cuando entraron, subieron al aposento alto donde se alojaban: Pedro, Juan, Santiago y Andrés; Felipe y Tomás; Bartolomé y Mateo; Santiago, hijo de Alfeo, y Simón el Zelote, y Judas, hijo de Santiago.
rows.current_english_pob: And when they had entered, they went up to the upstairs room where they were staying: Peter, John, James, and Andrew; Philip and Thomas; Bartholomew and Matthew; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when they had entered, they went up to the upper room where they were staying: Peter, and John, and James, and Andrew; Philip and Thomas; Bartholomew and Matthew; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

rows.spanish: Y en aquellos días, Pedro se levantó en medio de los hermanos y dijo —y el número de personas reunidas era aproximadamente ciento veinte—.
rows.current_english_pob: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the brothers and said (the number of names together was about one hundred twenty),
rows.spanish_base_english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the brothers and said (and the number of persons together was about one hundred twenty),

rows.spanish: Por tanto, es necesario que uno de los hombres que estuvieron con nosotros durante todo el tiempo en que el Señor Jesús entraba y salía entre nosotros,
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, it is necessary that one of the men who accompanied us during all the time in which the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore, it is necessary that one of the men who accompanied us during all the time in which the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

rows.spanish: Y se les aparecieron lenguas como de fuego, que se repartieron, y una se posó sobre cada uno de ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And tongues like fire appeared to them, being divided, and it came to rest on each one of them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And divided tongues as of fire appeared to them and rested on each one of them.

rows.spanish: En Jerusalén vivían judíos, hombres devotos, de toda nación bajo el cielo.
rows.current_english_pob: There were Jews living in Jerusalem, devout men from every nation under heaven.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were Jews living in Jerusalem, devout men from every nation under heaven.

rows.spanish: Incluso sobre mis esclavos y mis esclavas, en aquellos días derramaré de mi Espíritu, y profetizarán.
rows.current_english_pob: Even on my male servants and my female servants in those days I will pour out from my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
rows.spanish_base_english: Even on my male slaves and my female slaves in those days I will pour out from my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

rows.spanish: Y daré prodigios en el cielo, arriba, y señales sobre la tierra, abajo: sangre y fuego y vapor de humo.
rows.current_english_pob: And I will give wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below: blood and fire and a cloud of smoke.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I will give wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.

rows.spanish: Pues David dice acerca de él: «Tenía continuamente al Señor delante de mí, porque está a mi derecha, para que yo no sea sacudido».
rows.current_english_pob: For David says concerning him, ‘I kept seeing the Lord before me continually, because he is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.’
rows.spanish_base_english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord continually before me, because he is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.’

rows.spanish: Al oír esto, fueron traspasados en el corazón, y dijeron a Pedro y a los demás apóstoles: «¿Qué debemos hacer, hermanos?».
rows.current_english_pob: When they heard this, they were pierced to the heart, and they said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “What should we do, brothers?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when they heard this, they were pierced to the heart, and they said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “What should we do, brothers?”

rows.spanish: Y Pedro les dijo: «Arrepiéntanse, y que cada uno de ustedes sea bautizado en el nombre de Jesús Mesías para el perdón de sus pecados, y recibirán el don del Espíritu Santo».
rows.current_english_pob: And Peter said to them, “Repent, and let each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus the Messiah for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Peter said to them, “Repent, and let each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Messiah for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.”

rows.spanish: Y día tras día, perseverando con un mismo propósito en el templo, y partiendo el pan de casa en casa, compartían comida con alegría y sencillez de corazón.
rows.current_english_pob: And day by day, continuing together with one purpose in the temple courts, and breaking bread from house to house, they were sharing meals with gladness and simplicity of heart,
rows.spanish_base_english: And day by day, continuing with one purpose in the temple courts, and breaking bread from house to house, they were sharing food with gladness and simplicity of heart,

rows.spanish: Pedro y Juan subían al templo a la hora de la oración, la novena hora.
rows.current_english_pob: Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

rows.spanish: Cuando vio a Pedro y a Juan, que estaban por entrar en el templo, les pidió limosna.
rows.current_english_pob: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the temple, he began asking to receive alms.
rows.spanish_base_english: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive alms.

rows.spanish: Pero Pedro dijo: «Plata y oro no tengo, pero lo que tengo, eso te doy: en el nombre de Jesús Mesías el Nazareno, camina».
rows.current_english_pob: But Peter said, “Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have, this I give to you: in the name of Jesus the Messiah the Nazarene, walk.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But Peter said, “Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have, this I give to you: in the name of Jesus Messiah the Nazarene, walk.”

rows.spanish: Y saltando, se puso en pie y comenzó a andar, y entró con ellos en el templo, andando y saltando y alabando a Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: And leaping up, he stood and began to walk, and he entered the temple with them, walking and jumping and praising God.
rows.spanish_base_english: And leaping up, he stood and began to walk, and he entered the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God.

rows.spanish: a quien el cielo debe recibir hasta los tiempos de la restauración de todas las cosas, acerca de las cuales Dios habló por boca de sus santos profetas desde antiguo.
rows.current_english_pob: whom heaven must receive until the times of the restoration of all things that God spoke through the mouth of his holy prophets from of old.
rows.spanish_base_english: whom heaven must receive until the times of the restoration of all things about which God spoke through the mouth of his holy prophets from of old.

rows.spanish: Mientras hablaban al pueblo, se les acercaron los sacerdotes, el capitán del templo y los saduceos.
rows.current_english_pob: While they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now while they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,

rows.spanish: Hágaseles saber a todos ustedes y a todo el pueblo de Israel que, en el nombre de Jesús Mesías, el Nazareno, a quien ustedes crucificaron, a quien Dios resucitó de entre los muertos, por este nombre este hombre está ante ustedes sano.
rows.current_english_pob: let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel that in the name of Jesus the Messiah the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead—by this name this man stands before you healthy.
rows.spanish_base_english: let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel that in the name of Jesus Messiah the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead—by this name this man stands before you healthy.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, al observar el denuedo de Pedro y de Juan, y al darse cuenta de que eran hombres sin instrucción y corrientes, se asombraban y reconocían que habían estado con Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: As they observed the boldness of Peter and John, and realized that they were uneducated and ordinary men, they were astonished, and they recognized that they had been with Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now as they observed the boldness of Peter and John, and realized that they were uneducated and ordinary men, they were astonished, and they recognized that they had been with Jesus.

rows.spanish: Pero, para que no se extienda más entre el pueblo, amenacémoslos para que no hablen más en este nombre a nadie.
rows.current_english_pob: But so that it may not spread any further among the people, let us warn them not to speak any longer to anyone in this name.
rows.spanish_base_english: But so that it may not spread any further among the people, let us threaten them not to speak any longer to anyone in this name.

rows.spanish: Porque no podemos dejar de hablar de lo que hemos visto y oído.
rows.current_english_pob: For we are not able not to speak about what we have seen and heard.
rows.spanish_base_english: For we cannot but speak about what we have seen and heard.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, la multitud de los que habían creído era de un solo corazón y una sola alma, y ni siquiera uno de ellos decía que algo de lo que poseía era suyo, sino que todas las cosas eran comunes entre ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: The multitude of those who had believed were of one heart and soul, and not even one of them said that anything belonging to him was his own, but all things were held in common among them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the multitude of those who had believed were of one heart and soul, and not even one of them said that anything belonging to him was his own, but all things were held in common among them.

rows.spanish: Y con gran poder los apóstoles daban testimonio de la resurrección del Señor Jesús, y había gran favor sobre todos ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And with great power the apostles were giving their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great favor was upon them all.
rows.spanish_base_english: And with great power the apostles were giving testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great favor was upon them all.

rows.spanish: Ahora José, a quien los apóstoles llamaron Bernabé —que traducido significa hijo de aliento—, levita, natural de Chipre,
rows.current_english_pob: Joseph, who was called Barnabas by the apostles—which translated means son of encouragement—a Levite, a native of Cyprus,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Joseph, who was called Barnabas by the apostles—which translated means son of encouragement—a Levite, a native of Cyprus,

rows.spanish: Entonces, después de un intervalo de unas tres horas, su esposa entró, sin saber lo que había sucedido.
rows.current_english_pob: After an interval of about three hours, his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after an interval of about three hours, his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

rows.spanish: Entonces ella cayó inmediatamente a sus pies y expiró. Cuando entraron los jóvenes, la encontraron muerta, y la sacaron y la sepultaron junto a su marido.
rows.current_english_pob: Then she immediately fell at his feet and died. When the young men came in, they found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then she immediately fell at his feet and breathed her last. When the young men came in, they found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

rows.spanish: Ahora se hacían muchas señales y prodigios entre el pueblo por medio de las manos de los apóstoles, y estaban todos juntos en el Pórtico de Salomón.
rows.current_english_pob: Many signs and wonders were being done among the people through the hands of the apostles, and they were all together in Solomon’s Portico.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now many signs and wonders were being done among the people through the hands of the apostles, and they were all together in Solomon’s Portico.

rows.spanish: Pero ninguno de los demás se atrevía a unirse a ellos, y el pueblo los tenía en alta estima.
rows.current_english_pob: But none of the rest dared to join them; rather, the people held them in high esteem.
rows.spanish_base_english: But none of the rest dared to join them, but the people held them in high esteem.

rows.spanish: Y cuando el capitán del templo y los principales sacerdotes oyeron estas palabras, estaban perplejos acerca de ellas, preguntándose en qué iba a parar esto.
rows.current_english_pob: When the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were perplexed about them, wondering what this might come to.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were perplexed about them, wondering what this might come to.

rows.spanish: Después de llevarlos, los pusieron ante el consejo, y el sumo sacerdote los interrogó.
rows.current_english_pob: After bringing them in, they stood them before the council, and the high priest questioned them.
rows.spanish_base_english: After bringing them in, they set them before the council, and the high priest questioned them.

rows.spanish: Pero al oír esto, se enfurecieron y querían matarlos.
rows.current_english_pob: But when they heard this, they were enraged and wanted to kill them.
rows.spanish_base_english: But when they heard this, they were cut to the heart and wanted to kill them.

rows.spanish: En aquellos días, al multiplicarse los discípulos, surgió una queja de los helenistas contra los hebreos, porque sus viudas eran pasadas por alto en la distribución diaria.
rows.current_english_pob: In those days, as the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in those days, as the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.

rows.spanish: Esteban, lleno de gracia y de poder, hacía grandes prodigios y señales entre el pueblo.
rows.current_english_pob: Stephen, full of grace and power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Stephen, full of grace and power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.

rows.spanish: Entonces, después de haber salido de la tierra de los caldeos, habitó en Harán. Y desde allí, después de morir su padre, lo trasladó a esta tierra, en la cual ustedes ahora habitan
rows.current_english_pob: Then, after he had gone out from the land of the Chaldeans, he settled in Haran. And from there, after his father died, God moved him into this land in which you now live,
rows.spanish_base_english: Then, after he had gone out from the land of the Chaldeans, he settled in Haran. And from there, after his father died, he moved him into this land in which you now live,

rows.spanish: Pero Dios habló de esta manera: que sus descendientes serían forasteros en tierra ajena, y los esclavizarían y los maltratarían durante cuatrocientos años.
rows.current_english_pob: But God spoke in this way: that his offspring would be a foreign resident in a strange land, and they would enslave it and mistreat it for four hundred years.
rows.spanish_base_english: But God spoke in this way: that his offspring would be sojourners in a foreign land, and they would enslave them and mistreat them for four hundred years.

rows.spanish: Entonces hubo una hambruna sobre todo Egipto y Canaán, y gran aflicción, y nuestros padres no podían encontrar alimentos.
rows.current_english_pob: A famine came over all Egypt and Canaan, and great distress, and our fathers could not find food.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a famine came over all Egypt and Canaan, and great distress, and our fathers could not find food.

rows.spanish: Y Moisés fue educado en toda la sabiduría de los egipcios, y era poderoso en palabras y obras.
rows.current_english_pob: And Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and deeds.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in words and deeds.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando estaba por cumplir cuarenta años, le vino al corazón visitar a sus hermanos, los hijos de Israel.
rows.current_english_pob: When he was approaching forty years of age, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the sons of Israel.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when he was approaching forty years of age, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the sons of Israel.

rows.spanish: Y al ver a alguien que era maltratado, lo defendió y vengó al que era oprimido, golpeando al egipcio.
rows.current_english_pob: And when he saw someone being wronged, he defended him and brought justice for the one being oppressed by striking down the Egyptian.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when he saw someone being wronged, he defended him and avenged the one being oppressed by striking down the Egyptian.

rows.spanish: Él pensaba que sus hermanos entendían que Dios les estaba dando liberación por medio de su mano, pero ellos no entendieron.
rows.current_english_pob: He supposed that his brothers understood that God was giving them deliverance through his hand, but they did not understand.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he supposed that his brothers understood that God was giving them deliverance through his hand, but they did not understand.

rows.spanish: ¿Quieres matarme como mataste al egipcio ayer?
rows.current_english_pob: Do you want to kill me the way you killed the Egyptian yesterday?
rows.spanish_base_english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?

rows.spanish: «El cielo es mi trono, y la tierra, el escabel de mis pies. ¿Qué clase de casa me edificarán, dice el Señor, o cuál es el lugar de mi descanso?»
rows.current_english_pob: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is the footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build for me, says the Lord, or what is the place of my rest?
rows.spanish_base_english: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is the footstool of my feet. What kind of house will you build for me, says the Lord, or what is the place of my rest?

rows.spanish: Al oír esto, se sintieron traspasados hasta el corazón y rechinaban los dientes contra él.
rows.current_english_pob: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart and gnashed their teeth at him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart and gnashed their teeth at him.

rows.spanish: Ahora Saulo aprobaba su ejecución. Y aquel día surgió una gran persecución contra la iglesia en Jerusalén, y todos fueron dispersados por las regiones de Judea y Samaria, excepto los apóstoles.
rows.current_english_pob: Saul was approving of his execution. And on that day a great persecution arose against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Saul was approving of his execution. And on that day a great persecution arose against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.

rows.spanish: Ahora Felipe bajó a la ciudad de Samaria y les proclamó al Mesías.
rows.current_english_pob: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah to them.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cierto hombre llamado Simón ya estaba en la ciudad, practicando magia y asombrando al pueblo de Samaria, diciendo que él mismo era alguien grande.
rows.current_english_pob: A certain man named Simon had previously been in the city practicing magic and astonishing the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was someone great,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a certain man named Simon had previously been in the city practicing magic and astonishing the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was someone great,

rows.spanish: Pero cuando creyeron a Felipe, mientras proclamaba las buenas noticias acerca del reino de Dios y del nombre de Jesús Mesías, iban siendo bautizados, tanto hombres como mujeres.
rows.current_english_pob: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus the Messiah, they were being baptized, both men and women.
rows.spanish_base_english: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Messiah, they were being baptized, both men and women.

rows.spanish: Y Simón también creyó, y después de ser bautizado permanecía con Felipe, y viendo las señales y las grandes obras de poder que sucedían, quedaba asombrado.
rows.current_english_pob: And Simon himself also believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip, and as he saw signs and great works of power happening, he was amazed.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Simon himself also believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip, and seeing signs and great works of power being done, he was amazed.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando los apóstoles en Jerusalén oyeron que Samaria había recibido la palabra de Dios, enviaron a Pedro y a Juan hacia ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

rows.spanish: Entonces les imponían las manos, y recibían el Espíritu Santo.
rows.current_english_pob: Then they laid their hands on them, and they were receiving the Holy Spirit.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

rows.spanish: No tienes parte ni suerte en este asunto, porque tu corazón no es recto delante de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: You have neither part nor share in this matter, because your heart is not right before God.
rows.spanish_base_english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, because your heart is not right before God.

rows.spanish: Ahora un ángel de Yahvé habló a Felipe, diciendo: «Levántate y ve al sur, al camino que baja de Jerusalén a Gaza». Este es un camino desierto.
rows.current_english_pob: An angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Get up and go south to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.” This is a deserted road.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Get up and go south to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.” This is a deserted road.

rows.spanish: Así que se levantó y se fue. Y he aquí, un hombre etíope, un eunuco, un alto funcionario de Candace, reina de los etíopes, que estaba a cargo de toda su tesorería, había venido a Jerusalén para adorar.
rows.current_english_pob: So he got up and went. And behold, an Ethiopian man, a eunuch, a high official of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasury, had come to Jerusalem to worship,
rows.spanish_base_english: So he got up and went. And behold, an Ethiopian man, a eunuch, a high official of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasury, had come to Jerusalem to worship,

rows.spanish: Ahora, el pasaje de la Escritura que él leía era este: «Como oveja fue llevado al degüello, y como cordero delante del que lo trasquila permanece en silencio, así no abre su boca».
rows.current_english_pob: The passage of Scripture that he was reading was this: “Like a sheep he was led to slaughter, and like a lamb before the one shearing it is silent, so he does not open his mouth.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the passage of Scripture that he was reading was this: “Like a sheep he was led to slaughter, and like a lamb before the one shearing it is silent, so he does not open his mouth.”

rows.spanish: Y mientras iban por el camino, llegaron a agua, y el eunuco dijo: «¡Mira, agua! ¿Qué impide que sea bautizado?»
rows.current_english_pob: And as they were going along the road, they came to some water, and the eunuch says, “Look, water! What prevents me from being baptized?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And as they were going along the road, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, “Look, water! What prevents me from being baptized?”

rows.spanish: Mientras iba de camino y se acercaba a Damasco, de repente una luz del cielo brilló a su alrededor.
rows.current_english_pob: As he was traveling, it happened that he was drawing near to Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now as he was traveling, it happened that he was drawing near to Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «¿Quién eres, Señor?» Y él dijo: «Yo soy Jesús, a quien tú persigues».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Who are you, Lord?” And he said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Who are you, Lord?” And he said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.”

rows.spanish: Ahora los hombres que lo acompañaban estaban sin habla, oyendo la voz, pero sin ver a nadie.
rows.current_english_pob: The men traveling with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but seeing no one.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the men traveling with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but seeing no one.

rows.spanish: Y había en Damasco un discípulo llamado Ananías, y el Señor le dijo en una visión: «Ananías». Él respondió: «Aquí estoy, Señor».
rows.current_english_pob: There was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias, and the Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias.” And he said, “Here I am, Lord.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias, and the Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias.” And he said, “Here I am, Lord.”

rows.spanish: Y el Señor le dijo: «Levántate y ve a la calle llamada Recta, y en la casa de Judas busca a un hombre llamado Saulo, de Tarso, porque está orando».
rows.current_english_pob: And the Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the street called Straight, and in the house of Judas look for a man named Saul, from Tarsus, for behold, he is praying.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And the Lord said to him, “Rise and go to the street called Straight, and at the house of Judas look for a man of Tarsus named Saul, for behold, he is praying.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Ananías fue y entró en la casa, y poniendo las manos sobre él dijo: «Hermano Saulo, el Señor Jesús, que se te apareció en el camino por el que venías, me ha enviado para que recobres la vista y seas lleno del Espíritu Santo».
rows.current_english_pob: So Ananias went and entered the house, and laying his hands on him he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord has sent me—Jesus, the one who appeared to you on the road by which you were coming—so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So Ananias went and entered the house, and laying his hands on him he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road by which you were coming, has sent me so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

rows.spanish: Mientras Pedro pasaba por todos, también descendió hasta donde estaban los santos que vivían en Lida.
rows.current_english_pob: As Peter was passing through all of them, he also went down to the saints living in Lydda.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that as Peter was passing through all of them, he also went down to the saints living in Lydda.

rows.spanish: Y Pedro le dijo: «Eneas, Jesús, el Mesías, te sana. Levántate y haz tu cama.» Y enseguida se levantó.
rows.current_english_pob: And Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus the Messiah heals you. Get up and make your bed.” And immediately he got up.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Messiah heals you. Get up and make your bed.” And immediately he got up.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en Jope había una discípula llamada Tabita, que traducida se llama Dorcas. Esta estaba llena de buenas obras y actos de misericordia que hacía.
rows.current_english_pob: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha, which translated is called Dorcas. She was full of good works and acts of mercy that she was doing.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha, which translated is called Dorcas. She was full of good works and acts of mercy that she was doing.

rows.spanish: En aquellos días ocurrió que ella enfermó y murió. Después de lavarla, la pusieron en una habitación de arriba.
rows.current_english_pob: In those days it happened that she became sick and died. After washing her, they laid her in an upstairs room.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in those days it happened that she became sick and died. After washing her, they laid her in an upstairs room.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, como Lida estaba cerca de Jope, los discípulos, al oír que Pedro estaba allí, enviaron dos hombres a donde él estaba, para rogarle: «No tardes en venir a donde nosotros estábamos».
rows.current_english_pob: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, urging, “Do not delay to come to us.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, urging, “Do not delay to come to us.”

rows.spanish: Había en Cesarea un hombre llamado Cornelio, centurión de la llamada cohorte Italiana.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion from the cohort called the Italian Cohort,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion from the cohort called the Italian Cohort,

rows.spanish: Pero él lo miró fijamente y, llenándose de temor, dijo: «¿Qué es, Señor?». Y él le dijo: «Tus oraciones y tus obras de misericordia han subido como memorial delante de Dios».
rows.current_english_pob: But he stared at him, and becoming afraid, said, “What is it, Lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and your acts of mercy have gone up as a memorial before God.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But he stared at him, and becoming afraid, said, “What is it, Lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and your acts of mercy have gone up as a memorial before God.”

rows.spanish: Al día siguiente, mientras aquellos hombres viajaban y se acercaban a la ciudad, Pedro subió a la azotea para orar, hacia la hora sexta.
rows.current_english_pob: On the next day, while those men were traveling and drawing near to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the next day, while those men were traveling and drawing near to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour.

rows.spanish: Pero Pedro dijo: «De ningún modo, Señor, pues nunca he comido nada común o impuro».
rows.current_english_pob: But Peter said, “By no means, Lord, because I have never eaten anything common and unclean.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But Peter said, “By no means, Lord, for I have never eaten anything common or unclean.”

rows.spanish: Mientras Pedro estaba perplejo en su interior acerca de qué podría significar la visión que había visto, he aquí, los hombres que habían sido enviados por Cornelio, después de haber pedido indicaciones para la casa de Simón, llegaron al portón.
rows.current_english_pob: While Peter was inwardly perplexed as to what the vision that he had seen might mean, behold, the men who had been sent by Cornelius, having asked directions to Simon’s house, stood at the gate.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now while Peter was inwardly perplexed as to what the vision that he had seen might mean, behold, the men who had been sent by Cornelius, having asked directions to Simon’s house, stood at the gate.

rows.spanish: Mientras Pedro meditaba sobre la visión, el Espíritu le dijo: «He aquí, hombres te buscan».
rows.current_english_pob: While Peter was still pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Look, men are seeking you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, men are seeking you.”

rows.spanish: Al día siguiente entró en Cesarea. Ahora bien, Cornelio los esperaba, y había convocado a sus parientes y a sus amigos íntimos.
rows.current_english_pob: On the next day he entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
rows.spanish_base_english: On the next day he entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

rows.spanish: Entonces Cornelio dijo: «Hace cuatro días, hasta esta hora, estaba orando a la hora novena en mi casa, y he aquí, un hombre se puso delante de mí con ropa resplandeciente»
rows.current_english_pob: And Cornelius said, “Four days ago, up to this hour, I was praying at the ninth hour in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Cornelius said, “Four days ago, until this hour, I was praying at the ninth hour in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing.”

rows.spanish: Así que envié por ti de inmediato, y hiciste bien en venir. Ahora bien, todos nosotros estamos delante de Dios para oír todo lo que te ha sido mandado por el Señor.
rows.current_english_pob: So I sent for you at once, and you did well to come. Now then, we are all here before God to hear everything that has been commanded to you by the Lord.
rows.spanish_base_english: So I sent for you at once, and you did well to come. Now then, we are all here before God to hear everything that has been commanded to you by the Lord.

rows.spanish: pero en toda nación, el que le teme y hace lo recto es aceptable para él.
rows.current_english_pob: but in every nation the one who fears him and does what is righteous is acceptable to him.
rows.spanish_base_english: but in every nation the one who fears him and does what is right is acceptable to him.

rows.spanish: el mensaje que envió a los hijos de Israel, proclamando paz por medio de Jesús el Mesías—este es Señor de todos.
rows.current_english_pob: the message that he sent to the sons of Israel, proclaiming peace through Jesus the Messiah—he is Lord of all.
rows.spanish_base_english: the message that he sent to the sons of Israel, proclaiming peace through Jesus Messiah—he is Lord of all.

rows.spanish: Dios lo resucitó al tercer día e hizo que se manifestara,
rows.current_english_pob: God raised this one on the third day and granted him to become visible,
rows.spanish_base_english: God raised him on the third day and caused him to appear,

rows.spanish: Así que les ordenó que fueran bautizados en el nombre de Jesús Mesías. Entonces le pidieron que se quedara algunos días.
rows.current_english_pob: So he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus the Messiah. Then they asked him to remain for some days.
rows.spanish_base_english: So he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Messiah. Then they asked him to remain for some days.

rows.spanish: Ahora los apóstoles y los hermanos que estaban por toda Judea oyeron que también los gentiles habían recibido la palabra de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: The apostles and the brothers who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

rows.spanish: Y oí también una voz que me decía: «Levántate, Pedro; mata y come».
rows.current_english_pob: And I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter; kill and eat.’
rows.spanish_base_english: And I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter; slaughter and eat.’

rows.spanish: Pero dije: «De ningún modo, Señor, porque nada común o inmundo ha entrado jamás en mi boca».
rows.current_english_pob: But I said, ‘By no means, Lord, because nothing common or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
rows.spanish_base_english: But I said, ‘By no means, Lord, for nothing common or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, inmediatamente tres hombres llegaron a la casa donde estábamos, enviados desde Cesarea a mí.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, immediately three men arrived at the house where we were, having been sent to me from Caesarea.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, immediately three men arrived at the house where we were, having been sent to me from Caesarea.

rows.spanish: Si entonces Dios les dio a ellos el mismo don que también a nosotros los que creímos en el Señor Jesús Mesías, ¿quién era yo como para impedir a Dios?
rows.current_english_pob: If then God gave to them the same gift as also to us who believed in the Lord Jesus the Messiah, who was I that I could hinder God?
rows.spanish_base_english: If then God gave to them the same gift as also to us who believed in the Lord Jesus Messiah, who was I that I could hinder God?

rows.spanish: Al oír estas cosas, se calmaron y glorificaron a Dios, diciendo: «Entonces Dios también ha concedido a los gentiles el cambio de mente que conduce a la vida».
rows.current_english_pob: When they heard these things, they became quiet and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles the change of mind that leads to life.”
rows.spanish_base_english: When they heard these things, they became quiet and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance unto life.”

rows.spanish: La noticia acerca de ellos llegó a oídos de la iglesia en Jerusalén, y enviaron a Bernabé hasta Antioquía.
rows.current_english_pob: The report about them reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas as far as Antioch.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the report about them reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas as far as Antioch.

rows.spanish: Cuando llegó y vio la gracia de Dios, se alegró y seguía exhortando a todos a permanecer con el Señor con firme propósito de corazón.
rows.current_english_pob: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and kept urging them all to remain devoted to the Lord with purpose of heart,
rows.spanish_base_english: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and kept urging them all to remain with the Lord with purpose of heart,

rows.spanish: Y cuando lo halló, lo llevó a Antioquía. Y durante todo un año se reunieron en la iglesia y enseñaron a mucha gente; y en Antioquía los discípulos fueron llamados cristianos por primera vez.
rows.current_english_pob: And when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. And for a whole year they met together with the church and taught a considerable crowd; and it was in Antioch that the disciples were first called Christians.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. And for a whole year they met together in the church and taught a considerable crowd; and in Antioch the disciples were first called Christians.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en aquellos días bajaron profetas de Jerusalén a Antioquía.
rows.current_english_pob: In those days prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in those days prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

rows.spanish: Por aquel tiempo, el rey Herodes les echó mano a algunos de la iglesia para maltratarlos.
rows.current_english_pob: About that time Herod the king laid hands on some from the church to mistreat them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now about that time Herod the king laid hands on some from the church to mistreat them.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando Herodes estaba a punto de sacarlo, aquella misma noche Pedro estaba durmiendo entre dos soldados, atado con dos cadenas, y guardias delante de la puerta vigilaban la cárcel.
rows.current_english_pob: When Herod was about to bring him out, on that very night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and guards before the door were keeping watch over the prison.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when Herod was about to bring him out, on that very night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and guards before the door were keeping watch over the prison.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, un ángel de Yahvé se puso cerca, y una luz brilló en la celda. Golpeando a Pedro en el costado, lo despertó, diciendo: “Levántate rápidamente”. Y las cadenas se le cayeron de las manos.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood near, and a light shone in the cell. Striking Peter on the side, he woke him, saying, “Get up quickly.” And his chains fell off from his hands.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood near, and a light shone in the cell. Striking Peter on the side, he woke him, saying, “Get up quickly.” And his chains fell off from his hands.

rows.spanish: Y Pedro, volviendo en sí, dijo: «Ahora sé verdaderamente que el Señor envió a su ángel y me libró de la mano de Herodes y de toda la expectativa del pueblo judío».
rows.current_english_pob: And Peter, coming to himself, said, “Now I truly know that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s hand and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Peter, coming to himself, said, “Now I truly know that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando amaneció, hubo no poca conmoción entre los soldados por lo que había sido de Pedro.
rows.current_english_pob: When day came, there was no small disturbance among the soldiers over what had become of Peter.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when day came, there was no small disturbance among the soldiers over what had become of Peter.

rows.spanish: Estaba muy airado con los tirios y sidonios. Pero ellos acudieron a él de común acuerdo y, después de convencer a Blasto, el chambelán del rey, pedían paz, porque su territorio era abastecido desde el dominio del rey.
rows.current_english_pob: He was very angry with the Tyrians and Sidonians. But they came to him with one accord, and after persuading Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they were asking for peace, because their country was fed from the king’s domain.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he was very angry with the Tyrians and Sidonians. But they came to him with one accord, and after persuading Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they were asking for peace, because their country was fed from the king’s domain.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en un día señalado, Herodes, habiéndose vestido con ropa real y habiendo tomado asiento en el tribunal, les dirigía un discurso público.
rows.current_english_pob: On an appointed day, Herod, having put on royal clothing and having sat down on the tribunal, was delivering a public address to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on an appointed day, Herod, having put on royal clothing and having sat down on the tribunal, was delivering a public address to them.

rows.spanish: Pero Bernabé y Saulo regresaron a Jerusalén, después de haber cumplido el ministerio, llevando consigo a Juan, llamado Marcos.
rows.current_english_pob: But Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem after completing the ministry, taking along John, who was called Mark.
rows.spanish_base_english: But Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem after completing the ministry, taking along John, who was called Mark.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en Antioquía, en la iglesia que estaba en Antioquía, había profetas y maestros: Bernabé, Simeón, llamado Niger, Lucio de Cirene, Manaén, compañero cercano de Herodes el tetrarca, y Saulo.
rows.current_english_pob: In Antioch, in the church there, there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen, a close companion of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in Antioch, in the church there, there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen, a close companion of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, después de la lectura de la Ley y de los Profetas, los jefes de la sinagoga les enviaron mensaje, diciendo: «Hermanos, si hay entre ustedes alguna palabra de ánimo para el pueblo, hablen».
rows.current_english_pob: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue rulers sent word to them, saying, “Brothers, if there is among you any word of encouragement for the people, speak.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue rulers sent word to them, saying, “Brothers, if there is among you any word of encouragement for the people, speak.”

rows.spanish: Y cuando Juan estaba completando su curso, seguía diciendo: «¿Qué suponen que soy? Yo no soy él. Pero he aquí, viene después de mí uno de quien no soy digno de desatar las sandalias de sus pies».
rows.current_english_pob: And as John was completing his course, he kept saying, ‘What do you suppose me to be? I am not he. But look, one is coming after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
rows.spanish_base_english: And as John was completing his course, he kept saying, ‘What do you suppose I am? I am not he. But behold, one is coming after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

rows.spanish: Pues los que viven en Jerusalén y sus gobernantes, sin reconocerlo y condenándolo, cumplieron las palabras de los profetas que se leen cada sábado,
rows.current_english_pob: For those who live in Jerusalem and their rulers, because they did not recognize this one and by condemning him fulfilled the voices of the prophets that are read every Sabbath,
rows.spanish_base_english: For those who live in Jerusalem and their rulers, not recognizing this one and condemning him, fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath,

rows.spanish: Y nosotros les anunciamos las buenas noticias de la promesa hecha a los padres,
rows.current_english_pob: And we ourselves proclaim to you the good news of the promise made to the fathers,
rows.spanish_base_english: And we proclaim to you the good news of the promise made to the fathers,

rows.spanish: Y en cuanto al hecho de que lo resucitó de entre los muertos, ya no para volver a la corrupción, así ha dicho: «Les daré las bendiciones santas y seguras de David».
rows.current_english_pob: And that he raised him from the dead, no longer about to return to decay, he has spoken in this way: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
rows.spanish_base_english: And as for the fact that he raised him from the dead, no longer to return to decay, he has spoken in this way: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

rows.spanish: Cuando los gentiles oyeron esto, se alegraron y glorificaron la palabra de Yahvé, y creyeron cuantos habían sido destinados para la vida eterna.
rows.current_english_pob: When the Gentiles heard this, they began rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord, and all who had been appointed for eternal life believed.
rows.spanish_base_english: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and as many as had been appointed to eternal life believed.

rows.spanish: En Iconio, entraron juntos en la sinagoga de los judíos y hablaron de tal manera que una gran multitud de judíos y de griegos creyó.
rows.current_english_pob: In Iconium they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews and spoke in such a way that a great multitude of both Jews and Greeks believed.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in Iconium they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews and spoke in such a way that a great multitude of both Jews and Greeks believed.

rows.spanish: Pero cuando los apóstoles Bernabé y Pablo lo oyeron, rasgaron sus vestidos y se lanzaron al gentío, clamando,
rows.current_english_pob: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard, they tore their garments and rushed out into the crowd, crying out,
rows.spanish_base_english: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard, they tore their garments and rushed into the crowd, crying out,

rows.spanish: y diciendo: «Hombres, ¿por qué hacen estas cosas? Nosotros también somos hombres de la misma condición que ustedes, y les anunciamos buenas nuevas, para que se vuelvan de estas cosas inútiles al Dios viviente, que hizo el cielo, la tierra, el mar y todo lo que hay en ellos».
rows.current_english_pob: and saying, “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men with the same nature as you, bringing you good news to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.”
rows.spanish_base_english: and saying, “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like nature with you, bringing you good news, that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and all that is in them.”

rows.spanish: Y al decir estas cosas, apenas contuvieron a las multitudes de ofrecerles sacrificios.
rows.current_english_pob: Even by saying these things, they barely restrained the crowds from sacrificing to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And by saying these things, they scarcely restrained the crowds from sacrificing to them.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, ¿por qué están poniendo a prueba a Dios, al imponer un yugo sobre el cuello de los discípulos, que ni nuestros padres ni nosotros hemos podido llevar?
rows.current_english_pob: Now then, why are you testing God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples that neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?
rows.spanish_base_english: Now then, why are you testing God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples that neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?

rows.spanish: Entonces pareció bien a los apóstoles y a los ancianos, junto con toda la iglesia, elegir hombres de entre ellos y enviarlos a Antioquía con Pablo y Bernabé: Judas, llamado Barsabás, y Silas, hombres destacados entre los hermanos.
rows.current_english_pob: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, together with the whole church, to choose men from among them and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas, who was called Barsabbas, and Silas, men who were leading among the brothers.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, together with the whole church, to choose men from among them and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas, who was called Barsabbas, and Silas, leading men among the brothers.

rows.spanish: Puesto que hemos oído que algunos salieron de entre nosotros y los perturbaron con palabras, trastornando sus almas, aunque nosotros no les dimos instrucciones,
rows.current_english_pob: Since we have heard that some went out from us and troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, to whom we gave no instructions,
rows.spanish_base_english: Since we have heard that some from among us have gone out and troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, although we gave them no instructions,

rows.spanish: También llegó a Derbe y a Listra. Y he aquí, cierto discípulo estaba allí, llamado Timoteo, hijo de una mujer judía creyente, pero de padre griego.
rows.current_english_pob: He also came to Derbe and to Lystra. And behold, a certain disciple was there named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman, but of a Greek father,
rows.spanish_base_english: He also came to Derbe and to Lystra. And behold, a certain disciple was there named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman, but of a Greek father,

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, mientras íbamos al lugar de oración, cierta esclava, que tenía un espíritu de Pitón, nos salió al encuentro; ella daba mucha ganancia a sus amos mediante la adivinación.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened that, as we were going to the place of prayer, a certain servant girl who had a python spirit met us, and she was bringing much profit to her masters by fortune-telling.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened that, as we were going to the place of prayer, a certain slave girl having a spirit of Python met us, who was bringing much profit to her masters by fortune-telling.

rows.spanish: Ella iba siguiendo a Pablo y a nosotros, y gritaba: «Estos hombres son esclavos del Dios Altísimo, que les proclaman el camino de salvación».
rows.current_english_pob: She kept following Paul and us and crying out, saying, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation.”
rows.spanish_base_english: She kept following Paul and us and crying out, saying, “These men are slaves of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation.”

rows.spanish: Y ella seguía haciendo esto por muchos días. Pero Pablo, profundamente turbado, se volvió al espíritu y dijo: «Te ordeno en el nombre de Jesús Mesías que salgas de ella». Y salió en esa misma hora.
rows.current_english_pob: And she kept doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly troubled, turned to the spirit and said, “I command you in the name of Jesus the Messiah to come out of her.” And it came out that very hour.
rows.spanish_base_english: And she kept doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly troubled, turned to the spirit and said, “I command you in the name of Jesus Messiah to come out of her.” And it came out that very hour.

rows.spanish: A eso de la medianoche, Pablo y Silas, mientras oraban, cantaban himnos a Dios, y los prisioneros los escuchaban.
rows.current_english_pob: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

rows.spanish: Entonces pidió luces, entró corriendo y, temblando de miedo, cayó ante Pablo y Silas,
rows.current_english_pob: Then, asking for lights, he rushed in, and trembling with fear he fell down before Paul and Silas,
rows.spanish_base_english: Then, asking for lights, he rushed in, and becoming trembling, he fell down before Paul and Silas,

rows.spanish: Estos eran de ánimo más noble que los de Tesalónica, pues recibieron la palabra con todo entusiasmo, examinando cada día las Escrituras para ver si estas cosas eran así.
rows.current_english_pob: These were more noble-minded than those in Thessalonica, for they received the word with all eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these were more noble-minded than those in Thessalonica, for they received the word with all eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, mientras Pablo los esperaba en Atenas, su espíritu se sentía provocado dentro de él, al ver que la ciudad estaba llena de ídolos.
rows.current_english_pob: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw that the city was full of idols.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now while Paul was waiting for them in Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw that the city was full of idols.

rows.spanish: Así que lo tomaron consigo y lo llevaron al Areópago, diciendo: «¿Podríamos saber cuál es esta nueva enseñanza que estás enseñando?»
rows.current_english_pob: So they took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is that is being spoken by you?”
rows.spanish_base_english: So they took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are speaking?”

rows.spanish: Pues todos los atenienses y los extranjeros que estaban de paso allí pasaban el tiempo en nada más que en decir o en oír algo más nuevo.
rows.current_english_pob: All the Athenians and the foreigners staying there would spend their time in nothing else than telling or hearing something newer.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now all the Athenians and the foreigners staying there would spend their time in nothing else than telling or hearing something newer.

rows.spanish: Y de uno hizo toda nación de seres humanos para habitar sobre toda la faz de la tierra, habiendo determinado sus tiempos señalados y los límites de su habitación.
rows.current_english_pob: And he made from one man every nation of mankind to live on the whole face of the earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their dwelling place,
rows.spanish_base_english: And he made from one every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their dwelling place,

rows.spanish: Porque en él vivimos, y nos movemos, y somos, como incluso algunos de sus propios poetas han dicho: «Porque también nosotros somos su descendencia».
rows.current_english_pob: For in him we live and move and exist, as even some of your own poets have said, ‘For we also are his offspring.’
rows.spanish_base_english: For in him we live and move and are, as even some of your own poets have said, ‘For we also are his offspring.’

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando oyeron acerca de la resurrección de los muertos, unos se burlaban, pero otros dijeron: «Te oiremos otra vez acerca de esto».
rows.current_english_pob: When they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked, but others said, “We will hear you again about this.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked, but others said, “We will hear you again about this.”

rows.spanish: Y halló a un judío llamado Áquila, natural de Ponto, recién llegado de Italia con Priscila, su esposa, porque Claudio había ordenado que todos los judíos salieran de Roma; y fue a ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with Priscilla his wife because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome; and he went to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, recently come from Italy with Priscilla his wife because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to depart from Rome; and he went to them.

rows.spanish: Pero cuando se opusieron y blasfemaron, sacudió sus vestidos y les dijo: «Su sangre caiga sobre sus propias cabezas. Soy inocente. Desde ahora iré a los gentiles».
rows.current_english_pob: But when they opposed and reviled him, he shook out his garments and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads. I am innocent. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But when they opposed and blasphemed, he shook out his garments and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads. I am innocent. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”

rows.spanish: Había un judío llamado Apolos, alejandrino de nacimiento, hombre elocuente, que llegó a Éfeso, siendo poderoso en las Escrituras.
rows.current_english_pob: A certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, an eloquent man, arrived in Ephesus, being mighty in the Scriptures.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, an eloquent man, arrived in Ephesus, being mighty in the Scriptures.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, sucedió que, mientras Apolos estaba en Corinto, Pablo, después de pasar por las regiones del interior, llegó a Éfeso y halló a algunos discípulos.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened that while Apollos was in Corinth, Paul passed through the inland regions and came to Ephesus and found some disciples,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that while Apollos was in Corinth, Paul passed through the inland regions and came to Ephesus and found some disciples,

rows.spanish: Y cuando Pablo les impuso las manos, el Espíritu Santo vino sobre ellos, y hablaban en lenguas y profetizaban.
rows.current_english_pob: And when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they began speaking in tongues and prophesying.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.

rows.spanish: Había siete hijos de un judío llamado Sceva, jefe de los sacerdotes, que hacían esto.
rows.current_english_pob: There were seven sons of a Jewish chief priest named Sceva doing this.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were seven sons of a Jewish chief priest named Sceva doing this.

rows.spanish: Y muchos de los que habían creído venían, confesando y declarando lo que habían hecho.
rows.current_english_pob: And many of those who had believed were coming, confessing and disclosing their practices.
rows.spanish_base_english: And many of those who had believed were coming, confessing and declaring their deeds.

rows.spanish: Y muchos de los que habían practicado artes mágicas reunieron sus libros y los quemaron en presencia de todos; y calcularon su valor, y hallaron que era de cincuenta mil piezas de plata.
rows.current_english_pob: And many of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books together and were burning them in front of everyone; and they totaled up their value and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
rows.spanish_base_english: And many of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of everyone; and they totaled up their value and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando se completaron estas cosas, Pablo resolvió en el Espíritu ir a Jerusalén, después de pasar por Macedonia y Acaya, diciendo: «Después de haber estado allí, también debo ver Roma».
rows.current_english_pob: After these things were completed, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem after passing through Macedonia and Achaia, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after these things were completed, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem after passing through Macedonia and Achaia, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

rows.spanish: En aquel tiempo hubo no pequeño alboroto acerca del Camino.
rows.current_english_pob: At that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now at that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

rows.spanish: Y no solo nuestro oficio corre peligro de caer en descrédito, sino también que el templo de la gran diosa Artemisa sea tenido por nada, y aun que su majestad—a quien toda Asia y el mundo adoran—sea derribada.
rows.current_english_pob: And not only is this trade of ours in danger of coming into disrepute, but also the temple of the great goddess Artemis may be counted as nothing, and even her majesty—whom all Asia and the world worships—may be brought down.
rows.spanish_base_english: And not only is this trade of ours in danger of coming into disrepute, but also the temple of the great goddess Artemis may be counted as nothing, and even her majesty—whom all Asia and the world worship—may be brought down.

rows.spanish: Pero, después de que el secretario municipal calmó a la multitud, dijo: «Varones efesios, pues ¿qué hombre hay que no sepa que la ciudad de los efesios es guardiana del templo de la gran Artemisa y de la imagen caída del cielo?».
rows.current_english_pob: But after the city clerk had quieted the crowd, he said, “Men of Ephesus, for what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple-keeper of the great Artemis and of the image fallen from heaven?”
rows.spanish_base_english: But after the city clerk had quieted the crowd, he said, “Men of Ephesus, for what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is keeper of the temple of the great Artemis and of the image fallen from heaven?”

rows.spanish: Por tanto, ya que estas cosas son indiscutibles, es necesario que ustedes mantengan la calma y no hagan nada precipitado.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, since these things are undeniable, it is necessary for you to remain calm and to do nothing rash.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore, since these things are undeniable, it is necessary for you to remain calm and to do nothing rash.

rows.spanish: El primer día de la semana, cuando nos habíamos reunido para partir el pan, Pablo les hablaba, con intención de salir al día siguiente, y prolongó el mensaje hasta la medianoche.
rows.current_english_pob: On the first day of the week, when we had gathered to break bread, Paul was speaking to them, intending to depart the next day, and he prolonged the message until midnight.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the first day of the week, when we had gathered to break bread, Paul was speaking to them, intending to depart the next day, and he prolonged the message until midnight.

rows.spanish: Había muchas lámparas en el aposento alto donde estábamos reunidos.
rows.current_english_pob: There were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.

rows.spanish: Ahora, desde Mileto, envió a Éfeso y mandó llamar a los ancianos de la iglesia.
rows.current_english_pob: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now from Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.

rows.spanish: Y ahora, he aquí, atado por el Espíritu, voy a Jerusalén, sin saber qué me acontecerá allí,
rows.current_english_pob: And now, behold, bound in the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there,
rows.spanish_base_english: And now, behold, bound by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there,

rows.spanish: Y ahora sé que ninguno de ustedes, entre quienes anduve proclamando el reino, volverá a ver mi rostro.
rows.current_english_pob: And now, look, I know that none of you among whom I went about proclaiming the kingdom will see my face again.
rows.spanish_base_english: And now, behold, I know that none of you among whom I went about proclaiming the kingdom will see my face again.

rows.spanish: Todos lloraron mucho, abrazaron a Pablo y lo besaron con cariño.
rows.current_english_pob: They all wept a great deal, threw their arms around Paul’s neck, and kept kissing him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And there was much weeping among them all, and falling on Paul's neck, they were kissing him affectionately.

rows.spanish: Tenía cuatro hijas solteras que profetizaban.
rows.current_english_pob: He had four unmarried daughters who were prophesying.
rows.spanish_base_english: He had four virgin daughters who were prophesying.

rows.spanish: Y algunos de los discípulos de Cesarea también fueron con nosotros, llevándonos a un tal Mnasón de Chipre, un discípulo de larga data, con quien nos hospedaríamos.
rows.current_english_pob: And some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing us to Mnason, a certain Cypriot, an early disciple, with whom we were to stay.
rows.spanish_base_english: And some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing us to a certain Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we were to stay.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, haz lo que te decimos: tenemos cuatro hombres que están bajo un voto propio.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore do what we tell you: we have four men who are under a vow of their own.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore do what we tell you: we have four men who have a vow upon themselves.

rows.spanish: Cuando Pablo estaba a punto de ser introducido en el cuartel, dijo al tribuno: «¿Me está permitido decirte algo?». Y él dijo: «¿Sabes griego?»
rows.current_english_pob: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he said to the tribune, “Is it permitted for me to say something to you?” And he said, “Do you know Greek?”
rows.spanish_base_english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he said to the tribune, “Is it permitted for me to say something to you?” And he said, “Do you know Greek?”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, sucedió que, mientras yo viajaba y me acercaba a Damasco, como al mediodía, de repente una luz intensa del cielo resplandeció alrededor de mí.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened that as I was traveling and drawing near to Damascus, about noon, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that as I was traveling and drawing near to Damascus, about noon, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me,

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, los que estaban conmigo vieron la luz, pero no oyeron la voz del que me hablaba.
rows.current_english_pob: Those who were with me saw the light, but they did not hear the voice of the one speaking to me.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now those who were with me saw the light, but they did not hear the voice of the one speaking to me.

rows.spanish: Ananías, cierto hombre devoto conforme a la ley, de quien todos los judíos que vivían allí daban buen testimonio,
rows.current_english_pob: A certain man, Ananias, devout according to the law, well spoken of by all the Jews living there,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a certain man, Ananias, devout according to the law, well spoken of by all the Jews living there,

rows.spanish: Lo escuchaban hasta esta expresión, y alzaron la voz, diciendo: «¡Quiten de la tierra a un hombre así, porque no debe vivir!»
rows.current_english_pob: They were listening to him up to this statement, and they raised their voices, saying, “Take such a man away from the earth, for it was not fitting for him to live.”
rows.spanish_base_english: They were listening to him up to this statement, and they raised their voices, saying, “Away with such a man from the earth, for he ought not to live.”

rows.spanish: Y Pablo dijo: «Yo no sabía, hermanos, que era el sumo sacerdote; porque está escrito: “No hablarás mal de un gobernante de tu pueblo”».
rows.current_english_pob: And Paul said, “I did not know, brothers, that he is the high priest; for it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Paul said, “I did not know, brothers, that he was the high priest; for it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

rows.spanish: Así que no te dejes persuadir por ellos, porque más de cuarenta hombres de entre ellos le están tendiendo una emboscada; quienes se han puesto bajo maldición de no comer ni beber hasta matarlo. Y ahora están listos, esperando tu promesa.
rows.current_english_pob: So do not be persuaded by them, for more than forty men from among them are lying in ambush for him, who have bound themselves under a curse neither to eat nor to drink until they have killed him. And now they are ready, waiting for the promise from you.
rows.spanish_base_english: So do not be persuaded by them, for more than forty men among them are lying in ambush for him, who have bound themselves under a curse neither to eat nor to drink until they have killed him. And now they are ready, waiting for the promise from you.

rows.spanish: Después de cinco días, el sumo sacerdote Ananías bajó con algunos ancianos y cierto orador llamado Tértulo, y ellos presentaron cargos contra Pablo ante el gobernador.
rows.current_english_pob: After five days, the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a certain orator named Tertullus, and they brought charges against Paul before the governor.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after five days, the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a certain orator named Tertullus, and they brought charges against Paul before the governor.

rows.spanish: Y cuando fue citado, Tértulo comenzó a acusarlo, diciendo: «Puesto que por ti gozamos de mucha paz, y se están haciendo reformas para esta nación por tu previsión»
rows.current_english_pob: And when he had been summoned, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying: “Since through you we are enjoying much peace, and reforms are being brought to this nation through your foresight,”
rows.spanish_base_english: And when he had been summoned, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying: “Since through you we are enjoying much peace, and reforms are being made for this nation through your foresight,”

rows.spanish: Pero, para no demorarlo más, le ruego, por su bondad, que nos escuche brevemente.
rows.current_english_pob: But, so that I may not delay you any further, I beg you to hear us briefly, in your graciousness.
rows.spanish_base_english: But, so that I may not detain you any longer, I beg you to hear us briefly in your courtesy.

rows.spanish: Porque hemos hallado que este hombre es una plaga, que provoca disturbios entre todos los judíos por todo el mundo, y además cabecilla de la secta de los nazarenos,
rows.current_english_pob: For we have found this man to be a plague, stirring up riots among all the Jews throughout the inhabited world, and also a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
rows.spanish_base_english: For we have found this man to be a plague, stirring up unrest among all the Jews throughout the inhabited world, and also a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,

rows.spanish: Ahora, después de varios años, vine para traer limosnas a mi nación y ofrendas.
rows.current_english_pob: After several years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after several years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.

rows.spanish: Pero hay algunos judíos de Asia, que deberían estar presentes ante ti y acusarme, si tienen algo contra mí.
rows.current_english_pob: But there are some Jews from Asia who ought to have been present before you and to accuse me, if they had anything against me.
rows.spanish_base_english: But there are some Jews from Asia who ought to be present before you and to accuse me, if they have anything against me.

rows.spanish: Pero Félix, teniendo un conocimiento más exacto acerca del Camino, aplazó el asunto, diciendo: «Cuando descienda el comandante Lisias, decidiré su caso».
rows.current_english_pob: But Felix, having a more accurate knowledge about the Way, put them off, saying, “When Lysias the commander comes down, I will decide your case.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But Felix, having a more accurate knowledge concerning the Way, put them off, saying, “When Lysias the commander comes down, I will decide your case.”

rows.spanish: Después de algunos días, Félix vino con Drusila, su propia esposa, que era judía, y mandó llamar a Pablo y lo oyó acerca de la fe en Mesías Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his own wife, who was Jewish, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning faith in Messiah Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his own wife, who was Jewish, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning faith in Messiah Jesus.

rows.spanish: Pero mientras hablaba acerca de rectitud, dominio propio y del juicio venidero, Félix se atemorizó y respondió: «Por el momento, vete; cuando tenga oportunidad, te haré llamar».
rows.current_english_pob: But as he was discussing righteousness and self-control and the coming judgment, Felix became afraid and answered, “For now, go away. When I get an opportunity, I will summon you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But as he was discussing righteousness and self-control and the coming judgment, Felix became afraid and answered, “For the present, go away. When I get an opportunity, I will summon you.”

rows.spanish: Pero cuando se cumplieron dos años, Félix fue sucedido por Porcio Festo; y como Félix quería hacerles un favor a los judíos, dejó a Pablo atado.
rows.current_english_pob: But when two years had been completed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus; and because Felix wanted to lay up favor with the Jews, he left Paul bound.
rows.spanish_base_english: But when two years had been completed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus; and because Felix wanted to do the Jews a favor, he left Paul bound.

rows.spanish: pidiendo un favor contra él, que lo mandara traer a Jerusalén, preparando una emboscada para matarlo en el camino.
rows.current_english_pob: asking a favor against him, that he would have him brought to Jerusalem, while setting an ambush to kill him on the way.
rows.spanish_base_english: asking a favor against him, that he might have him brought to Jerusalem, setting an ambush to kill him on the way.

rows.spanish: Festus, por tanto, respondió que Pablo estaba retenido en Cesarea, y que él mismo estaba a punto de partir en breve.
rows.current_english_pob: Festus therefore answered that Paul was being kept in Caesarea, and that he himself was about to leave shortly.
rows.spanish_base_english: Festus therefore answered that Paul was being kept in Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

rows.spanish: Pasados algunos días, el rey Agripa y Berenice llegaron a Cesarea para saludar a Festo.
rows.current_english_pob: After some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea to greet Festus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea to greet Festus.

rows.spanish: Y, porque estaba perplejo acerca de cómo investigar estos asuntos, le pregunté si quería ir a Jerusalén y ser juzgado allí respecto de ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And since I was at a loss about the investigation concerning these matters, I asked whether he wanted to go to Jerusalem and be judged there concerning them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And because I was at a loss how to investigate these matters, I asked whether he wanted to go to Jerusalem and be judged there concerning them.

rows.spanish: Así, al día siguiente, Agripa y Berenice llegaron con gran pompa y entraron en la sala de audiencias, con los tribunos militares y los hombres principales de la ciudad; y, por orden de Festo, hicieron entrar a Pablo.
rows.current_english_pob: So on the next day, Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the audience hall with both the military tribunes and the prominent men of the city, and at Festus's command Paul was brought in.
