rows.spanish_base_english: Now Moses would take the tent and pitch it for himself outside the camp, far from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone seeking Yahweh would go out to the tent of meeting that was outside the camp.

rows.spanish: Ahora, pues, si he hallado favor ante tus ojos, te ruego que me des a conocer tu camino, para que yo te conozca, a fin de que halle favor ante tus ojos. Y mira que esta nación es tu pueblo.
rows.current_english_pob: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your eyes, please make your ways known to me, so that I may know you, in order that I may find favor in your eyes. And consider that this nation is your people.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your eyes, please make your way known to me, so that I may know you, in order that I may find favor in your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.

rows.spanish: Yahvé dijo: «Mira, hay un lugar junto a mí, y estarás de pie sobre la roca».
rows.current_english_pob: And the LORD said, “Look, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.”

rows.spanish: Y nadie subirá contigo, y nadie será visto en ninguna parte del monte; ni el rebaño ni el ganado pastarán delante de aquel monte.
rows.current_english_pob: And no man shall go up with you, and indeed no man shall be seen anywhere on the mountain; even the flock and the herd must not graze in front of that mountain.
rows.spanish_base_english: And no man shall go up with you, and let no man be seen anywhere on the mountain; even the flock and the herd must not graze in front of that mountain.

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «Mira, yo hago un pacto delante de todo tu pueblo. Haré maravillas que no han sido creadas en toda la tierra ni entre todas las naciones. Y todo el pueblo en medio del cual tú estás verá la obra de Yahvé, porque es algo sobrecogedor lo que yo hago contigo».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Look, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders such as have not been created in all the earth or among any of the nations. And all the people in whose midst you are will see the work of the LORD, for what I am doing with you is awe-inspiring.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders such as have not been created in all the earth or among any of the nations. And all the people in whose midst you are will see the work of Yahweh, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.”

rows.spanish: Guarda lo que te estoy mandando hoy. He aquí, estoy expulsando de delante de ti a los amorreos, a los cananeos, a los hititas, a los ferezeos, a los heveos y a los jebuseos.
rows.current_english_pob: Keep what I am commanding you today. Behold, I am driving out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
rows.spanish_base_english: Keep what I am commanding you today. Behold, I am driving out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

rows.spanish: Y todas las mujeres cuyos corazones las impulsaron, con habilidad, hilaron pelo de cabra.
rows.current_english_pob: And all the women whose hearts moved them with skill spun the goats' hair.
rows.spanish_base_english: And all the women whose hearts stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats' hair.

rows.spanish: Él los ha llenado de sabiduría de corazón para hacer toda clase de trabajo de grabador, de diseñador y de bordador en azul, en púrpura, en hilo escarlata y en lino fino, y de tejedor: hacedores de toda obra e ideadores de diseños.
rows.current_english_pob: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do every kind of work of an engraver, a designer, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet yarn, and in fine linen, and of a weaver—makers of every kind of work and designers of designs.
rows.spanish_base_english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do every kind of work of an engraver, a designer, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet yarn, and in fine linen, and of a weaver—doers of every kind of work and devisers of designs.

rows.spanish: Y tomaron de delante de Moisés toda la contribución que los hijos de Israel habían traído para la obra del servicio del santuario, para hacerla. Y seguían trayéndole todavía ofrendas voluntarias mañana tras mañana.
rows.current_english_pob: And they took from before Moses all the contribution that the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to do it. But they still kept bringing to him freewill offerings morning after morning.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they took from before Moses all the contribution that the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to do it. And they kept bringing to him freewill offerings morning after morning.

rows.spanish: Entonces Moisés mandó, y se proclamó por todo el campamento, diciendo: «Ni hombre ni mujer hagan ya más trabajo para la ofrenda del santuario». Y al pueblo se le impidió seguir trayendo más.
rows.current_english_pob: So Moses commanded, and they sent a proclamation through the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman do any more work for the contribution of the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more.
rows.spanish_base_english: So Moses commanded, and they proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman do any more work for the contribution of the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more.

rows.spanish: La longitud de cada cortina era de treinta codos, y el ancho de cada cortina era de cuatro codos; las once cortinas tenían la misma medida.
rows.current_english_pob: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the width of each curtain; the eleven curtains had one measure.
rows.spanish_base_english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain was four cubits; all eleven curtains had the same measure.

rows.spanish: E hizo cuarenta bases de plata bajo los veinte marcos, dos bases bajo un marco para sus dos espigas, y dos bases bajo el otro marco para sus dos espigas.
rows.current_english_pob: And he made forty silver bases under the twenty frames, two bases under the one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the other frame for its two tenons.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he made forty silver bases under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the other frame for its two tenons.

rows.spanish: Estaban emparejados en la parte inferior, y juntos estaban completos en su parte superior, hacia el aro único. Así lo hizo con ambos, para las dos esquinas.
rows.current_english_pob: They were paired at the bottom, and together they were complete up to its top, to the one ring. Thus he did for both of them, for the two corners.
rows.spanish_base_english: They were paired at the bottom, and together they were complete at its top, to the one ring. Thus he did for both of them, for the two corners.

rows.spanish: y cinco barras para las tablas del segundo lado del tabernáculo, y cinco barras para las tablas del tabernáculo al lado posterior, hacia el oeste.
rows.current_english_pob: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at the far rear on the west.
rows.spanish_base_english: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle on the rear side westward.

rows.spanish: Los anillos estaban frente al marco, como receptáculos para las varas, para llevar la mesa.
rows.current_english_pob: The rings were beside the frame, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
rows.spanish_base_english: The rings were opposite the frame, as holders for the poles to carry the table.

rows.spanish: Hizo los utensilios de oro puro que estaban sobre la mesa: sus platos, sus copas, sus jarros y sus cuencos con los que se derramaban las ofrendas de libación.
rows.current_english_pob: He made the utensils that were on the table: its plates, its cups, its pitchers, and its bowls with which the drink offering was poured out, of pure gold.
rows.spanish_base_english: He made the utensils that were on the table: its plates, its cups, its jars, and its bowls with which drink offerings were poured out, of pure gold.

rows.spanish: Y para el lado occidental había cortinas de cincuenta codos, sus columnas diez y sus basas diez; los ganchos de las columnas y sus bandas eran de plata.
rows.current_english_pob: And for the west side there were hangings of fifty cubits, with ten of their pillars and ten of their bases; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
rows.spanish_base_english: And for the west side there were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their bases ten; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.

rows.spanish: Sus cuatro columnas y sus cuatro bases de bronce, sus ganchos de plata y el recubrimiento de sus partes superiores y sus bandas de plata.
rows.current_english_pob: Their four pillars and their four bronze bases, their hooks of silver, and the overlay of their tops and their bands of silver.
rows.spanish_base_english: Their four pillars and their four bronze bases, their silver hooks, and the overlay of their tops and their silver bands.

rows.spanish: Sujetaron el pectoral por sus anillos a los anillos del efod con un cordón azul, para que estuviera sobre la banda tejida del efod, y para que el pectoral no se desprendiera del efod, tal como Yahvé había mandado a Moisés.
rows.current_english_pob: They fastened the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue, so that it would be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and so that the breastpiece would not come loose from on the ephod, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses.
rows.spanish_base_english: They fastened the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it would be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and so that the breastpiece would not come loose from the ephod, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

rows.spanish: Moisés vio toda la obra, y he aquí que la habían realizado tal como Yahvé había mandado; así la habían hecho. Y Moisés los bendijo.
rows.current_english_pob: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it; just as Yahweh had commanded, so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it; just as Yahweh had commanded, so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.

rows.spanish: Cuando entraron en la tienda de reunión, y cuando se acercaron al altar, se lavaron, tal como Yahvé había mandado a Moisés.
rows.current_english_pob: Whenever they entered the tent of meeting, and whenever they approached the altar, they washed, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses.
rows.spanish_base_english: When they entered the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses.

rows.spanish: Y la tierra estaba sin forma y vacía, y las tinieblas estaban sobre la superficie del abismo, y el Espíritu de Dios se cernía sobre la superficie de las aguas.
rows.current_english_pob: And the earth was formless and empty, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the earth was formless and empty, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

rows.spanish: Y Dios dijo: «He aquí, les he dado toda planta que da semilla, que está sobre la faz de toda la tierra, y todo árbol en el que hay fruto de árbol que da semilla. Eso será para ustedes como alimento».
rows.current_english_pob: And God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that is on the face of all the earth, and every tree in which is the fruit of a tree bearing seed. It will be for you as food.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that is on the face of all the earth, and every tree in which is the fruit of a tree bearing seed. It will be for you as food.”

rows.spanish: Y vio Dios todo lo que había hecho, y he aquí que era muy bueno. Y hubo tarde y hubo mañana, el sexto día.
rows.current_english_pob: And God saw all that he had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
rows.spanish_base_english: And God saw all that he had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, todavía no había en la tierra arbusto del campo, ni había brotado aún planta del campo, porque Yahvé Dios no había hecho llover sobre la tierra, y no había hombre para trabajar el suelo.
rows.current_english_pob: No shrub of the field was yet on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprung up, because Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and there was no man to work the ground.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now no shrub of the field was yet on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprung up, because Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and there was no man to work the ground.

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé Dios formó al hombre del polvo de la tierra, e insufló en su nariz el aliento de vida, y el hombre llegó a ser un ser viviente.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Yahweh God formed the man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living creature.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Yahweh God formed the man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

rows.spanish: Ahora, un río salía de Edén para regar el jardín, y de allí se dividía y formaba cuatro cabeceras.
rows.current_english_pob: A river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it divided and became four headwaters.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it divided and became four headwaters.

rows.spanish: Yahvé Dios formó de la tierra todo animal del campo y toda ave del cielo, y los trajo al hombre para ver cómo los llamaría. Todo nombre que el hombre dio a cada ser viviente, ese fue su nombre.
rows.current_english_pob: Yahweh God formed from the ground every wild animal and every bird of the sky, and he brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Yahweh God formed from the ground every wild animal and every bird of the sky, and he brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

rows.spanish: Y de la costilla que Yahvé Dios había tomado del hombre, hizo una mujer, y la llevó al hombre.
rows.current_english_pob: And the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, he built into a woman, and he brought her to the man.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the rib that Yahweh God had taken from the man he made into a woman, and he brought her to the man.

rows.spanish: Ahora la serpiente era más astuta que cualquier bestia del campo que Yahvé Dios había hecho. Y dijo a la mujer: “¿Conque Dios ha dicho: ‘No comerán de ningún árbol del jardín’?”
rows.current_english_pob: The serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that Yahweh God had made. And he said to the woman, “Indeed, has God said, ‘You shall not eat from any tree of the garden’?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that Yahweh God had made. And he said to the woman, “Indeed, has God said, ‘You shall not eat from any tree of the garden’?”

rows.spanish: Y él dijo: «¿Quién te dijo que estabas desnudo? ¿Has comido del árbol del cual te mandé no comer?»
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree from which I commanded you not to eat?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree from which I commanded you not to eat?”

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé Dios le dijo a la mujer: «¿Qué es esto que has hecho?» Y la mujer dijo: «La serpiente me engañó, y comí».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Yahweh God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Yahweh God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

rows.spanish: Y pondré enemistad entre ti y la mujer, y entre tu simiente y su simiente; él aplastará tu cabeza, y tú herirás su talón.
rows.current_english_pob: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; he will crush your head, and you will bruise his heel.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring; he will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé Dios dijo: «He aquí, el hombre ha llegado a ser como uno de nosotros, conociendo el bien y el mal. Y ahora, no sea que extienda su mano y también tome del árbol de la vida, y coma, y viva para siempre—»
rows.current_english_pob: Then Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and also take from the tree of life and eat, and live forever—”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and also take from the tree of life and eat, and live forever—”

rows.spanish: Y Adam conoció a Eva, su esposa; ella concibió y dio a luz a Caín, y dijo: «He adquirido un hombre de parte de Yahvé».
rows.current_english_pob: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, “I have acquired a man from Yahweh.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the man knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, “I have acquired a man with Yahweh.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé dijo a Caín: «¿Dónde está Abel, tu hermano?» Y él dijo: «No lo sé. ¿Acaso soy yo el guardián de mi hermano?»
rows.current_english_pob: Then Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

rows.spanish: Varón y mujer los creó, y los bendijo, y les puso por nombre Adán el día en que fueron creados.
rows.current_english_pob: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and called their name Man on the day they were created.
rows.spanish_base_english: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and called their name Adam on the day they were created.

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé dijo: «Mi Espíritu no contenderá con el hombre para siempre, porque él es carne; por tanto, sus días serán ciento veinte años».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is flesh; therefore his days will be one hundred and twenty years.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not abide in man forever, for he is flesh; his days will be one hundred and twenty years.”

rows.spanish: Y Yahvé sintió pesar por haber hecho al hombre en la tierra, y se dolió en su corazón.
rows.current_english_pob: And Yahweh regretted having made man on the earth, and he was pained in his heart.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh grieved over having made man on the earth, and he was pained in his heart.

rows.spanish: Ahora la tierra estaba corrupta delante de Dios, y la tierra estaba llena de violencia.
rows.current_english_pob: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

rows.spanish: Y vio Dios la tierra, y he aquí, estaba corrompida, porque toda carne había corrompido su camino sobre la tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: And God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupted, because all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
rows.spanish_base_english: And God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupted, because all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.

rows.spanish: Entonces Dios dijo a Noé: «El fin de toda carne ha llegado delante de mí, porque la tierra está llena de violencia a causa de ellos. Y he aquí, voy a destruirlos con la tierra».
rows.current_english_pob: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. And behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. And behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.”

rows.spanish: Y yo—he aquí— estoy trayendo el diluvio de aguas sobre la tierra para destruir toda carne en la cual hay aliento de vida, todo lo que hay debajo de los cielos. Todo lo que está sobre la tierra morirá.
rows.current_english_pob: And I—behold, I am bringing the flood of waters upon the earth to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life from under heaven. Everything that is on the earth will perish.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I—behold, I am bringing the flood of waters upon the earth to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life from under heaven. Everything that is on the earth will perish.

rows.spanish: Ahora Noé tenía seiscientos años, y el diluvio estaba sobre la tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: Noah was six hundred years old, and the flood was upon the earth.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Noah was six hundred years old, and the flood was upon the earth.

rows.spanish: Y hubo lluvia sobre la tierra cuarenta días y cuarenta noches.
rows.current_english_pob: And the rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.

rows.spanish: Y los que entraron, macho y hembra de toda carne, entraron como Dios le había mandado; y Yahvé cerró tras él.
rows.current_english_pob: And those that entered, male and female from all flesh, as God had commanded him; and Yahweh shut him in.
rows.spanish_base_english: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, entered as God had commanded him; and Yahweh shut him in.

rows.spanish: Las aguas subieron quince codos más, y los montes quedaron cubiertos.
rows.current_english_pob: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
rows.spanish_base_english: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.

rows.spanish: Y la paloma vino a él al atardecer, y he aquí, una hoja de olivo recién arrancada estaba en su boca. Entonces Noé supo que las aguas habían menguado de sobre la tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: And the dove came to him at evening time, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from upon the earth.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the dove came to him at evening time, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from upon the earth.

rows.spanish: Y aconteció en el año seiscientos uno, en el primer mes, el primer día del mes, que las aguas se habían secado de sobre la tierra. Entonces Noé quitó la cubierta del arca, miró y, he aquí, la superficie del suelo estaba seca.
rows.current_english_pob: And it came about in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the waters had dried up from upon the earth. Then Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and behold, the surface of the ground was dry.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it came about in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the waters had dried up from upon the earth. Then Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and behold, the surface of the ground was dry.

rows.spanish: Y Yahvé olió el aroma agradable, y Yahvé dijo para sí: «No volveré a maldecir el suelo por causa del hombre, porque la intención del corazón del hombre es mala desde su juventud. Y no volveré a destruir a todo ser viviente como lo he hecho».
rows.current_english_pob: And the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, and the LORD said to himself, “I will never again curse the ground because of man, for the intention of man’s heart is evil from his youth. And I will never again strike down every living thing as I have done.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh smelled the pleasing aroma, and Yahweh said in his heart, “I will never again curse the ground because of man, for the inclination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. And I will never again strike down every living thing as I have done.”

rows.spanish: Y en cuanto a mí, he aquí, estoy estableciendo mi alianza con ustedes y con su descendencia después de ustedes.
rows.current_english_pob: And as for me, behold, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your offspring after you.
rows.spanish_base_english: And as for me, behold, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your offspring after you.

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «Canaán está maldito; será para sus hermanos un esclavo de esclavos».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Canaan is cursed; he shall be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Canaan is cursed; he shall be a slave of servants to his brothers.”

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «Bendito sea Yahvé, el Dios de Sem, y que Canaán sea siervo de ellos».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem, and let Canaan be their servant.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem, and let Canaan be his slave.”

rows.spanish: Que Dios ensanche a Jafet, y que él habite en las tiendas de Sem, y que Canaán sea esclavo para ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: May God enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be a servant to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: May God enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be a slave to them.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, estas son las generaciones de los hijos de Noé: Sem, Cam y Jafet. Y les nacieron hijos varones después del diluvio.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.

rows.spanish: Ahora toda la tierra tenía una sola lengua y las mismas palabras.
rows.current_english_pob: The whole earth had one language and the same words.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the whole earth had one language and the same words.

rows.spanish: Yahvé dijo: «He aquí, son un solo pueblo, y todos tienen una sola lengua, y esto es lo que han comenzado a hacer. Y ahora nada de lo que se propongan hacer les será vedado».
rows.current_english_pob: And Yahweh said, "Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they have begun to do. And now nothing that they plan to do will be withheld from them."
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh said, "Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they have begun to do. And now nothing that they plan to do will be withheld from them."

rows.spanish: Vamos, bajemos allí y confundamos su lengua, para que uno no entienda la lengua de su prójimo.
rows.current_english_pob: Come, let us go down there and confuse their language, so that one man will not understand the language of his neighbor.
rows.spanish_base_english: Come, let us go down there and confuse their language, so that one will not understand the language of his neighbor.

rows.spanish: Estas son las generaciones de Taré: Taré engendró a Abram, a Nahor y a Harán; y Harán engendró a Lot.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.

rows.spanish: Sarai era estéril; no tenía ningún hijo.
rows.current_english_pob: Sarai was barren; she had no child.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Sarai was barren; she had no child.

rows.spanish: Taré tomó a Abram, su hijo, a Lot, hijo de Harán y nieto suyo, y a Sarai, su nuera y esposa de Abram; juntos salieron de Ur de los caldeos para ir a la tierra de Canaán. Pero cuando llegaron a Harán, se establecieron allí.
rows.current_english_pob: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his grandson, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of Abram his son, and they set out together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan. But when they came as far as Haran, they settled there.
rows.spanish_base_english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his grandson, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of Abram his son, and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan. They came as far as Haran and settled there.

rows.spanish: Entonces Yahvé dijo a Abram: «Sal de tu tierra, de tu parentela y de la casa de tu padre a la tierra que te mostraré».
rows.current_english_pob: Yahweh said to Abram, “Go out from your land, from your kindred, and from your father’s house to the land that I will show you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Go from your land, from your kindred, and from your father’s house to the land that I will show you.”

rows.spanish: Entonces hubo una hambruna en la tierra, y Abram bajó a Egipto para residir allí temporalmente, porque la hambruna era severa en la tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, because the famine was severe in the land.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, because the famine was severe in the land.

rows.spanish: Y trató bien a Abram por causa de ella, y llegó a tener ovejas y ganado, y asnos machos, y esclavos y esclavas, y asnas y camellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And he treated Abram well because of her, and he came to have sheep and cattle and male donkeys and male servants and female servants and female donkeys and camels.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he treated Abram well because of her, and he came to have sheep and cattle and male donkeys and male slaves and female slaves and female donkeys and camels.

rows.spanish: Abram era muy rico en ganado, plata y oro.
rows.current_english_pob: Abram was very wealthy in livestock, silver, and gold.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Abram was very wealthy in livestock, silver, and gold.

rows.spanish: La tierra no podía sostenerlos mientras vivían juntos, porque sus posesiones eran demasiado grandes para que siguieran viviendo juntos.
rows.current_english_pob: And the land could not support them living together, because their possessions were too great for them to live together.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the land could not support them dwelling together, because their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.

rows.spanish: ¿No está toda la región delante de ti? Sepárate, por favor, de mí. Si a la izquierda, yo iré a la derecha; y si a la derecha, yo iré a la izquierda.
rows.current_english_pob: Is not the whole land before you? Please separate from me. If you go to the left, then I will go to the right; and if you go to the right, then I will go to the left.
rows.spanish_base_english: Is not the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If to the left, then I will go to the right; and if to the right, then I will go to the left.

rows.spanish: Ahora los hombres de Sodoma eran sumamente perversos y pecadores contra Yahvé.
rows.current_english_pob: The men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful against Yahweh.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful against Yahweh.

rows.spanish: Entonces salieron el rey de Sodoma, el rey de Gomorra, el rey de Adma, el rey de Zeboyim y el rey de Bela —es decir, Zoar— y se dispusieron para la batalla contra ellos en el valle de Sidim.
rows.current_english_pob: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out, and they drew up for battle with them in the Valley of Siddim.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out, and they arrayed themselves for battle against them in the Valley of Siddim.

rows.spanish: El valle de Sidim estaba lleno de pozos de betún, y los reyes de Sodoma y de Gomorra huyeron y cayeron allí, mientras el resto huyó a la región montañosa.
rows.current_english_pob: The Valley of Siddim was full of bitumen pits, and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled and fell there, while the rest fled to the hill country.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of bitumen pits, and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled and fell there, while the rest fled to the hill country.

rows.spanish: Él y sus siervos se dividieron contra ellos de noche, los abatieron y los persiguieron hasta Hobá, que está al norte de Damasco.
rows.current_english_pob: By night he and his servants divided themselves against them, struck them down, and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.
rows.spanish_base_english: He and his servants divided themselves against them by night, struck them down, and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.

rows.spanish: Pero Abram dijo: «Señor Yahvé, ¿qué me darás, si yo sigo sin hijos, y el hijo de posesión de mi casa es Eliezer de Damasco?»
rows.current_english_pob: But Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I am going childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
rows.spanish_base_english: But Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I am going childless, and the son of possession of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”

rows.spanish: Entonces Abram dijo: «He aquí, no me has dado descendencia, y he aquí que un hijo de mi casa me heredará.»
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abram said, “Behold, you have given me no offspring, and behold, a son of my household will inherit me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abram said, “Behold, you have given me no offspring, and behold, a son of my household will inherit me.”

rows.spanish: Y he aquí la palabra de Yahvé vino a él, diciendo: «Este no será tu heredero; sino el que saldrá de tu propio cuerpo será tu heredero».
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, the word of the LORD came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir; rather, one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, the word of Yahweh came to him, saying, “This one will not be your heir; rather, one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”

rows.spanish: Entonces lo llevó afuera y dijo: «Por favor, mira hacia los cielos y cuenta las estrellas, si puedes contarlas». Entonces le dijo: «Así será tu descendencia».
rows.current_english_pob: Then he brought him outside and said, “Please look toward the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he brought him outside and said, “Please look toward the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”

rows.spanish: Cuando el sol se estaba poniendo, un sueño profundo cayó sobre Abram. Y he aquí, un gran pavor tenebroso cayó sobre él.
rows.current_english_pob: As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram. And behold, a great dark dread fell upon him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now as the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram. And behold, a great dark dread fell upon him.

rows.spanish: Cuando el sol se había puesto y estaba oscuro, he aquí, un brasero humeante y una antorcha de fuego pasaron entre estos pedazos.
rows.current_english_pob: And when the sun had gone down and it was dark, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when the sun had gone down and it was dark, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

rows.spanish: Sarai, la esposa de Abram, no le había dado ningún hijo, y tenía una esclava egipcia cuyo nombre era Agar.
rows.current_english_pob: Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children, and she had an Egyptian servant woman whose name was Hagar.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children, and she had an Egyptian slave woman whose name was Hagar.

rows.spanish: Entonces Sarai dijo a Abram: «Mira ahora, Yahvé me ha impedido dar a luz. Por favor, llégate a mi esclava; quizá seré edificada por medio de ella». Y Abram escuchó la voz de Sarai.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, Yahweh has kept me from bearing children. Please go in to my female servant; perhaps I will be built up through her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, Yahweh has kept me from bearing children. Please go in to my female slave; perhaps I will be built up through her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

rows.spanish: Entonces Sarai, esposa de Abram, tomó a Agar la egipcia, su esclava, después de que Abram había vivido diez años en la tierra de Canaán, y se la dio a Abram, su esposo, como esposa.
rows.current_english_pob: So Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her female servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband as a wife.
rows.spanish_base_english: So Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her female slave, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband as a wife.

rows.spanish: Entonces Sarai dijo a Abram: «La injusticia hecha contra mí recae sobre ti. Yo entregué a mi esclava en tus brazos, y cuando vio que había concebido, quedé rebajada a sus ojos. Que Yahvé juzgue entre tú y yo».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Sarai said to Abram, “The wrong done to me is on you. I gave my female servant into your embrace, and when she saw that she had conceived, I became contemptible in her eyes. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Sarai said to Abram, “The wrong done to me is on you. I gave my female slave into your embrace, and when she saw that she had conceived, I became contemptible in her eyes. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Abram dijo a Sarai: «Mira, tu esclava está en tu mano; haz con ella lo que bien te parezca». Entonces Sarai la afligió, y ella huyó de su presencia.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abram said to Sarai, “Look, your female servant is in your hand; do to her what is good in your eyes.” Then Sarai afflicted her, and she fled from her presence.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abram said to Sarai, “Look, your female slave is in your hand; do to her what is good in your eyes.” Then Sarai afflicted her, and she fled from her presence.

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «Hagar, esclava de Sarai, ¿de dónde has venido y adónde vas?» Y ella dijo: «Estoy huyendo de la presencia de Sarai, mi señora».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant woman, where have you come from, and where are you going?” And she said, “I am fleeing from the presence of Sarai my mistress.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Hagar, Sarai’s slave woman, where have you come from, and where are you going?” And she said, “I am fleeing from the presence of Sarai my mistress.”

rows.spanish: Entonces el ángel de Yahvé le dijo: «Ciertamente multiplicaré tu descendencia, de modo que no podrá ser contada por su multitud».
rows.current_english_pob: Then the angel of Yahweh said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, so that it cannot be counted because of its multitude.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then the angel of Yahweh said to her, “I will surely multiply your offspring so greatly that it cannot be counted because of its multitude.”

rows.spanish: Por eso se llamó al pozo Beer-lahai-roi. He aquí, está entre Cades y Bered.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi. Look, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

rows.spanish: En cuanto a mí, he aquí, mi alianza es contigo, y llegarás a ser padre de una multitud de naciones.
rows.current_english_pob: As for me, behold, my covenant is with you, and you will become the father of a multitude of nations.
rows.spanish_base_english: As for me, behold, my covenant is with you, and you will become the father of a multitude of nations.

rows.spanish: A los ocho días de edad será circuncidado todo varón entre ustedes a lo largo de sus generaciones, tanto el nacido en la casa como el comprado con plata de cualquier extranjero que no sea de su descendencia.
rows.current_english_pob: And at eight days old, every male among you throughout your generations shall be circumcised—whether born in the house or bought with silver from any foreigner who is not from your offspring.
rows.spanish_base_english: And every male among you who is eight days old shall be circumcised throughout your generations, whether born in the house or bought with silver from any son of a foreigner who is not of your offspring.

rows.spanish: Y en cuanto a Ismael, te he oído. He aquí, lo he bendecido, y lo haré fecundo, y lo multiplicaré en gran manera. Él engendrará doce príncipes, y haré de él una gran nación.
rows.current_english_pob: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Look, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.
rows.spanish_base_english: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.

rows.spanish: Alzó sus ojos y miró, y he aquí, tres hombres estaban de pie cerca de él. Cuando los vio, corrió desde la entrada de la tienda a su encuentro y se postró hasta el suelo.
rows.current_english_pob: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing near him. When he saw them, he ran from the entrance of the tent to meet them and bowed down to the ground.
rows.spanish_base_english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing near him. When he saw them, he ran from the entrance of the tent to meet them and bowed down to the ground.

rows.spanish: Y él dijo: «Sin duda volveré a ti por este tiempo el año que viene, y he aquí que Sara, tu esposa, tendrá un hijo». Y Sara estaba escuchando a la entrada de la tienda, detrás de él.
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “I will surely return to you about this time next year, and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” And Sarah was listening at the entrance of the tent behind him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “I will surely return to you about this time next year, and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” And Sarah was listening at the entrance of the tent behind him.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Abraham y Sara eran ancianos, avanzados en días; había cesado para Sara el camino de las mujeres.
rows.current_english_pob: Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days; the way of women had ceased to be with Sarah.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days; the way of women had ceased to be with Sarah.

rows.spanish: Y Yahvé dijo a Abraham: «¿Por qué se rió Sara, diciendo: “¿Acaso de veras daré a luz, ya que soy anciana?”»
rows.current_english_pob: And the LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, now that I am old?’”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Shall I indeed bear a child, now that I am old?’”

rows.spanish: Entonces Abraham respondió: «He aquí, te ruego, me he atrevido a hablar a mi Señor, aunque soy polvo y ceniza».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abraham answered and said, “Behold, please, I have dared to speak to my Lord, though I am dust and ashes.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abraham answered and said, “Behold, please, I have undertaken to speak to my Lord, though I am dust and ashes.”

rows.spanish: Habló otra vez a él y dijo: «Quizá se encuentren allí cuarenta». Y dijo: «No lo haré por causa de los cuarenta»
rows.current_english_pob: He spoke to him again and said, “Perhaps forty will be found there.” And he said, “I will not do it for the sake of the forty.”
rows.spanish_base_english: He spoke to him again and said, “Perhaps forty will be found there.” And he said, “I will not do it for the sake of the forty.”

rows.spanish: Entonces dijo: «Mira ahora, me he atrevido a hablar con mi Señor. Quizá se encuentren allí veinte». Y dijo: «No la destruiré por causa de los veinte».
rows.current_english_pob: Then he said, “See now, I have undertaken to speak to my Lord. Perhaps twenty will be found there.” And he said, “I will not destroy it for the sake of the twenty.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he said, “See now, I have undertaken to speak to my Lord. Perhaps twenty will be found there.” And he said, “I will not destroy it for the sake of the twenty.”

rows.spanish: Entonces dijo: «Por favor, no se enoje, mi señor, y hablaré solo una vez más. Quizá se encuentren allí diez». Y dijo: «No la destruiré por causa de los diez».
rows.current_english_pob: Then he said, “Please, let not my lord be angry, and I will speak only this once more. Perhaps ten will be found there.” And he said, “I will not destroy it for the sake of the ten.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he said, “Please, let not my lord be angry, and I will speak only this once more. Perhaps ten will be found there.” And he said, “I will not destroy it for the sake of the ten.”

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «Por favor, mis hermanos, no obren mal».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Please, my brothers, do not do evil.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Please, my brothers, do not act wickedly.”

rows.spanish: Y dijeron: «¡Hazte a un lado!». Luego dijeron: «Este vino a residir como extranjero, y ahora se pone a juzgar. Ahora te haremos más daño que a ellos». Y presionaron con fuerza contra el hombre, contra Lot, y se acercaron para romper la puerta.
rows.current_english_pob: And they said, “Get back!” Then they said, “This one came to live as a foreigner, and now he keeps acting as judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed very hard against the man, against Lot, and came near to break down the door.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This fellow came to sojourn, and now he acts as judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed hard against the man, against Lot, and came near to break down the door.

rows.spanish: Y le dijo: «Mira, te he concedido este favor también en este asunto; no arrasaré la ciudad de la cual has hablado».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said to him, “Look, I grant you this request also: I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said to him, “Look, I have granted you this favor also: I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.”

rows.spanish: Y miró sobre Sodoma y Gomorra y sobre toda la tierra del llano, y vio, y he aquí, subía humo de la tierra como el humo de un horno.
rows.current_english_pob: And he looked out over Sodom and Gomorrah and over all the land of the plain, and he saw, and behold, smoke was rising from the land like the smoke of a furnace.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he looked out over Sodom and Gomorrah and over all the land of the plain, and he saw, and behold, smoke was rising from the land like the smoke of a furnace.

rows.spanish: Ahora Abimelec no se había acercado a ella, y dijo: «Señor, ¿acaso matarás aun a una nación justa?»
rows.current_english_pob: Abimelech had not come near her, so he said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Abimelech had not come near her, so he said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?”

rows.spanish: ¿No fue él mismo quien me dijo: «Ella es mi hermana»? Y ella misma también dijo: «Él es mi hermano». Con integridad de mi corazón y con inocencia de mis manos he hecho esto.
rows.current_english_pob: Did he not himself say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself also said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.
rows.spanish_base_english: Did he not himself say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself also said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, devuelve la esposa del hombre, porque es profeta, y orará por ti, y vivirás. Pero si no la devuelves, sabe que ciertamente morirás: tú y todos los que son tuyos.
rows.current_english_pob: Now then, return the man's wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. But if you do not return her, know that you will surely die—you and all who are yours.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now then, return the man's wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. But if you do not return her, know that you will surely die—you and all who are yours.

rows.spanish: Y cuando Dios me hizo vagar desde la casa de mi padre, le dije: «Esta es la bondad que debes mostrarme: en todo lugar adonde lleguemos, di de mí: “Él es mi hermano”».
rows.current_english_pob: And when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is the kindness you must show me: at every place we come to, say of me, “He is my brother.”’
rows.spanish_base_english: And when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is the kindness you shall show me: at every place to which we come, say of me, “He is my brother.”’

rows.spanish: Entonces Abimelec tomó ovejas y ganado, y esclavos y esclavas, y se los dio a Abraham; y le devolvió a Sara, su esposa.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abimelech took sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham; and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abimelech took sheep and cattle, and male slaves and female slaves, and gave them to Abraham; and he returned Sarah his wife to him.

rows.spanish: Y Abimelec dijo: «Mira, mi tierra está delante de ti; instálate donde mejor te parezca».
rows.current_english_pob: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you; settle wherever seems good in your eyes.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you; dwell where it is good in your eyes.”

rows.spanish: Yahvé visitó a Sara, como había dicho, y Yahvé hizo con Sara como había hablado.
rows.current_english_pob: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did for Sarah as he had spoken.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did for Sarah as he had spoken.

rows.spanish: Entonces le dijo a Abraham: «Expulsa a esta esclava y a su hijo, porque el hijo de esta esclava no heredará con mi hijo Isaac».
rows.current_english_pob: So she said to Abraham, “Drive out this servant woman and her son, for the son of this servant woman will not inherit with my son Isaac.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So she said to Abraham, “Drive out this slave woman and her son, for the son of this slave woman will not inherit with my son Isaac.”

rows.spanish: Pero Dios dijo a Abraham: «No te parezca mal por causa del muchacho y por causa de tu esclava. Todo lo que Sara te diga, escucha su voz, porque en Isaac tu descendencia será llamada».
rows.current_english_pob: But God said to Abraham, “Do not let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy and because of your servant woman. Whatever Sarah says to you, listen to her voice, for through Isaac your offspring will be called.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But God said to Abraham, “Do not let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy and because of your slave woman. Whatever Sarah says to you, listen to her voice, for through Isaac your offspring will be called.”

rows.spanish: Y también haré del hijo de la esclava una nación, porque él es tu descendencia.
rows.current_english_pob: And I will also make the son of the servant woman into a nation, because he is your offspring.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I will also make the son of the slave woman into a nation, because he is your offspring.

rows.spanish: Ahora, júrame aquí por Dios que no obrarás con falsedad conmigo, ni con mis hijos ni con mis descendientes. Según la bondad que te he mostrado, así la mostrarás conmigo y con la tierra donde has vivido como extranjero.
rows.current_english_pob: Swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, or with my children, or with my descendants. According to the kindness that I have shown to you, you shall show to me and to the land where you have lived as a foreigner.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, or with my offspring, or with my posterity. According to the kindness that I have shown to you, you shall show to me and to the land where you have lived as a foreigner.

rows.spanish: Entonces Abraham reprendió a Abimelec acerca del pozo de agua que los siervos de Abimelec habían arrebatado.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abraham reproved Abimelech about the well of water that Abimelech’s servants had seized.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abraham reproved Abimelech concerning the well of water that Abimelech’s servants had seized.

rows.spanish: Y Abimelec dijo: «Yo no sabía quién había hecho esto. Tú tampoco me lo dijiste, y yo mismo no había oído de ello hasta hoy».
rows.current_english_pob: And Abimelech said, “I did not know who had done this thing. You also did not tell me, and I myself had not heard of it until today.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Abimelech said, “I do not know who did this thing. You did not tell me either, and I did not hear of it until today.”

rows.spanish: Y él dijo: «Tomarás estas siete corderas de mi mano, para que sean un testimonio para mí de que cavé este pozo».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “You are to take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, so that it may serve as a witness for me that I dug this well.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “You are to take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, so that they may be a witness for me that I dug this well.”

rows.spanish: Y dijo Isaac a Abraham, su padre: «¡Padre mío!». Y él dijo: «Aquí estoy, hijo mío». Y él dijo: «Mira, el fuego y la leña; pero ¿dónde está la oveja para el holocausto?».
rows.current_english_pob: And Isaac said to Abraham his father, “My father!” And he said, “Here I am, my son.” And he said, “Look, the fire and the wood—but where is the sheep for a burnt offering?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Isaac said to Abraham his father, “My father!” And he said, “Here I am, my son.” And he said, “Look, the fire and the wood—but where is the sheep for a burnt offering?”

rows.spanish: Pero el ángel de Yahvé llamó a Abraham desde el cielo y dijo: «¡Abraham, Abraham!». Y él dijo: «Aquí estoy».
rows.current_english_pob: But the angel of Yahweh called to him from heaven and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” And he said, “Here I am.”
rows.spanish_base_english: But the angel of Yahweh called to him from heaven and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” And he said, “Here I am.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Abraham alzó los ojos y miró, y he aquí, detrás de él, un carnero atrapado en el matorral por sus cuernos. Abraham fue, tomó el carnero y lo ofreció en holocausto en lugar de su hijo.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by its horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering instead of his son.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by its horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering instead of his son.

rows.spanish: Y Abraham llamó a aquel lugar «Yahvé proveerá», como se dice hasta hoy: «En el monte de Yahvé será provisto».
rows.current_english_pob: And Abraham called the name of that place, “The LORD will provide,” as it is said to this day, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Abraham called the name of that place, “Yahweh will see,” as it is said to this day, “On the mountain of Yahweh it will be seen.”

rows.spanish: Ahora, después de estas cosas, se informó a Abraham, diciendo: «He aquí, Milca también ha dado a luz hijos varones a tu hermano Nacor».
rows.current_english_pob: After these things, it was reported to Abraham, saying, “Look, Milcah also has borne sons to your brother Nahor:”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after these things, it was reported to Abraham, saying, “Behold, Milcah also has borne sons to your brother Nahor:”

rows.spanish: Sara vivió ciento veintisiete años; estos fueron los años de la vida de Sara.
rows.current_english_pob: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years; these were the years of Sarah’s life.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the life of Sarah was one hundred twenty-seven years; these were the years of Sarah’s life.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Ephrón estaba sentado entre los hijos de Het, y Ephrón el hitita respondió a Abraham a oídos de los hijos de Het, delante de todos los que entraban por la puerta de su ciudad, diciendo,
rows.current_english_pob: Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth, and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the sons of Heth, before all who entered the gate of his city, saying,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth, and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the sons of Heth, before all who entered the gate of his city, saying,

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Abraham era viejo, de edad avanzada, y Yahvé había bendecido a Abraham en todo.
rows.current_english_pob: Abraham was old, advanced in years, and Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Abraham was old, advanced in years, and Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

rows.spanish: Y sea que la joven a quien yo diga: “Te ruego, inclina tu cántaro para que yo beba”, y que responda: “Bebe, y también daré de beber a tus camellos”, sea la que has designado para tu siervo, para Isaac. Por esto sabré que has mostrado tu amor leal a mi señor.
rows.current_english_pob: And let it be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Please lower your jar so that I may drink,’ and who says, ‘Drink, and I will also water your camels’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant, for Isaac. By her I will know that you have shown steadfast love to my master.
rows.spanish_base_english: And let it be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Please lower your jar so that I may drink,’ and who says, ‘Drink, and I will also water your camels’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown steadfast love to my master.

rows.spanish: Y aconteció, antes de que terminara de hablar, y he aquí, Rebeca salía, la que le había nacido a Betuel, hijo de Milca, esposa de Nacor, hermano de Abraham, con su cántaro sobre su hombro.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah was coming out—she who had been born to Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother—with her jar on her shoulder.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah was coming out—she who had been born to Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother—with her jar on her shoulder.

rows.spanish: La joven era muy hermosa de aspecto, virgen; ningún hombre la había conocido. Ella descendió a la fuente, llenó su cántaro y subió.
rows.current_english_pob: The young woman was very beautiful in appearance, a virgin; no man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the young woman was very beautiful in appearance, a virgin; no man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up.

rows.spanish: Ahora Rebeca tenía un hermano, y su nombre era Labán; y Labán corrió afuera hacia el hombre, junto al manantial.
rows.current_english_pob: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban; and Laban ran out to the man, outside by the spring.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban; and Laban ran out to the man, outside by the spring.

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, cuando vio el anillo de la nariz y los brazaletes sobre las manos de su hermana, y cuando oyó las palabras de Rebeca, su hermana: «Así me habló el hombre», fue al hombre. Y he aquí que él estaba de pie junto a los camellos, al lado del manantial.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened, when he saw the nose ring and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” that he went to the man. And behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened, when he saw the nose ring and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” that he went to the man. And behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

rows.spanish: Le pusieron comida delante de él para comer, pero dijo: «No comeré hasta haber hablado mis palabras». Y dijo: «Habla».
rows.current_english_pob: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have spoken my words.” And he said, “Speak.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have spoken my words.” And he said, “Speak.”

rows.spanish: Antes de que terminara de hablar en mi corazón, he aquí que Rebeca salió con su cántaro sobre su hombro, y descendió al manantial y sacó agua. Entonces le dije: «Por favor, dame de beber».
rows.current_english_pob: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. Then I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
rows.spanish_base_english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. Then I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’

rows.spanish: Entonces me incliné y me postré ante Yahvé, y bendije a Yahvé, Dios de mi amo Abraham, que me condujo por el camino recto para tomar a la hija del hermano de mi amo para su hijo.
rows.current_english_pob: Then I bowed down and worshiped Yahweh, and I blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the true way to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then I bowed down and worshiped Yahweh, and I blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the right way to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.

rows.spanish: Ahora, si ustedes muestran bondad y fidelidad hacia mi señor, háganmelo saber; pero si no, háganmelo saber, para que me vuelva a la derecha o a la izquierda.
rows.current_english_pob: Now if you are going to show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, tell me, so that I may turn to the right or to the left.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right or to the left.

rows.spanish: Entonces Rebeca y sus jóvenes se levantaron, montaron en los camellos y fueron tras el hombre. Y el siervo tomó a Rebeca y se fue.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Rebekah and her young women arose, mounted the camels, and went after the man. And the servant took Rebekah and went on his way.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Rebekah and her young women arose, mounted the camels, and went after the man. And the servant took Rebekah and went.

rows.spanish: Isaac había venido de Beer-lahai-roi, y habitaba en la tierra del Neguev.
rows.current_english_pob: Isaac had come from Beer-lahai-roi, and he was dwelling in the land of the Negev.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Isaac had come from Beer-lahai-roi, and he was dwelling in the land of the Negev.

rows.spanish: Y salió Isaac a meditar en el campo al atardecer; alzó sus ojos y miró, y he aquí que venían camellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening, and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, camels were coming.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening, and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, camels were coming.

rows.spanish: Y ella dijo al siervo: «¿Quién es este hombre que camina en el campo a nuestro encuentro?» Y el siervo dijo: «Él es mi amo». Entonces tomó el velo y se cubrió.
rows.current_english_pob: And she said to the servant, “Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?” And the servant said, “He is my master.” Then she took the veil and covered herself.
rows.spanish_base_english: And she said to the servant, “Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?” And the servant said, “He is my master.” Then she took the veil and covered herself.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, estas son las generaciones de Ismael, hijo de Abraham, a quien Hagar la egipcia, esclava de Sara, dio a luz a Abraham.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant woman, bore to Abraham.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s slave woman, bore to Abraham.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, estas son las generaciones de Isaac, hijo de Abraham: Abraham engendró a Isaac.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the generations of Isaac, son of Abraham: Abraham fathered Isaac.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the generations of Isaac, son of Abraham: Abraham fathered Isaac.

rows.spanish: Cuando se cumplieron sus días para dar a luz, he aquí que había gemelos en su vientre.
rows.current_english_pob: When her days to give birth were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
rows.spanish_base_english: When her days to give birth were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

rows.spanish: Isaac amó a Esaú porque la caza estaba en su boca, pero Rebeca amó a Jacob.
rows.current_english_pob: Isaac loved Esau because game was in his mouth, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Isaac loved Esau because game was in his mouth, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Jacob estaba cocinando un guiso, y Esaú vino del campo, y estaba agotado.
rows.current_english_pob: Jacob was cooking a stew, and Esau came in from the field, and he was exhausted.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jacob was cooking a stew, and Esau came in from the field, and he was exhausted.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, hubo hambre en la tierra, además de la primera hambruna que hubo en los días de Abraham. Así que Isaac fue a Abimelec, rey de los filisteos, en Gerar.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that had been in the days of Abraham. So Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that had been in the days of Abraham. So Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar.

rows.spanish: Y aconteció cuando ya llevaba mucho tiempo allí, que Abimélec, rey de los filisteos, se asomó por la ventana y vio, y he aquí que Isaac estaba jugueteando con Rebeca su esposa.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out through the window and saw, and behold, Isaac was laughing with Rebekah his wife.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out through the window and saw, and behold, Isaac was laughing with Rebekah his wife.

rows.spanish: Ahora, todos los pozos que habían cavado los siervos de su padre en los días de Abraham su padre, los filisteos los taparon y los llenaron de tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: All the wells that his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines stopped up and filled them with earth.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now all the wells that his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines stopped up and filled them with earth.

rows.spanish: Entonces Abimelec dijo a Isaac: «Vete de entre nosotros, porque te has hecho mucho más fuerte que nosotros».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, because you have become much stronger than we are.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you have become much mightier than we.”

rows.spanish: Y madrugaron por la mañana y hicieron juramento el uno al otro; entonces Isaac los despidió, y se fueron de su presencia en paz.
rows.current_english_pob: And they rose early in the morning and swore an oath, each man to his brother; then Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they rose early in the morning and swore to one another; then Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, cuando Isaac era anciano y sus ojos estaban demasiado nublados para ver, llamó a Esaú, su hijo mayor, y le dijo: «Hijo mío». Y él le respondió: «Aquí estoy».
rows.current_english_pob: It happened that when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim to see, he called Esau his older son and said to him, “My son,” and he said to him, “Here I am.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim to see, he called Esau his older son and said to him, “My son,” and he said to him, “Here I am.”

rows.spanish: Y él dijo: «Mira ahora, he envejecido; no sé el día de mi muerte».
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Look now, I have grown old; I do not know the day of my death.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Behold now, I have grown old; I do not know the day of my death.”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, toma, por favor, tu equipo—tu aljaba y tu arco—y sal al campo y cázame algo de caza.
rows.current_english_pob: Now then, please take your equipment—your quiver and your bow—and go out to the field and hunt game for me.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now then, please take your equipment—your quiver and your bow—and go out to the field and hunt game for me.

rows.spanish: Y Rebeca estaba escuchando mientras Isaac hablaba a Esaú su hijo, y Esaú fue al campo para cazar caza y traerla de vuelta.
rows.current_english_pob: Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son, and Esau went to the field to hunt game and bring it back.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son, and Esau went to the field to hunt game and bring it back.

rows.spanish: Entonces Isaac dijo a su hijo: «¿Cómo es que encontraste tan pronto, hijo mío?» Y él dijo: «Porque Yahvé tu Dios hizo que ocurriera delante de mí».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you found it so quickly, my son?” And he said, “Because Yahweh your God caused it to happen before me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you found it so quickly, my son?” And he said, “Because Yahweh your God caused it to happen before me.”

rows.spanish: Él dijo: «¿De veras eres tú mi hijo Esaú?» Y él dijo: «Soy yo».
rows.current_english_pob: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” And he said, “I am.”
rows.spanish_base_english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” And he said, “I am.”

rows.spanish: Que Dios te dé del rocío del cielo, y de la riqueza de la tierra, y abundancia de grano y vino nuevo.
rows.current_english_pob: May God give you some of the dew of heaven, and some of the richness of the earth, and an abundance of grain and new wine.
rows.spanish_base_english: May God give you of the dew of heaven, and of the richness of the earth, and abundance of grain and new wine.

rows.spanish: Su padre Isaac le dijo: «¿Quién eres?» Y él dijo: «Yo soy tu hijo, tu primogénito, Esaú».
rows.current_english_pob: His father Isaac said to him, “Who are you?” And he said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
rows.spanish_base_english: His father Isaac said to him, “Who are you?” And he said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Isaac se estremeció con un estremecimiento muy grande, en gran manera, y dijo: «¿Quién, pues, fue el que cazó algo de caza, me lo trajo, y yo comí de todo ello antes de que tú vinieras, y lo bendije? Sí, y bendito será».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Isaac trembled with a very great trembling and said, “Who then was it who hunted game and brought it to me, and I ate from all of it before you came and blessed him? Yes, and he will be blessed.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Isaac trembled with a very great trembling and said, “Who then was it who hunted game and brought it to me, and I ate from all of it before you came and I blessed him? Yes, and he will be blessed.”

rows.spanish: Y dijo: «¿Acaso no fue llamado Jacob con razón? Porque me ha suplantado dos veces: tomó mi primogenitura, y he aquí, ahora ha tomado mi bendición». Y dijo: «¿No has reservado una bendición para mí?»
rows.current_english_pob: And he said, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times: he took my birthright, and look, now he has taken my blessing.” And he said, “Have you not reserved a blessing for me?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he said, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times: he took my birthright, and behold, now he has taken my blessing.” And he said, “Have you not reserved a blessing for me?”

rows.spanish: Entonces su padre Isaac respondió y le dijo: «He aquí, tu morada será de la riqueza de la tierra y del rocío del cielo arriba».
rows.current_english_pob: Then his father Isaac answered and said to him, “Behold, your dwelling shall be away from the richness of the earth, and away from the dew of heaven above.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then his father Isaac answered and said to him, “Behold, your dwelling shall be from the richness of the earth, and from the dew of heaven above.”

rows.spanish: Cuando informaron a Rebeca de las palabras de Esaú, su hijo mayor, ella mandó llamar a Jacob, su hijo menor, y le dijo: «Mira, tu hermano Esaú se consuela planeando matarte».
rows.current_english_pob: And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Look, Esau your brother is consoling himself about you by planning to kill you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Look, Esau your brother is comforting himself concerning you, to kill you.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Esaú vio que Isaac había bendecido a Jacob y lo había enviado a Padán-aram para tomar de allí una mujer para sí, y que, cuando lo bendijo, le mandó, diciendo: «No tomarás mujer de las hijas de Canaán».
rows.current_english_pob: Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife for himself from there, and that when he blessed him, he commanded him, saying, “You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife for himself from there, and that when he blessed him, he commanded him, saying, “You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.”

rows.spanish: Y soñó, y he aquí una escalera estaba puesta sobre la tierra, y su parte superior llegaba al cielo; y he aquí los ángeles de Dios subían y bajaban por ella.
rows.current_english_pob: And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and its top reached to heaven; and behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and its top reached to heaven; and behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí Yahvé estaba de pie sobre ella, y dijo: «Yo soy Yahvé, el Dios de tu padre Abraham y el Dios de Isaac. La tierra sobre la que estás acostado te la daré a ti y a tu descendencia».
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, Yahweh was standing above it, and he said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. The land on which you are lying I will give to you and to your offspring.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, Yahweh was standing above it, and he said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. The land on which you are lying I will give to you and to your offspring.”

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, yo estoy contigo, y te guardaré en todo lugar adonde vayas, y te haré volver a esta tierra. Porque no te dejaré hasta que haya hecho lo que te he dicho.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, I am with you, and I will keep you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have spoken to you.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, I am with you, and I will keep you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have spoken to you.

rows.spanish: Entonces Jacob se puso en camino y fue a la tierra de los hijos del oriente.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Jacob set out and went to the land of the sons of the east.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Jacob lifted up his feet and went to the land of the sons of the east.

rows.spanish: Él miró, y he aquí, había un pozo en el campo, y he aquí, allí había tres rebaños de ovejas recostados junto a él, porque de ese pozo abrevaban los rebaños. Y la piedra sobre la boca del pozo era grande.
rows.current_english_pob: He looked, and behold, there was a well in the field, and behold, three flocks of sheep were lying there beside it, because from that well they watered the flocks. And the stone on the mouth of the well was large.
