rows.spanish: solo respecto de alimentos y bebidas y diversos lavamientos, regulaciones para el cuerpo impuestas hasta el tiempo de la rectificación.
rows.current_english_pob: concerned only with foods and drinks and various washings, fleshly regulations imposed until the time of reformation.
rows.spanish_base_english: concerned only with foods and drinks and various washings, regulations for the flesh imposed until the time of reformation.

rows.spanish: Porque si la sangre de machos cabríos y de toros, y las cenizas de una novilla, rociando a los que se han vuelto impuros, santifican para la purificación de la carne,
rows.current_english_pob: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer that sprinkle those who have been defiled, sanctify for the purification of the flesh,
rows.spanish_base_english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify for the purification of the flesh,

rows.spanish: Porque donde hay un pacto, es necesario que la muerte del que lo hizo sea presentada.
rows.current_english_pob: For where there is a covenant, it is necessary for the death of the one who made it to be brought forward.
rows.spanish_base_english: For where there is a covenant, it is necessary for the death of the one who made it to be brought forward.

rows.spanish: De otro modo, ¿no habrían dejado de ofrecerse, ya que los adoradores, una vez purificados, ya no tendrían conciencia de pecados?
rows.current_english_pob: Otherwise, would they not have stopped being offered, because those who worship, having once been cleansed, would no longer have any consciousness of sins?
rows.spanish_base_english: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, since the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have any consciousness of sins?

rows.spanish: Entonces dijo: «He aquí, he venido para hacer tu voluntad». Quita lo primero para establecer lo segundo.
rows.current_english_pob: Then he said, ‘Behold, I have come to do your will.’ He takes away the first so that he may establish the second.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he said, ‘Behold, I have come to do your will.’ He takes away the first so that he may establish the second.

rows.spanish: Por esa voluntad hemos sido santificados mediante la ofrenda del cuerpo de Jesús el Mesías una vez para siempre.
rows.current_english_pob: By that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus the Messiah once for all.
rows.spanish_base_english: By that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Messiah once for all.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, donde hay perdón de estas, ya no hay ofrenda por el pecado.
rows.current_english_pob: Where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer any offering for sin.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer any offering for sin.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, hermanos, puesto que tenemos confianza para entrar en los lugares santos por la sangre de Jesús,
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, brothers, since we have boldness to enter the holy places by the blood of Jesus,
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore, brothers, since we have boldness for entry into the holy places by the blood of Jesus,

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, la fe es la certeza de lo que se espera, la prueba de lo que no se ve.
rows.current_english_pob: Faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the proof of things not seen.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the proof of things not seen.

rows.spanish: Y sin fe es imposible agradarle, porque es necesario que el que se acerca a Dios crea que él existe, y que es recompensador de los que lo buscan con diligencia.
rows.current_english_pob: And without faith it is impossible to please him, for the one who comes to God must believe that he exists and that he is a rewarder of those who diligently seek him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And without faith it is impossible to please him, for the one who comes to God must believe that he exists and that he is a rewarder of those who diligently seek him.

rows.spanish: Por la fe, Abraham, cuando era probado, ofreció a Isaac, y el que había recibido las promesas ofreció a su hijo único,
rows.current_english_pob: By faith Abraham, when he was being tested, offered up Isaac, and the one who had received the promises was offering up his one and only son,
rows.spanish_base_english: By faith Abraham, when he was being tested, offered up Isaac, and the one who had received the promises offered up his only son,

rows.spanish: Por la fe, Isaac bendijo a Jacob y a Esaú con respecto al futuro.
rows.current_english_pob: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
rows.spanish_base_english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

rows.spanish: Por la fe, José, cuando estaba muriendo, mencionó el éxodo de los hijos de Israel y dio instrucciones acerca de sus huesos.
rows.current_english_pob: By faith Joseph, as he was nearing the end of his life, mentioned the exodus of the sons of Israel and gave instructions concerning his bones.
rows.spanish_base_english: By faith Joseph, when he was dying, mentioned the exodus of the sons of Israel and gave instructions concerning his bones.

rows.spanish: eligiendo más bien ser maltratado con el pueblo de Dios que tener el disfrute pasajero del pecado,
rows.current_english_pob: choosing rather to be mistreated with the people of God than to have the temporary enjoyment of sin,
rows.spanish_base_english: choosing rather to be mistreated with the people of God than to have the fleeting enjoyment of sin,

rows.spanish: Pero si ustedes están sin disciplina, de la cual todos han llegado a ser partícipes, entonces son hijos ilegítimos y no hijos legítimos.
rows.current_english_pob: But if you are without discipline, of which all have become sharers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
rows.spanish_base_english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, toda disciplina, por el momento, no parece ser de alegría, sino de tristeza; pero después da el fruto pacífico de rectitud a los que han sido ejercitados por ella.
rows.current_english_pob: All discipline seems for the present to be not joy but sorrow; yet later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now all discipline seems for the present to be not joy but sorrow; yet later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

rows.spanish: que no haya nadie sexualmente inmoral ni profano, como Esaú, que por una sola comida vendió sus propios derechos de primogenitura.
rows.current_english_pob: that no one be sexually immoral or godless like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.
rows.spanish_base_english: that no one be sexually immoral or profane like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.

rows.spanish: y a la asamblea de los primogénitos inscritos en los cielos, y a Dios, el juez de todos, y a los espíritus de los justos hechos perfectos,
rows.current_english_pob: and to the assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in the heavens, and to God, the judge of all, and to the spirits of righteous people made perfect,
rows.spanish_base_english: and to the assembly of the firstborn enrolled in heaven, and to God, the judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

rows.spanish: Ahora esta frase, «Aún una vez más», indica la remoción de las cosas que son sacudidas —es decir, cosas que han sido hechas— para que permanezcan las cosas que no son sacudidas.
rows.current_english_pob: This phrase, “Yet once more,” indicates the removal of the things being shaken—as things that have been made—so that the things not being shaken may remain.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now this phrase, “Yet once more,” indicates the removal of the things being shaken—that is, things that have been made—so that the things not being shaken may remain.

rows.spanish: Jesús Mesías es el mismo ayer y hoy y para siempre.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus the Messiah is the same yesterday and today and forever.
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus Messiah is the same yesterday and today and forever.

rows.spanish: Oren por nosotros, porque estamos convencidos de que tenemos una buena conciencia, pues queremos conducirnos bien en todo.
rows.current_english_pob: Pray for us, for we are convinced that we have a good conscience, since we want to conduct ourselves well in everything.
rows.spanish_base_english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to conduct ourselves well in all things.

rows.spanish: Y ahora, que el Dios de paz, que hizo subir de entre los muertos a nuestro Señor Jesús, el gran pastor de las ovejas, por la sangre de un pacto eterno,
rows.current_english_pob: May the God of peace, who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of an eternal covenant,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of an eternal covenant,

rows.spanish: Que él los capacite en todo lo bueno, para que hagan su voluntad, obrando en nosotros lo que es agradable delante de él, por medio de Jesús el Mesías, a él sea la gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
rows.current_english_pob: may he equip you in every good thing to do his will, working in us what is pleasing before him through Jesus the Messiah, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
rows.spanish_base_english: may he equip you in every good thing to do his will, working in us what is pleasing before him through Jesus Messiah, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

rows.spanish: Ahora les ruego, hermanos, que soporten esta palabra de exhortación, porque les he escrito brevemente.
rows.current_english_pob: I urge you, brothers, bear with this word of exhortation, for I have written to you briefly.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now I urge you, brothers, bear with this word of exhortation, for I have written to you briefly.

rows.spanish: Entonces él tocó mi boca y dijo: «He aquí, esto ha tocado tus labios; tu culpa es quitada, y tu pecado es expiado».
rows.current_english_pob: And he touched my mouth and said, “Look, this has touched your lips; your guilt is removed, and your sin is atoned for.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he touched my mouth and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; your guilt is removed, and your sin is atoned for.”

rows.spanish: Entonces dije: «¿Hasta cuándo, Señor?». Y él dijo: «Hasta que las ciudades queden asoladas, sin habitante, y las casas sin gente, y la tierra sea devastada, una desolación».
rows.current_english_pob: Then I said, “Until when, Lord?” And he said, “Until cities lie waste, without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land is laid waste, a desolation.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then I said, “Until when, Lord?” And he said, “Until cities lie waste, without inhabitant, and houses without people, and the land is laid waste, a desolation.”

rows.spanish: Y fue comunicado a la casa de David, diciendo: «Aram se ha aliado con Efraín». Y se estremeció su corazón y el corazón de su pueblo, como se estremecen los árboles del bosque ante el viento.
rows.current_english_pob: And it was reported to the house of David, saying, “Aram has settled on Ephraim.” And his heart and the heart of his people shook, as the trees of the forest shake before the wind.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it was reported to the house of David, saying, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim.” And his heart and the heart of his people shook, as the trees of the forest shake before the wind.

rows.spanish: Porque Aram ha planeado el mal contra ti, junto con Efraín y el hijo de Remalías, diciendo:
rows.current_english_pob: Because Aram has planned evil against you, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, saying,
rows.spanish_base_english: Because Aram, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah have planned evil against you, saying,

rows.spanish: Subamos contra Judá, y aterroricémosla, y abramos brecha en ella para nosotros, y pongamos por rey en medio de ella al hijo de Tabeel.
rows.current_english_pob: Let us go up against Judah, and terrify her, and break her open for ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king in her midst.
rows.spanish_base_english: Let us go up against Judah, and terrorize her, and break through it for ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king in the midst of it.

rows.spanish: Yahvé traerá sobre ti, sobre tu pueblo y sobre la casa de tu padre días como no han venido desde el día en que Efraín se apartó de Judá: el rey de Asiria.
rows.current_english_pob: Yahweh will bring upon you, upon your people, and upon your father's house days unlike any that have not come since the day Ephraim turned away from Judah—namely, the king of Assyria.
rows.spanish_base_english: Yahweh will bring upon you, upon your people, and upon your father's house days unlike any that have come since the day Ephraim turned away from Judah—the king of Assyria.

rows.spanish: Porque este pueblo ha rechazado las aguas de Shiloah que fluyen suavemente, y se regocija por Rezín y el hijo de Remalías.
rows.current_english_pob: Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
rows.spanish_base_english: Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoices in Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

rows.spanish: Por tanto, he aquí, el Señor hace subir contra ellos las aguas del Río, poderosas y muchas—el rey de Asiria y toda su gloria. Y subirá sobre todos sus cauces y pasará sobre todas sus orillas.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, behold, the Lord is bringing up against them the waters of the River, mighty and many—the king of Assyria and all his glory. And it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore, behold, the Lord is bringing up against them the waters of the River, mighty and many—the king of Assyria and all his glory. And it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks.

rows.spanish: Y él será un santuario, pero para las dos casas de Israel será una piedra contra la cual golpear y una roca sobre la cual tropezar, una trampa y un lazo para el habitante de Jerusalén.
rows.current_english_pob: And he will become a sanctuary, but a stone to strike against and a rock to stumble over for both houses of Israel, a trap and a snare to the inhabitant of Jerusalem.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he will become a sanctuary, and a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense to both houses of Israel, a trap and a snare to the inhabitant of Jerusalem.

rows.spanish: He aquí yo y los hijos que Yahvé me ha dado somos para señales y prodigios en Israel, de parte de Yahvé de los Ejércitos, que habita en el monte Sion.
rows.current_english_pob: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells on Mount Zion.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells on Mount Zion.

rows.spanish: Y mirará a la tierra, y he aquí, angustia y oscuridad, la negrura de la aflicción; y la densa oscuridad será apartada.
rows.current_english_pob: And he will look to the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and thick darkness will be driven away.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he will look to the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and thick darkness will be driven away.

rows.spanish: Porque toda bota del guerrero que avanza en el tumulto, y toda vestidura enrollada en sangre, serán para la quema, combustible para el fuego.
rows.current_english_pob: For every boot of the tramping warrior in the battle's tumult, and every garment rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
rows.spanish_base_english: For every boot of the tramping warrior in the tumult, and every garment rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

rows.spanish: Y todo el pueblo sabrá—Efraín y los habitantes de Samaria—, que dicen con soberbia y con grandeza de corazón.
rows.current_english_pob: And all the people will know—Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria—who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
rows.spanish_base_english: And all the people will know—Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria—who say in pride and in greatness of heart,

rows.spanish: Porque la maldad arde como fuego; consume espino y zarza, y enciende los matorrales del bosque, y se arremolinan en una columna de humo.
rows.current_english_pob: For wickedness burns like a fire; it devours brier and thorn, and it kindles the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
rows.spanish_base_english: For wickedness burns like a fire; it devours brier and thorn, and kindles the thickets of the forest, and they swirl upward in a column of smoke.

rows.spanish: ¡Ay de los que decretan decretos de iniquidad, y de los que siguen escribiendo opresión!
rows.current_english_pob: Woe to those who decree decrees of wickedness, and the writers who keep writing oppression,
rows.spanish_base_english: Woe to those who decree decrees of iniquity, and to the writers who keep writing oppression,

rows.spanish: Contra una nación impía lo envío, y contra el pueblo de mi ira le ordeno, para saquear botín y arrebatar despojo, y convertirlo en pisoteo, como el lodo de las calles.
rows.current_english_pob: Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to seize spoil and to carry off plunder, and to make it a trampling place like the mud of the streets.
rows.spanish_base_english: Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to seize spoil and to carry off plunder, and to make them a trampling like the mire of the streets.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, el Señor, Yahvé de los ejércitos, enviará delgadez entre sus gordos, y bajo su gloria se encenderá un ardor, como el ardor del fuego.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send wasting sickness among his stout warriors, and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send leanness among his fat ones, and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

rows.spanish: Y en aquel día el remanente de Israel y los sobrevivientes de la casa de Jacob ya no se apoyarán en el que los hirió, sino que se apoyarán en Yahvé, el Santo de Israel, en verdad.
rows.current_english_pob: And in that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer continue to lean on the one who struck them, but will lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
rows.spanish_base_english: And in that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer lean on the one who struck them, but will lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

rows.spanish: Yahvé de los ejércitos levantará un látigo contra él, como en la matanza de Madián en la peña de Oreb; y su vara estará sobre el mar, y la levantará como en Egipto.
rows.current_english_pob: And Yahweh of hosts will stir up a whip against him, as at the striking down of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it as in the way of Egypt.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh of hosts will stir up a whip against him, as at the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it as in Egypt.

rows.spanish: Él ha llegado a Aiat; ha pasado por Migrón. En Micmas deja su equipaje.
rows.current_english_pob: He has come against Aiath; he has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
rows.spanish_base_english: He has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

rows.spanish: No harán daño ni destruirán en todo mi monte santo, porque la tierra estará llena del conocimiento de Yahvé, como las aguas cubren el mar.
rows.current_english_pob: They will not do harm or bring destruction on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh as the waters cover the sea.
rows.spanish_base_english: They will not do harm or destroy in all my holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh as the waters cover the sea.

rows.spanish: Y en aquel día la raíz de Isaí, que está en pie como estandarte para los pueblos—a él buscarán las naciones—, y su lugar de reposo será glorioso.
rows.current_english_pob: And in that day the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner for the peoples—to him the nations will seek, and his resting place will be glory.
rows.spanish_base_english: And in that day the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner for the peoples—to him the nations will seek, and his resting place will be glorious.

rows.spanish: Ellos se lanzarán sobre el hombro de los filisteos hacia el occidente; juntos saquearán a los hijos del oriente. Edom y Moab estarán bajo la extensión de su mano, y los hijos de Amón les obedecerán.
rows.current_english_pob: They will swoop down on the shoulder of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. Edom and Moab will be the putting forth of their hand, and the sons of Ammon will obey them.
rows.spanish_base_english: They will swoop down on the shoulder of the Philistines toward the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. Edom and Moab will be under the putting forth of their hand, and the sons of Ammon will obey them.

rows.spanish: Y habrá una calzada para el remanente de su pueblo que quede de Asiria, como la hubo para Israel en el día en que subió de la tierra de Egipto.
rows.current_english_pob: And there will be a highway for the remnant of his people that remains from Assyria, as there was for Israel in the day of his coming up from the land of Egypt.
rows.spanish_base_english: And there will be a highway for the remnant of his people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel in the day when he came up from the land of Egypt.

rows.spanish: He aquí, Dios es mi salvación; confiaré y no temeré, porque Yah, Yahvé, es mi fuerza y mi cántico, y ha llegado a ser mi salvación.
rows.current_english_pob: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song, and he has become my salvation.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song, and he has become my salvation.

rows.spanish: ¡He aquí, el día de Yahvé viene, cruel, con ira y furor ardiente, para convertir la tierra en desolación, y destruirá de ella a sus pecadores.
rows.current_english_pob: Behold, the day of Yahweh is coming—cruel, with wrath and fierce anger—to make the land a desolation, and he will destroy its sinners from it.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, the day of Yahweh is coming—cruel, with wrath and fierce anger—to make the land a desolation, and he will destroy its sinners from it.

rows.spanish: Porque las estrellas de los cielos y sus constelaciones no darán su luz; el sol se oscurecerá al salir, y la luna no hará resplandecer su luz.
rows.current_english_pob: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not give their light; the sun is darkened at its rising, and the moon will not make its light shine.
rows.spanish_base_english: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not give their light; the sun will be darkened at its rising, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

rows.spanish: He aquí, yo estoy levantando contra ellos a los medos, que no valoran la plata ni desean el oro.
rows.current_english_pob: Behold, I am stirring up the Medes against them, who do not value silver and do not delight in gold.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, I am stirring up the Medes against them, who do not value silver and do not delight in gold.

rows.spanish: Los pueblos los tomarán y los llevarán a su lugar; y la casa de Israel los poseerá en la tierra de Yahvé como siervos y siervas. Se convertirán en captores de quienes los habían capturado y dominarán sobre sus opresores.
rows.current_english_pob: Peoples will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them on the land of Yahweh as male servants and female servants. They will become captors of their captors, and they will rule over their oppressors.
rows.spanish_base_english: Peoples will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them on the land of Yahweh as male slaves and female slaves. They will take captive those who took them captive, and they will rule over their oppressors.

rows.spanish: el que hizo del mundo un desierto y derribó sus ciudades, el que no abrió la casa a sus prisioneros?
rows.current_english_pob: who made the world like a wilderness and tore down its cities, who did not open the house for his prisoners?
rows.spanish_base_english: who made the world like a wilderness and tore down its cities, who did not let his prisoners go home?

rows.spanish: Este es el propósito que ha sido determinado contra toda la tierra, y esta es la mano que está extendida contra todas las naciones.
rows.current_english_pob: This is the plan that is planned against all the earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out against all the nations.
rows.spanish_base_english: This is the purpose that is purposed against all the earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out against all the nations.

rows.spanish: No te regocijes, toda Filistea, porque se ha roto la vara que te golpeaba; pues de la raíz de la serpiente saldrá una víbora, y su fruto será una serpiente ardiente voladora.
rows.current_english_pob: Do not rejoice, all of you Philistia, because the rod that struck you is broken; for from the root of the serpent will come out a viper, and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent.
rows.spanish_base_english: Do not rejoice, all of you in Philistia, because the rod that struck you is broken; for from the serpent’s root will come forth a viper, and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent.

rows.spanish: Traigan consejo; tomen una decisión. Haz tu sombra como la noche en medio del mediodía; esconde a los desterrados; no reveles al fugitivo.
rows.current_english_pob: Bring counsel; make a decision. Make your shadow like the night in the middle of noon; hide the outcasts; do not betray the fugitive.
rows.spanish_base_english: Bring counsel; make a decision. Make your shadow like the night in the midst of noon; hide the outcasts; do not reveal the fugitive.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, Moab se lamentará por Moab; todo entero se lamentará. Por las tortas de pasas de Kir-hareset gemirán, completamente abatidos.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab; all of it will wail. You will moan for the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth, utterly stricken.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab; all of it will wail. For the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth you will moan, utterly stricken.

rows.spanish: Oráculo sobre Damasco: He aquí, Damasco dejará de ser ciudad, y se convertirá en un montón de ruinas.
rows.current_english_pob: An oracle concerning Damascus: Behold, Damascus will be removed from being a city, and it will become a heap of ruins.
rows.spanish_base_english: An oracle concerning Damascus: Behold, Damascus will be removed from being a city, and it will become a heap of ruins.

rows.spanish: En aquel día sus ciudades fortificadas serán como los lugares abandonados del bosque y la cima del árbol, que abandonaron a causa de los hijos de Israel; y será desolación.
rows.current_english_pob: In that day his fortified cities will be like the deserted places of the forest and the treetop, which they abandoned before the sons of Israel; and it will become a desolation.
rows.spanish_base_english: In that day his fortified cities will be like the deserted places of the forest and the treetop, which they abandoned because of the sons of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

rows.spanish: Porque te has olvidado del Dios de tu salvación, y no te has acordado de la Roca de tu refugio; por tanto, plantas plantas deleitosas y la plantas con una vid extranjera.
rows.current_english_pob: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the Rock of your refuge; therefore you plant pleasant plants and sow it with a foreign vine.
rows.spanish_base_english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the Rock of your refuge; therefore you plant delightful plants and set it with a foreign vine.

rows.spanish: Los pueblos rugen como el rugido de muchas aguas, pero él los reprende, y huyen lejos, perseguidos como tamo sobre los montes ante el viento, y como polvo arremolinado ante la tormenta.
rows.current_english_pob: The peoples roar like the roaring of many waters, but he rebukes it, and it flees far away, chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind, and like whirling dust before the storm.
rows.spanish_base_english: The peoples roar like the roaring of many waters, but he rebukes them, and they flee far away, chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind, and like whirling dust before the storm.

rows.spanish: Al atardecer, he aquí, terror; antes de la mañana, ya no está. Esta es la porción de los que nos saquean, y la suerte de los que nos despojan.
rows.current_english_pob: At evening time, look—terror! Before morning, he is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who loot us.
rows.spanish_base_english: At evening time, behold, terror! Before morning, he is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who loot us.

rows.spanish: los que no nacieron de sangre, ni de la voluntad de la carne, ni de la voluntad del hombre, sino de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: who were born, not from bloods, nor from the will of the flesh, nor from the will of a man, but from God.
rows.spanish_base_english: who were born, not from blood, nor from the will of the flesh, nor from the will of man, but from God.

rows.spanish: Porque la ley fue dada por medio de Moisés; la gracia y la verdad vinieron por medio de Jesús Mesías.
rows.current_english_pob: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus the Messiah.
rows.spanish_base_english: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Messiah.

rows.spanish: Él dijo: «Yo soy una voz que clama en el desierto: “Enderecen el camino de Yahvé”, tal como dijo el profeta Isaías».
rows.current_english_pob: He said, “I am a voice of one crying out in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ just as Isaiah the prophet said.”
rows.spanish_base_english: He said, “I am a voice of one crying out in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ just as Isaiah the prophet said.”

rows.spanish: Al día siguiente ve a Jesús venir hacia él y dice: «He aquí el Cordero de Dios, que quita el pecado del mundo».
rows.current_english_pob: The next day he sees Jesus coming toward him and says, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!”
rows.spanish_base_english: The next day he sees Jesus coming toward him and says, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!”

rows.spanish: Y yo no lo conocía, pero el que me envió a bautizar en agua me dijo: «Aquel sobre quien veas al Espíritu descender y permanecer sobre él, este es el que bautiza en el Espíritu Santo».
rows.current_english_pob: And I did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘The one on whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining on him, this is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
rows.spanish_base_english: And I did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘He on whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining on him, this is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

rows.spanish: Y fijando la mirada en Jesús mientras caminaba, dice: «¡He aquí el Cordero de Dios!»
rows.current_english_pob: And looking at Jesus as he was walking, he says, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
rows.spanish_base_english: And looking at Jesus as he was walking, he says, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

rows.spanish: Felipe era de Betsaida, de la ciudad de Andrés y Pedro.
rows.current_english_pob: Philip was from Bethsaida, from the town of Andrew and Peter.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, from the town of Andrew and Peter.

rows.spanish: Y Natanael le dijo: «¿Puede salir algo bueno de Nazaret?» Felipe le dijo: «Ven y mira».
rows.current_english_pob: And Nathanael said to him, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Nathanael said to him, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

rows.spanish: Jesús vio a Natanael que venía hacia él y dijo de él: «Mira, verdaderamente un israelita en quien no hay engaño».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said about him, “Look, truly an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said about him, “Behold, truly an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”

rows.spanish: Natanael le dijo: «¿Cómo me conoces?». Jesús respondió y le dijo: «Antes de que Felipe te llamara, mientras estabas bajo la higuera, te vi».
rows.current_english_pob: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered and said to him, “Before Philip called you, while you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered and said to him, “Before Philip called you, while you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

rows.spanish: Había allí seis tinajas de piedra, colocadas allí según los ritos judíos de purificación, con capacidad para dos o tres medidas cada una.
rows.current_english_pob: There were six stone water jars standing there, in accordance with the Jewish rites of purification, each holding two or three measures.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were six stone water jars standing there, in accordance with the Jewish rites of purification, each holding two or three measures.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando el encargado del banquete probó el agua que se había convertido en vino, y no sabía de dónde procedía —aunque los siervos que habían sacado el agua sí lo sabían—, el encargado del banquete llama al novio.
rows.current_english_pob: When the master of the feast tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it came from (though the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast calls the bridegroom
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the master of the feast tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it came from (though the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast calls the bridegroom

rows.spanish: Y estaba cerca la Pascua de los judíos, y Jesús subió a Jerusalén.
rows.current_english_pob: The Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, cuando fue resucitado de entre los muertos, sus discípulos recordaron que había dicho esto, y creyeron en la Escritura y en la palabra que Jesús había dicho.
rows.current_english_pob: So when he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had been saying this, and they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
rows.spanish_base_english: So when he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando estaba en Jerusalén en la Pascua, durante la fiesta, muchos creyeron en su nombre, al ver las señales que hacía.
rows.current_english_pob: When he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name as they were seeing the signs that he was doing.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name as they were seeing the signs that he was doing.

rows.spanish: Había un hombre de entre los fariseos, llamado Nicodemo, un dirigente de los judíos.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a man from the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a man from the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

rows.spanish: No te asombres de que te dije: «Es necesario que ustedes nazcan de arriba».
rows.current_english_pob: Do not be amazed that I told you, ‘You must be born from above.’
rows.spanish_base_english: Do not be amazed that I told you, ‘You must be born from above.’

rows.spanish: Y así como Moisés levantó la serpiente en el desierto, así es necesario que el Hijo del Hombre sea levantado.
rows.current_english_pob: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
rows.spanish_base_english: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

rows.spanish: Ahora Juan también estaba bautizando en Ainón, cerca de Salim, porque allí había muchas aguas, y venían y eran bautizados.
rows.current_english_pob: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there were many waters there, and people were coming and being baptized.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there were many waters there, and people were coming and being baptized.

rows.spanish: El que cree en el Hijo tiene vida eterna; pero el que no obedece al Hijo no verá vida, sino que la ira de Dios permanece sobre él.
rows.current_english_pob: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who disobeys the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
rows.spanish_base_english: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who does not obey the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.

rows.spanish: Y tenía que pasar por Samaria.
rows.current_english_pob: He had to pass through Samaria.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he had to pass through Samaria.

rows.spanish: Y allí estaba el pozo de Jacob. Entonces Jesús, cansado del viaje, estaba sentado junto al pozo. Era como la sexta hora.
rows.current_english_pob: Jacob’s well was there. So Jesus, wearied from the journey, was sitting there by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jacob’s well was there. So Jesus, wearied from the journey, was sitting there by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

rows.spanish: Pero cualquiera que beba del agua que yo le daré no tendrá sed jamás; más bien, el agua que yo le daré llegará a ser en él un manantial de agua que brota para vida eterna.
rows.current_english_pob: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never thirst forever; rather, the water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life.
rows.spanish_base_english: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never thirst; rather, the water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life.

rows.spanish: La mujer respondió y le dijo: «No tengo marido». Jesús le dijo: «Bien has dicho: “No tengo marido”»
rows.current_english_pob: The woman answered and said to him, “I do not have a husband.” Jesus said to her, “You have spoken well: ‘I do not have a husband.’”
rows.spanish_base_english: The woman answered and said to him, “I do not have a husband.” Jesus said to her, “You have spoken well: ‘I do not have a husband.’”

rows.spanish: Entonces la mujer dejó su cántaro de agua y fue a la ciudad, y dijo a la gente.
rows.current_english_pob: So the woman left her water jar and went into the town and says to the people,
rows.spanish_base_english: So the woman left her water jar and went into the town and said to the people,

rows.spanish: Mientras tanto, los discípulos le preguntaban, diciendo: «Rabí, come».
rows.current_english_pob: Meanwhile, the disciples were urging him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Meanwhile, the disciples were asking him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

rows.spanish: Y muchos de los samaritanos de aquella ciudad creyeron en él por la palabra de la mujer que daba testimonio: «Me dijo todo lo que he hecho».
rows.current_english_pob: And many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the word of the woman who was testifying, “He told me everything I did.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the word of the woman who was testifying, “He told me everything I have done.”

rows.spanish: Jesús le dijo: «Ve; tu hijo vive». El hombre creyó la palabra que Jesús le dijo, y siguió su camino.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said to him, “Go; your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went on his way.
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said to him, “Go; your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went on his way.

rows.spanish: Y mientras él ya iba bajando, sus esclavos le salieron al encuentro, diciendo que su niño estaba vivo.
rows.current_english_pob: And while he was already going down, his servants met him, saying that his child was alive.
rows.spanish_base_english: And while he was already going down, his slaves met him, saying that his child was alive.

rows.spanish: Así que les preguntó cuál había sido la hora en que había comenzado a mejorar. Entonces ellos le dijeron: «Ayer, a la séptima hora, la fiebre lo dejó».
rows.current_english_pob: So he asked them the hour in which he got better. Then they said to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So he asked them the hour at which he began to get better. Then they said to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.”

rows.spanish: Ahora hay en Jerusalén, junto a la Puerta de las Ovejas, un estanque llamado Betesda en hebreo, con cinco pórticos.
rows.current_english_pob: There is in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, a pool called Bethesda in Hebrew, having five porticoes.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there is in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, a pool called Bethesda in Hebrew, having five porticoes.

rows.spanish: Había allí un hombre que llevaba treinta y ocho años en su enfermedad.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a man there who had been in his sickness for thirty-eight years.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a man there who had been in his sickness for thirty-eight years.

rows.spanish: El enfermo le respondió: «Señor, no tengo a nadie que me meta en la piscina cuando el agua se agita; pero mientras yo llego, otro baja antes que yo».
rows.current_english_pob: The sick man answered him, “Lord, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another goes down before me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another goes down before me.”

rows.spanish: Y el Padre que me envió, él mismo ha dado testimonio acerca de mí. Ustedes no han oído jamás su voz ni han visto su forma,
rows.current_english_pob: And the Father who sent me—that one has testified about me. You have neither ever heard his voice nor seen his form,
rows.spanish_base_english: And the Father who sent me has himself testified about me. You have neither ever heard his voice nor seen his form,

rows.spanish: Pero yo sé de ustedes que no tienen el amor de Dios en ustedes.
rows.current_english_pob: But I know you: you do not have the love of God in yourselves.
rows.spanish_base_english: But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in yourselves.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, la Pascua, la fiesta de los judíos, estaba cerca.
rows.current_english_pob: The Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.

rows.spanish: Felipe le respondió: «Pan por valor de doscientos denarios no basta para ellos, para que cada uno reciba un poco».
rows.current_english_pob: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not enough for them, so that each one may receive a little.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not enough for them, that each one may receive a little.”

rows.spanish: Jesús dijo: «Hagan que la gente se siente». Había abundante hierba en el lugar. Entonces los hombres se sentaron; eran unos cinco mil.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was plenty of grass in the place. So the men sat down, about five thousand in number.
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said, “Have the people recline.” Now there was much grass in the place. So the men reclined, about five thousand in number.

rows.spanish: Al anochecer, sus discípulos bajaron al mar.
rows.current_english_pob: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

rows.spanish: Jesús les dijo: «Yo soy el pan de vida; el que viene a mí nunca tendrá hambre, y el que cree en mí nunca tendrá sed».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; the one who comes to me will never hunger, and the one who believes in me will never thirst again.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; the one who comes to me will never hunger, and the one who believes in me will never thirst.”

rows.spanish: Y decía: «Por esta razón les he dicho que nadie puede venir a mí si no le ha sido concedido del Padre».
rows.current_english_pob: And he was saying, “For this reason I have told you that no one is able to come to me unless it has been given to him from the Father.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he was saying, “For this reason I have told you that no one is able to come to me unless it has been granted to him by the Father.”

rows.spanish: Estaba hablando de Judas, hijo de Simón Iscariote; porque él, uno de los Doce, estaba por traicionarlo.
rows.current_english_pob: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for this one was about to betray him, being one of the Twelve.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for he was about to betray him, one of the Twelve.

rows.spanish: Y estaba cerca la fiesta judía, la fiesta de los Tabernáculos.
rows.current_english_pob: The Jewish feast, the Feast of Tabernacles, was near.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the Jewish feast, the Feast of Tabernacles, was near.

rows.spanish: Porque nadie hace cosa alguna en secreto mientras procura ser conocido abiertamente. Si haces estas cosas, muéstrate al mundo.
rows.current_english_pob: For no one does anything in secret while seeking to be in public view. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.
rows.spanish_base_english: For no one does anything in secret while seeking to be known openly. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.

rows.spanish: Después de decir estas cosas, se quedó en Galilea.
rows.current_english_pob: After saying these things, he himself remained in Galilee.
rows.spanish_base_english: After saying these things, he remained in Galilee.

rows.spanish: Para entonces, cuando la fiesta ya iba por la mitad, Jesús subió al templo y estaba enseñando.
rows.current_english_pob: When the feast was already half over, Jesus went up into the temple and was teaching.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the feast was already half over, Jesus went up into the temple and was teaching.

rows.spanish: Entonces los judíos se decían entre sí: «¿Adónde va a ir este hombre, para que no lo encontremos? ¿Acaso va a ir a la Dispersión entre los griegos y enseñar a los griegos?»
rows.current_english_pob: So the Jews said to one another, “Where is this man about to go, that we will not find him? He is not about to go to the dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks, is he?”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the Jews said to one another, “Where is this man about to go, that we will not find him? He is not about to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks, is he?”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en el último día, el gran día de la fiesta, Jesús estaba de pie y clamó, diciendo: «Si alguno tiene sed, que venga a mí y beba».
rows.current_english_pob: On the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink.”

rows.spanish: Ahora dijo esto acerca del Espíritu, a quien iban a recibir los que creyeron en él; porque aún no estaba el Espíritu, pues Jesús todavía no había sido glorificado.
rows.current_english_pob: He said this about the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were about to receive; for the Spirit was not yet, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he said this about the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were about to receive; for the Spirit was not yet, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.

rows.spanish: En nuestra ley, Moisés mandó que tales mujeres fueran apedreadas. Entonces, ¿qué dices tú?
rows.current_english_pob: in our law, Moses commanded that such women be stoned. So what do you say?
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in our law, Moses commanded that such women be stoned. So what do you say?

rows.spanish: Ella dijo: «Nadie, Señor». Y Jesús dijo: «Yo tampoco te condeno; vete, y no peques más».
rows.current_english_pob: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you; go, and sin no more."
rows.spanish_base_english: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you; go, and sin no more."

rows.spanish: Entonces los fariseos le dijeron: «Tú das testimonio acerca de ti mismo; tu testimonio no es verdadero».
rows.current_english_pob: So the Pharisees said to him, “You are testifying about yourself; your testimony is not true.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the Pharisees said to him, “You testify about yourself; your testimony is not true.”

rows.spanish: Así que le decían: «¿Quién eres tú?». Jesús les dijo: «Lo que les he estado diciendo desde el principio».
rows.current_english_pob: So they were saying to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So they were saying to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “What I have been telling you from the beginning.”

rows.spanish: Jesús les respondió: «De cierto, de cierto les digo que todo el que practica el pecado es esclavo del pecado».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who practices sin is a servant of sin.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who practices sin is a slave of sin.”

rows.spanish: El siervo no permanece en la casa para siempre; el hijo permanece para siempre.
rows.current_english_pob: The servant does not remain in the household forever; the son remains forever.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the slave does not remain in the house forever; the son remains forever.

rows.spanish: Le respondieron: «Abraham es nuestro padre». Jesús les dice: «Si ustedes fueran hijos de Abraham, harían las obras de Abraham».
rows.current_english_pob: They answered and said to him, “Abraham is our father.” Jesus says to them, “If you are Abraham’s children, you would be doing Abraham’s works.”
rows.spanish_base_english: They answered and said to him, “Abraham is our father.” Jesus says to them, “If you are Abraham’s children, you are doing the works of Abraham.”

rows.spanish: Jesús les dijo: «Si Dios fuera su Padre, me amarían, porque yo vine de Dios y estoy aquí. Pues no he venido por mi propia cuenta, sino que él me envió».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and am here. For I have not come from myself, but he sent me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and am here. For I have not come on my own, but he sent me.”

rows.spanish: Ustedes son de su padre, el diablo, y quieren hacer los deseos de su padre. Él era homicida desde el principio, y no se ha mantenido firme en la verdad, porque no hay verdad en él. Siempre que habla la mentira, habla de lo suyo, porque es mentiroso y padre de ella.
rows.current_english_pob: You are from your father, the devil, and you want to do your father's desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and he has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks the lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of it.
rows.spanish_base_english: You are from your father, the devil, and you want to do your father's desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks the lie, he speaks from his own, because he is a liar and its father.

rows.spanish: En verdad, en verdad, les digo: si alguien guarda mi palabra, no verá la muerte jamás.
rows.current_english_pob: Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps my word, he will certainly never see death forever.
rows.spanish_base_english: Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps my word, he will certainly never see death.

rows.spanish: Jesús respondió: «Si me glorifico a mí mismo, mi gloria no es nada. Es mi Padre quien me glorifica, de quien ustedes dicen: “Él es nuestro Dios”».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. My Father is the one who glorifies me, he whom you say is our God,”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God,’”

rows.spanish: Entonces los judíos le dijeron: «Aún no tienes cincuenta años, ¿y has visto a Abraham?»
rows.current_english_pob: So the Jews said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and you have seen Abraham?”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the Jews said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”

rows.spanish: Cuando estoy en el mundo, soy la luz del mundo.
rows.current_english_pob: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
rows.spanish_base_english: Whenever I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

rows.spanish: Después de decir estas cosas, escupió en el suelo, hizo barro con la saliva y extendió el barro sobre sus ojos,
rows.current_english_pob: After saying these things, he spit on the ground and made mud from the saliva, and he spread the mud on his eyes,
rows.spanish_base_english: After saying these things, he spit on the ground and made mud from the saliva, and he anointed his eyes with the mud,

rows.spanish: Era sábado el día en que Jesús hizo el barro y abrió sus ojos.
rows.current_english_pob: It was a Sabbath on the day when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it was the Sabbath on the day when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

rows.spanish: En verdad, en verdad, les digo: el que no entra por la puerta al redil de las ovejas, sino que sube por otro lado, ese es un ladrón y un salteador.
rows.current_english_pob: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who does not enter through the door into the sheepfold, but climbs up from somewhere else—that man is a thief and a robber.
rows.spanish_base_english: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who does not enter through the door into the sheepfold, but climbs up from elsewhere—that one is a thief and a robber.

rows.spanish: Y yo les doy vida eterna, y de ningún modo perecerán jamás, y nadie las arrebatará de mi mano.
rows.current_english_pob: And I give them eternal life, and they will certainly never perish forever, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I give them eternal life, and they will certainly never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

rows.spanish: Y muchos vinieron a él y decían: «Juan no hizo ninguna señal, pero todo lo que Juan dijo acerca de él era verdad.»
rows.current_english_pob: And many came to him and were saying, “John did no sign, but everything that John said about this man was true.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And many came to him and were saying, “John did no sign, but everything that John said about him was true.”

rows.spanish: Y estaba enfermo cierto hombre, Lázaro, de Betania, del pueblo de María y de Marta, su hermana.
rows.current_english_pob: A certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, from the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, from the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

rows.spanish: María era la que había ungido al Señor con perfume y había secado sus pies con su cabello, cuyo hermano Lázaro estaba enfermo.
rows.current_english_pob: It was Mary who had anointed the Lord with perfume and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it was Mary who had anointed the Lord with perfume and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

rows.spanish: Así que las hermanas le enviaron un mensaje, diciendo: «Señor, he aquí, el que amas está enfermo».
rows.current_english_pob: So the sisters sent word to him, saying, “Lord, look, the one you love is sick.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the sisters sent word to him, saying, “Lord, behold, the one you love is sick.”

rows.spanish: Y Jesús amaba a Marta, a su hermana y a Lázaro.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

rows.spanish: Jesús había hablado de su muerte, pero ellos pensaron que estaba hablando del sueño literal.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus had spoken about his death, but they thought that he was speaking about the sleep of rest.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jesus had spoken about his death, but they thought that he was speaking about the sleep of rest.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Betania estaba cerca de Jerusalén, como a quince estadios.
rows.current_english_pob: Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

rows.spanish: Ahora muchos de los judíos habían venido a Marta y María para consolarlas por su hermano.
rows.current_english_pob: Many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them about their brother.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them about their brother.

rows.spanish: Pero aun ahora sé que todo lo que le pidas a Dios, Dios te lo dará.
rows.current_english_pob: But even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you.
rows.spanish_base_english: But even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.

rows.spanish: Y todo el que vive y cree en mí no morirá jamás. ¿Crees esto?
rows.current_english_pob: And everyone who lives and believes in me will certainly never die forever. Do you believe this?
rows.spanish_base_english: And everyone who lives and believes in me will certainly never die. Do you believe this?

rows.spanish: Jesús todavía no había llegado al pueblo, sino que seguía en el lugar donde Marta lo había encontrado.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met him.

rows.spanish: Pero algunos de ellos dijeron: «¿No podía este hombre, que abrió los ojos del ciego, también haber hecho que este hombre no muriera?»
rows.current_english_pob: But some of them said, “Could not this man, who opened the eyes of the blind man, also have made it so that this man would not die?”
rows.spanish_base_english: But some of them said, “Could not this man, who opened the eyes of the blind man, also have caused that this man should not die?”

rows.spanish: Jesús dijo: «Quiten la piedra». Marta, la hermana del muerto, le dijo: «Señor, ya huele mal, porque lleva cuatro días muerto».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, “Lord, by now he smells, for he has been dead four days.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, “Lord, by now he smells, for he has been dead four days.”

rows.spanish: El hombre que había muerto salió, con los pies y las manos envueltos con vendas funerarias, y su rostro estaba envuelto con un paño. Jesús les dijo: «Desátenlo y déjenlo ir».
rows.current_english_pob: The man who had died came out, his feet and hands bound with burial cloths, and his face wrapped with a cloth. Jesus says to them, “Unbind him and let him go.”
rows.spanish_base_english: The man who had died came out, his feet and hands bound with burial cloths, and his face wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Unbind him and let him go.”

rows.spanish: Pero no lo dijo por sí mismo, sino que, siendo sumo sacerdote aquel año, profetizó que Jesús iba a morir por la nación.
rows.current_english_pob: He did not say this from himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he did not say this from himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation,

rows.spanish: Ya estaba cerca la Pascua de los judíos, y muchos subieron a Jerusalén del campo antes de la Pascua para purificarse.
rows.current_english_pob: The Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the countryside before the Passover to purify themselves.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the countryside before the Passover to purify themselves.

rows.spanish: Ahora los principales sacerdotes y los fariseos habían dado órdenes de que, si alguien sabía dónde estaba, lo informara, para que pudieran prenderlo.
rows.current_english_pob: The chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, so that they might seize him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, so that they might seize him.

rows.spanish: Ahora dijo esto, no porque le importaran los pobres, sino porque era un ladrón, y teniendo la caja del dinero, solía llevarse lo que se ponía en ella.
rows.current_english_pob: He said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, he used to take what was put into it.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, he used to take what was put into it.

rows.spanish: Había entonces algunos griegos de entre los que subían para adorar en la fiesta.
rows.current_english_pob: There were some Greeks among those going up to worship at the feast.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were some Greeks among those going up to worship at the feast.

rows.spanish: Así que la multitud que estaba de pie allí y lo había oído decía que había tronado; otros decían: «Un ángel le ha hablado».
rows.current_english_pob: So the crowd that was standing there and had heard it was saying that thunder had happened; others were saying, “An angel has spoken to him.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the crowd that stood there and heard it was saying that it had thundered; others were saying, “An angel has spoken to him.”

rows.spanish: Con esto indicaba qué clase de muerte iba a morir.
rows.current_english_pob: He was saying this to signify what kind of death he was about to die.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he was saying this to signify what kind of death he was about to die.

rows.spanish: Entonces la multitud le respondió: «Nosotros hemos oído de la Ley que el Mesías permanece para siempre, y ¿cómo puedes decir que es necesario que el Hijo del Hombre sea levantado? ¿Quién es este Hijo del Hombre?»
rows.current_english_pob: So the crowd answered him, "We have heard from the Law that the Messiah remains forever, and how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?"
rows.spanish_base_english: So the crowd answered him, "We have heard from the Law that the Messiah remains forever, and how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?"

rows.spanish: Sin embargo, incluso entre los gobernantes muchos creyeron en él, pero a causa de los fariseos no lo confesaban, para no ser excluidos de la sinagoga.
rows.current_english_pob: Nevertheless, even among the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing it, so that they might not become excluded from the synagogue.
rows.spanish_base_english: Nevertheless, even among the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing him, so that they might not become excluded from the synagogue.

rows.spanish: Antes de la fiesta de la Pascua, Jesús, sabiendo que había llegado su hora de partir de este mundo al Padre, habiendo amado a los suyos que estaban en el mundo, los amó hasta el fin.
rows.current_english_pob: Before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour had come to depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, loved them to the end.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour had come to depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, loved them to the end.

rows.spanish: Ustedes me llaman el Maestro y el Señor, y tienen razón, porque lo soy.
rows.current_english_pob: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you speak rightly, for I am.
rows.spanish_base_english: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you are right, for I am.

rows.spanish: En verdad, en verdad, les digo: un esclavo no es mayor que su amo, ni un apóstol es mayor que el que lo envió.
rows.current_english_pob: Truly, truly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master, nor is an apostle greater than the one who sent him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Truly, truly, I say to you, a slave is not greater than his master, nor is an apostle greater than the one who sent him.

rows.spanish: En verdad, en verdad, les digo: el que recibe a cualquiera que yo envíe me recibe a mí, y el que me recibe recibe al que me envió.
rows.current_english_pob: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever receives anyone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.
rows.spanish_base_english: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever receives anyone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.

rows.spanish: Los discípulos se miraban unos a otros, perplejos, sin saber de quién hablaba.
rows.current_english_pob: The disciples were looking at one another, at a loss about whom he was speaking.
rows.spanish_base_english: The disciples were looking at one another, at a loss as to whom he was speaking about.

rows.spanish: Si me hubieran conocido, también habrían conocido a mi Padre. Desde este momento lo conocen y lo han visto.
rows.current_english_pob: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on you do know him and have seen him.
rows.spanish_base_english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on you know him and have seen him.

rows.spanish: Por esto mi Padre es glorificado, para que ustedes den mucho fruto y lleguen a ser mis discípulos.
rows.current_english_pob: In this my Father is glorified: that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.
rows.spanish_base_english: By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.

rows.spanish: Ya no los llamo esclavos, porque el esclavo no sabe qué está haciendo su amo. Pero los he llamado amigos, porque todo lo que oí de parte de mi Padre se lo he dado a conocer.
rows.current_english_pob: I no longer call you servants, because the servant does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I heard from my Father.
rows.spanish_base_english: I no longer call you slaves, because the slave does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I heard from my Father.

rows.spanish: Recuerden la palabra que les dije: «Ningún esclavo es mayor que su amo». Si me persiguieron a mí, también a ustedes los perseguirán; si guardaron mi palabra, también guardarán la de ustedes.
rows.current_english_pob: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
rows.spanish_base_english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

rows.spanish: Les he dicho estas cosas para que no abandonen la fe.
rows.current_english_pob: I have spoken these things to you so that you may not fall away.
rows.spanish_base_english: I have spoken these things to you so that you may not stumble.

rows.spanish: Jesús supo que querían preguntarle, y les dijo: «¿Están discutiendo esto entre ustedes, porque dije: “Dentro de poco no me ven, y de nuevo dentro de poco me verán”?»
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Are you discussing this with one another, that I said, ‘A little while, and you no longer see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Are you discussing this with one another, because I said, ‘A little while, and you do not see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?”

rows.spanish: He aquí, viene la hora, y ya ha llegado, cuando ustedes serán esparcidos, cada uno a lo suyo, y me dejarán solo. Pero no estoy solo, porque el Padre está conmigo.
rows.current_english_pob: Behold, an hour is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, an hour is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

rows.spanish: Jesús dijo estas cosas, y, alzando sus ojos al cielo, dijo: «Padre, ha llegado la hora; glorifica a tu Hijo, para que el Hijo te glorifique»
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son may glorify you,”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son may glorify you,”

rows.spanish: Y esta es la vida eterna: que te conozcan a ti, el único Dios verdadero, y a Jesús, el Mesías, a quien enviaste.
rows.current_english_pob: And this is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus the Messiah whom you sent.
rows.spanish_base_english: And this is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Messiah whom you sent.

rows.spanish: He dado a conocer tu nombre a las personas que me diste de entre el mundo. Tuyos eran, y me los diste, y han guardado tu palabra.
rows.current_english_pob: I have made your name known to the men whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
rows.spanish_base_english: I have made your name known to the people whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.

rows.spanish: Y Judas, el que lo traicionaba, también conocía el lugar, porque Jesús se reunía allí con sus discípulos con frecuencia.
rows.current_english_pob: Judas, who was betraying him, also knew the place, because Jesus had often gathered there with his disciples.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Judas, who was betraying him, also knew the place, because Jesus often met there with his disciples.

rows.spanish: Le respondieron: «Jesús, el Nazareno». Les dijo: «Yo soy». Judas, el que lo traicionaba, estaba también allí de pie con ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: They answered him, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He said to them, “I am he.” Now Judas, who was betraying him, was also standing with them.
rows.spanish_base_english: They answered him, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He said to them, “I am.” Now Judas, who was betraying him, was also standing with them.

rows.spanish: Entonces Simón Pedro, teniendo una espada, la desenvainó y golpeó al esclavo del sumo sacerdote y le cortó la oreja derecha. Y el nombre del esclavo era Malco.
rows.current_english_pob: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant and cut off his right ear. Now the servant’s name was Malchus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s slave and cut off his right ear. Now the slave’s name was Malchus.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Caifás era el que había aconsejado a los judíos que era mejor que un solo hombre muriera por el pueblo.
rows.current_english_pob: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was better for one man to die for the people.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was better for one man to die for the people.

rows.spanish: Ahora Simón Pedro seguía a Jesús, y también otro discípulo. Aquel discípulo era conocido por el sumo sacerdote, y entró con Jesús en el patio del sumo sacerdote,
rows.current_english_pob: Simon Peter was following Jesus, and so was another disciple. That disciple was known to the high priest, and he went in with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Simon Peter was following Jesus, and so was another disciple. That disciple was known to the high priest, and he went in with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,

rows.spanish: Entonces la joven sirvienta que cuidaba la puerta le dijo a Pedro: «¿No eres tú también uno de los discípulos de este hombre?». Él dijo: «No soy».
rows.current_english_pob: So the servant girl who kept the door said to Peter, “You are not also one of this man's disciples, are you?” He said, “I am not.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So the servant girl who kept the door said to Peter, “You are not also one of this man's disciples, are you?” He said, “I am not.”

rows.spanish: Había allí los esclavos y los oficiales, que habían hecho un fuego de carbón porque hacía frío, y se calentaban. Pedro también estaba allí con ellos, de pie y calentándose.
rows.current_english_pob: The servants and the officers were standing there, having made a charcoal fire because it was cold, and they were warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them and warming himself.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the slaves and the officers were standing there, having made a charcoal fire because it was cold, and they were warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them and warming himself.

rows.spanish: Simón Pedro estaba de pie y calentándose. Entonces le dijeron: «Tú no eres también uno de sus discípulos, ¿verdad?» Él lo negó y dijo: «No lo soy».
rows.current_english_pob: Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. So they said to him, “You are not also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. So they said to him, “You are not also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

rows.spanish: Uno de los esclavos del sumo sacerdote, siendo pariente del hombre a quien Pedro había cortado la oreja, dijo: «¿No te vi yo en el jardín con él?»
rows.current_english_pob: One of the high priest’s servants, being a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
rows.spanish_base_english: One of the high priest’s slaves, being a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

rows.spanish: Pilato le dijo: «¿Qué es la verdad?». Después de decir esto, salió otra vez a los judíos y les dijo: «No encuentro ningún caso contra él».
rows.current_english_pob: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” After saying this, he went out again to the Jews and said to them, “I find no case against him.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” After saying this, he went out again to the Jews and said to them, “I find no case against him.”

rows.spanish: Entonces gritaron de nuevo, diciendo: «No a este, sino a Barrabás». Ahora bien, Barrabás era un ladrón.
rows.current_english_pob: So they shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
rows.spanish_base_english: So they shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

rows.spanish: Y los soldados, después de tejer una corona de espinas, se la pusieron sobre su cabeza y lo vistieron con una prenda púrpura.
rows.current_english_pob: And the soldiers, after weaving a crown out of thorns, put it on his head and clothed him in a purple robe,
rows.spanish_base_english: And the soldiers, after weaving a crown of thorns, put it on his head and clothed him in a purple garment,

rows.spanish: Entonces Jesús salió, con la corona de espinas y el manto púrpura puestos. Y les dice: «He aquí el hombre».
rows.current_english_pob: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And he says to them, “Behold, the man.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And he says to them, “Behold, the man.”

rows.spanish: Desde entonces Pilato trataba de ponerlo en libertad. Pero los judíos gritaron, diciendo: «Si dejas en libertad a este hombre, no eres amigo de César. Todo el que se hace rey se opone a César».
rows.current_english_pob: From then on Pilate was seeking to release him. But the Jews shouted, saying, “If you release this man, you are not Caesar’s friend. Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar.”
rows.spanish_base_english: From then on Pilate was seeking to release him. But the Jews shouted, saying, “If you release this man, you are not Caesar’s friend. Everyone who makes himself a king opposes Caesar.”
