rows.spanish: Ahora bien, era el día de preparación de la Pascua; era alrededor de la hora sexta. Y dice a los judíos: «¡Miren, su rey!»
rows.current_english_pob: It was the day of preparation of the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. And he says to the Jews, “Behold, your king!”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it was the day of preparation of the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. And he says to the Jews, “Behold, your king!”

rows.spanish: Así que, cuando los soldados habían crucificado a Jesús, tomaron sus prendas exteriores e hicieron cuatro partes, una parte para cada soldado, y también la túnica. Ahora bien, la túnica era sin costuras, tejida desde la parte superior por completo.
rows.current_english_pob: So when the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his outer garments and made four parts, a part for each soldier, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was seamless, woven from the top throughout.
rows.spanish_base_english: So when the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his outer garments and made four parts, a part for each soldier, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was seamless, woven from the top throughout.

rows.spanish: Junto a la cruz de Jesús estaban su madre, y la hermana de su madre, María la de Clopas, y María Magdalena.
rows.current_english_pob: Standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

rows.spanish: Entonces dijo al discípulo: «He aquí tu madre». Y desde aquella hora el discípulo la acogió en su propia casa.
rows.current_english_pob: Then he said to the disciple, “Look, your mother.” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own home.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother.” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own home.

rows.spanish: Ahora, en el lugar donde fue crucificado había un jardín, y en el jardín un sepulcro nuevo, en el cual aún no habían puesto a nadie.
rows.current_english_pob: In the place where he was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had yet been laid.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had yet been laid.

rows.spanish: Y el primer día de la semana, María Magdalena viene al sepulcro temprano, cuando todavía estaba oscuro, y ve la piedra ya quitada del sepulcro.
rows.current_english_pob: On the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and sees the stone having been taken away from the tomb.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and sees the stone having been taken away from the tomb.

rows.spanish: Pero María estaba de pie fuera de la tumba, llorando. Entonces, mientras lloraba, se inclinó para mirar dentro de la tumba.
rows.current_english_pob: But Mary was standing outside the tomb, weeping. So, as she was weeping, she bent over to look into the tomb,
rows.spanish_base_english: But Mary was standing outside the tomb, weeping. So, as she was weeping, she stooped to look into the tomb,

rows.spanish: Ahora Tomás, uno de los Doce, llamado Dídimo, no estaba con ellos cuando Jesús vino.
rows.current_english_pob: Thomas, one of the Twelve, the one called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Thomas, one of the Twelve, the one called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

rows.spanish: Y después de ocho días, sus discípulos estaban otra vez dentro, y Tomás estaba con ellos. Jesús vino, aunque las puertas estaban cerradas, se puso en medio y dijo: «Paz a ustedes».
rows.current_english_pob: And after eight days, his disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. Jesus comes, though the doors had been shut, and stood in the midst and said, “Peace to you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And after eight days, his disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, though the doors had been shut, and stood in the midst and said, “Peace to you.”

rows.spanish: Jesús le dijo: «¿Porque me has visto, has creído? Bienaventurados los que no han visto y han creído».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed? Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

rows.spanish: Jesús hizo muchos otros signos en presencia de los discípulos, que no están escritos en este libro.
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus did many other signs in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jesus did many other signs in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book.

rows.spanish: Cuando ya había amanecido, Jesús estaba de pie en la orilla; sin embargo, los discípulos no sabían que era Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: When daybreak had already come, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when daybreak had already come, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.

rows.spanish: Entonces aquel discípulo a quien Jesús amaba le dijo a Pedro: «Es el Señor». Al oír Simón Pedro que era el Señor, se ciñó la prenda exterior —pues estaba vestido ligeramente— y se echó al mar.
rows.current_english_pob: So that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord.” Therefore, when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he tied his outer garment around himself (for he was lightly clothed) and threw himself into the sea.
rows.spanish_base_english: So that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord.” Then Simon Peter, when he heard that it was the Lord, tied his outer garment around himself (for he was naked) and threw himself into the sea.

rows.spanish: Así, cuando habían desayunado, Jesús dijo a Simón Pedro: «Simón, hijo de Juan, ¿me amas más que estos?». Le dijo: «Sí, Señor; tú sabes que te amo». Le dijo: «Alimenta mis corderos».
rows.current_english_pob: So when they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you agape-love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I phileo-love you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
rows.spanish_base_english: So when they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I love you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

rows.spanish: Le dijo de nuevo, por segunda vez: «Simón, hijo de Juan, ¿me amas?». Él le dijo: «Sí, Señor; tú sabes que te amo». Él le dijo: «Pastorea mis ovejas».
rows.current_english_pob: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of John, do you agape-love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I phileo-love you.” He said to him, “Shepherd my sheep.”
rows.spanish_base_english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I love you.” He said to him, “Shepherd my sheep.”

rows.spanish: Él le dijo por tercera vez: «Simón, hijo de Juan, ¿me amas?» Pedro se entristeció porque le dijo por tercera vez: «¿Me amas?» Y le dijo: «Señor, tú lo sabes todo; tú sabes que te amo». Jesús le dijo: «Alimenta mis ovejas».
rows.current_english_pob: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of John, do you phileo-love me?” Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, “Do you phileo-love me?” And he said to him, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I phileo-love you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.”
rows.spanish_base_english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, “Do you love me?” And he said to him, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, esto lo dijo para indicar con qué clase de muerte glorificaría a Dios. Y después de decir esto, le dice: «Sígueme».
rows.current_english_pob: He said this to indicate by what kind of death he would glorify God. And after saying this, he says to him, “Follow me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now he said this to indicate by what kind of death he would glorify God. And after saying this, he says to him, “Follow me.”

rows.spanish: Cuando Pedro lo vio, le dijo a Jesús: «Señor, ¿qué hay de este hombre?».
rows.current_english_pob: So when Peter saw him, he says to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
rows.spanish_base_english: So Peter, seeing him, says to Jesus, “Lord, and what about this man?”

rows.spanish: Así que este dicho se difundió entre los hermanos que aquel discípulo no moriría. Sin embargo, Jesús no le dijo que no moriría, sino: «Si yo quiero que él permanezca hasta que yo venga, ¿qué te importa a ti?»
rows.current_english_pob: So this report spread among the brothers that that disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?”
rows.spanish_base_english: So this saying spread among the brothers that that disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?”

rows.spanish: Ahora también hay muchas otras cosas que Jesús hizo que, si se escribieran una por una, supongo que ni siquiera el mundo mismo podría contener los libros que se escribirían.
rows.current_english_pob: There are also many other things that Jesus did, which, if they were written down one by one, I suppose that not even the world itself would have room for the books being written.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there are also many other things that Jesus did, which, if they were written one by one, I suppose that not even the world itself could contain the books being written.
