rows.spanish_base_english: Now after the death of Moses, the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh said to Joshua son of Nun, the attendant of Moses, saying:

rows.spanish: Pasen por en medio del campamento y manden al pueblo, diciendo: «Preparen provisiones para ustedes, porque dentro de tres días van a cruzar este Jordán para entrar a poseer la tierra que Yahvé su Dios les da para poseerla».
rows.current_english_pob: Go through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, because within three days you are crossing this Jordan to go in to take possession of the land that Yahweh your God is giving you to possess it.’
rows.spanish_base_english: Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, because within three days you are crossing this Jordan to go in to possess the land that Yahweh your God is giving you to possess it.’

rows.spanish: Pero ella los había subido a la azotea y los había escondido entre los tallos de lino, tendidos sobre la azotea.
rows.current_english_pob: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax laid out for her on the roof.
rows.spanish_base_english: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax laid out on the roof.

rows.spanish: Los hombres le dijeron: «Nuestras vidas por la tuya, hasta la muerte, si no cuentas este asunto nuestro. Y cuando Yahvé nos dé la tierra, te trataremos con fidelidad al pacto y verdad».
rows.current_english_pob: The men said to her, “Our lives for yours, even to death, if you do not tell this matter of ours. And when Yahweh gives us the land, we will deal with you in covenant faithfulness and truth.”
rows.spanish_base_english: The men said to her, “Our lives for yours, even to death, if you do not tell this matter of ours. And when Yahweh gives us the land, we will deal kindly and faithfully with you.”

rows.spanish: Cualquiera que salga por las puertas de tu casa tendrá su sangre sobre su propia cabeza, y nosotros seremos inocentes; pero si alguien pone la mano sobre cualquiera que esté contigo en la casa, su sangre será sobre nuestras cabezas.
rows.current_english_pob: Anyone who goes out through the doors of your house, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be guiltless; but anyone who is with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads if a hand is laid on him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it shall be that anyone who goes out from the doors of your house to the outside—his blood shall be on his own head, and we shall be innocent. But everyone who is with you in the house—his blood shall be on our heads if a hand is laid on him.

rows.spanish: Y le dijeron a Josué: «Yahvé ha entregado toda la tierra en nuestras manos, y de hecho todos los habitantes de la tierra se han derretido delante de nosotros».
rows.current_english_pob: And they said to Joshua, “Surely the LORD has given all the land into our hands, and indeed all the inhabitants of the land have melted away before us.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And they said to Joshua, “Yahweh has given all the land into our hands, and indeed all the inhabitants of the land have melted away before us.”

rows.spanish: Entonces Josué dijo al pueblo: «Conságrense, porque mañana Yahvé hará maravillas entre ustedes».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, because tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

rows.spanish: Y cuando los que llevaban el arca llegaron hasta el Jordán, y los pies de los sacerdotes que llevaban el arca se hundieron en el borde del agua —ahora bien, el Jordán estaba lleno sobre todas sus orillas todos los días de la siega—
rows.current_english_pob: And when those carrying the ark came as far as the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (now the Jordan was full over all its banks all the days of harvest),
rows.spanish_base_english: And when those carrying the ark came as far as the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (now the Jordan was full over all its banks all the days of harvest),

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, cuando todos los reyes de los amorreos que estaban al otro lado del Jordán, al occidente, y todos los reyes de los cananeos que estaban junto al mar oyeron que Yahvé había secado las aguas del Jordán delante de los hijos de Israel hasta que cruzamos, se derritieron sus corazones, y ya no hubo en ellos espíritu por causa de los hijos de Israel.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the sons of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no longer spirit in them because of the sons of Israel.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the sons of Israel until they had crossed over, their hearts melted, and there was no longer spirit in them because of the sons of Israel.

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, cuando Josué estaba junto a Jericó, alzó los ojos y vio; y he aquí, un hombre estaba de pie frente a él, con su espada desenvainada en la mano. Josué fue hacia él y le dijo: «¿Estás de parte nuestra, o de nuestros enemigos?»
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man was standing opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man was standing opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

rows.spanish: Jericó estaba cerrada y bien asegurada por causa de los hijos de Israel; nadie salía ni nadie entraba.
rows.current_english_pob: Jericho was tightly shut up because of the sons of Israel; no one went out, and no one came in.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the sons of Israel; no one went out, and no one came in.

rows.spanish: Y cuando el cuerno del carnero dé un toque prolongado, cuando oigan el sonido de la trompeta, todo el pueblo dará un gran grito, y el muro de la ciudad caerá en su lugar, y el pueblo subirá, cada hombre directamente hacia adelante.
rows.current_english_pob: And when the ram's horn is drawn out, when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall raise a great shout, and the wall of the city will fall beneath itself, and the people shall go up, each man straight before him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when the ram's horn sounds a long blast, when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall raise a great shout, and the wall of the city will fall down beneath it, and the people shall go up, each man straight before him.

rows.spanish: Y aconteció el séptimo día que se levantaron temprano, al subir la aurora, y rodearon la ciudad de esta manera siete veces. Solo ese día rodearon la ciudad siete veces.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened on the seventh day that they rose early, at the going up of the dawn, and marched around the city in this manner seven times. Only on that day did they march around the city seven times.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened on the seventh day that they rose early, at the going up of the dawn, and went around the city in this manner seven times. Only on that day did they go around the city seven times.

rows.spanish: Pero en cuanto a ustedes, cuídense de las cosas dedicadas a la destrucción, no sea que ustedes mismos lleguen a ser dedicados a la destrucción y tomen de las cosas dedicadas a la destrucción, y hagan que el campamento de Israel quede dedicado a la destrucción, y le causen calamidad.
rows.current_english_pob: But as for you, keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest you yourselves become devoted to destruction and take some of what is devoted to destruction, and make the camp of Israel devoted to destruction, and bring trouble on it.
rows.spanish_base_english: But as for you, keep yourselves from the things devoted to destruction, lest you yourselves become devoted to destruction and take some of the things devoted to destruction, and make the camp of Israel devoted to destruction, and bring trouble on it.

rows.spanish: Y Josué dijo: «¡Ah, Señor Yahvé, por qué has hecho cruzar el Jordán a este pueblo siquiera, para entregarnos en la mano de los amorreos y destruirnos! ¡Ojalá nos hubiéramos contentado con habitar al otro lado del Jordán!»
rows.current_english_pob: And Joshua said, “Ah, Lord GOD, why have you brought this people across the Jordan at all—to give us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? If only we had been willing to dwell beyond the Jordan!”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Joshua said, “Ah, Lord GOD, why have you brought this people across the Jordan at all—to give us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? If only we had been content to dwell beyond the Jordan!”

rows.spanish: Y vi entre el botín un manto hermoso de Sinar, doscientos siclos de plata y una barra de oro que pesaba cincuenta siclos. Los codicié y los tomé; y he aquí, están escondidos en la tierra, dentro de mi tienda, y la plata debajo de ella.
rows.current_english_pob: I saw among the spoil one beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and one bar of gold weighing fifty shekels. I coveted them and took them, and look, they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath it.
rows.spanish_base_english: I saw among the spoil one beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and one bar of gold weighing fifty shekels. I coveted them and took them, and look, they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath it.

rows.spanish: Así Josué envió mensajeros, y corrieron a la tienda; y he aquí que estaba escondido en su tienda, con la plata debajo de ella.
rows.current_english_pob: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath it.
rows.spanish_base_english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath it.

rows.spanish: Y levantaron sobre él un gran montón de piedras hasta el día de hoy, y Yahvé se volvió del ardor de su ira. Por eso aquel lugar se llama Valle de Acor hasta el día de hoy.
rows.current_english_pob: And they raised over him a large heap of stones to this day, and Yahweh turned from the burning of his anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Achor to this day.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they raised over him a large heap of stones to this day, and Yahweh turned from the burning of his anger. Therefore the name of that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.

rows.spanish: Entonces Josué y todo el pueblo de guerra se levantaron para subir contra Hai, y Josué escogió treinta mil hombres, hombres poderosos de valor, y los envió de noche.
rows.current_english_pob: So Joshua and all the fighting people rose to go up against Ai, and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.
rows.spanish_base_english: So Joshua and all the people of war rose to go up against Ai, and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

rows.spanish: Y él les mandó, diciendo: «Miren, ustedes deben ponerse en emboscada contra la ciudad, detrás de la ciudad. No se alejen mucho de la ciudad, y todos ustedes estén listos».
rows.current_english_pob: And he commanded them, saying, “Look, you are to lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Do not go very far from the city, and all of you must be ready.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And he commanded them, saying, “See, you are to lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Do not go very far from the city, and all of you must be ready.”

rows.spanish: Y todos los hombres de guerra que estaban con él subieron y se acercaron, y llegaron delante de la ciudad y acamparon al norte de Hai, con el valle entre él y Hai.
rows.current_english_pob: And all the fighting people who were with him went up and approached, and they came before the city and camped north of Ai, with the valley between him and Ai.
rows.spanish_base_english: And all the men of war who were with him went up and approached, and they came before the city and camped north of Ai, with the valley between him and Ai.

rows.spanish: Así, el pueblo puso todo el campamento que estaba al norte de la ciudad, y su retaguardia al oeste de la ciudad; y Josué fue aquella noche en medio del valle.
rows.current_english_pob: So the people positioned the whole camp that was north of the city, with its rear west of the city, and Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
rows.spanish_base_english: So the people set all the camp that was north of the city, with its rear west of the city, and Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

rows.spanish: Entonces los hombres de Hai se volvieron y miraron detrás de sí, y he aquí que el humo de la ciudad subía al cielo, y no había poder en ellos para huir ni de un lado ni del otro. Y el pueblo que había huido al desierto se volvió contra el perseguidor.
rows.current_english_pob: Then the men of Ai turned behind them and looked, and behold, the smoke of the city was going up to the sky, and there was no power in them to flee this way or that. And the people who had fled to the wilderness turned back against the pursuer.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then the men of Ai turned behind them and looked, and behold, the smoke of the city was going up to the sky, and there was no power in them to flee this way or that. And the people who had fled to the wilderness turned back against the pursuer.

rows.spanish: Y estas salieron de la ciudad al encuentro de ellos, y quedaron en medio de Israel, estas por un lado y aquellas por el otro; y los abatieron hasta no dejarles ni sobreviviente ni fugitivo.
rows.current_english_pob: And these came out from the city to meet them, so that they were in the midst of Israel, these on one side and those on the other; and they struck them down until he left for him not a survivor or a fugitive.
rows.spanish_base_english: And these came out from the city to meet them, so that they were in the midst of Israel, these on one side and those on the other; and they struck them down until he left him neither survivor nor fugitive.

rows.spanish: Y sucedió que, cuando Israel hubo terminado de matar a todos los habitantes de Hai en el campo, en la región desierta donde los habían perseguido, y todos ellos habían caído a filo de espada hasta ser destruidos, todo Israel volvió a Hai y la golpeó a filo de espada.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened that when Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they had pursued them, and all of them had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were finished off, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened that when Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they had pursued them, and all of them had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were destroyed, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

rows.spanish: tal como Moisés, el siervo de Yahvé, había mandado a los hijos de Israel, como está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, un altar de piedras enteras, sobre las cuales no se había usado hierro; y ofrecieron sobre él holocaustos a Yahvé y ofrecieron sacrificios de paz.
rows.current_english_pob: just as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, on which no iron tool had been wielded; and they offered up burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.
rows.spanish_base_english: just as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron had been wielded; and they offered up burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.

rows.spanish: Y estos odres de vino, que llenamos cuando eran nuevos, y he aquí, se han reventado; y estas nuestras vestiduras y nuestras sandalias se han gastado por lo extremadamente largo del camino.
rows.current_english_pob: And these wineskins, which we filled when they were new—look, they have burst; and these our garments and our sandals have worn out from the journey being very long.
rows.spanish_base_english: And these wineskins, which we filled when they were new—look, they have burst; and these our garments and our sandals have worn out from the journey being very long.

rows.spanish: Entonces los hombres tomaron parte de sus provisiones, pero no pidieron consejo a Yahvé.
rows.current_english_pob: So the men took some of their provisions, but did not ask for the counsel of Yahweh.
rows.spanish_base_english: So the men took some of their provisions, but did not ask counsel from Yahweh.

rows.spanish: Y sucedió al cabo de tres días, después de haber hecho un pacto con ellos, que oyeron que estaban cerca de ellos y que vivían entre ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened at the end of three days, after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were near to them and were living among them.
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened at the end of three days, after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were near them and were living among them.

rows.spanish: Entonces los hijos de Israel partieron y llegaron a sus ciudades el tercer día. Ahora bien, sus ciudades eran Gabaón, Chefirá, Beerot y Quiriat-jearim.
rows.current_english_pob: So the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
rows.spanish_base_english: So the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.

rows.spanish: Los líderes les dijeron: «Que vivan». Así se convirtieron en cortadores de leña y en los que sacan agua para toda la congregación, tal como los líderes les habían dicho.
rows.current_english_pob: The leaders said to them, “Let them live.” So they became woodcutters and water-drawers for all the congregation, just as the leaders had spoken to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: The leaders said to them, “Let them live.” So they became cutters of wood and drawers of water for all the congregation, just as the leaders had spoken to them.

rows.spanish: Así que ustedes están malditos, y no dejará de haber entre ustedes esclavos, leñadores y aguadores para la casa de mi Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: So now you are cursed, and there shall never cease to be from among you servants, cutters of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
rows.spanish_base_english: So now you are cursed, and there shall never cease to be from among you slaves, cutters of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

rows.spanish: Ellos respondieron a Josué y dijeron: «Porque se les había dicho claramente a tus siervos, lo que Yahvé, tu Dios, había mandado a Moisés, su siervo: darles toda la tierra y destruir a todos los habitantes de la tierra de delante de ustedes. Así que temimos mucho por nuestras vidas, a causa de ustedes, e hicimos esta cosa».
rows.current_english_pob: They answered Joshua and said, “Because it was clearly told to your servants what Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses: to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you. So we feared greatly for our lives because of you, and we did this thing.”
rows.spanish_base_english: They answered Joshua and said, “Because it was clearly told to your servants what Yahweh your God had commanded his servant Moses: to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you. So we greatly feared for our lives because of you, and we did this thing.”

rows.spanish: Y sucedió, cuando Adoni-zedec, rey de Jerusalén, oyó que Josué había capturado Hai y la había consagrado a la destrucción, tal como había hecho con Jericó y con su rey, así hizo con Hai y con su rey; y que los habitantes de Gabaón habían hecho la paz con Israel y estaban entre ellos,
rows.current_english_pob: It happened, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and had devoted it to destruction, just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king, and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and had devoted it to destruction, just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king, and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,

rows.spanish: Yahvé los hizo entrar en confusión delante de Israel, y los golpeó con un gran golpe en Gabaón, y los persiguió por el camino de la subida de Bet-horón, y los golpeó hasta Azeca y Makeda.
rows.current_english_pob: And Yahweh threw them into confusion before Israel, and struck them down with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and pursued them by the way of the ascent of Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh threw them into confusion before Israel, and struck them with a great blow at Gibeon, and pursued them by the way of the ascent of Beth-horon, and struck them as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

rows.spanish: Y al tiempo de ponerse el sol, Josué mandó, y los bajaron de los árboles y los arrojaron en la cueva donde se habían escondido, y pusieron grandes piedras sobre la entrada de la cueva hasta este mismo día.
rows.current_english_pob: And at the time of the sun’s going down, Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden there, and they placed large stones over the mouth of the cave to this very day.
rows.spanish_base_english: And at the time of the sun’s going down, Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden, and they placed large stones over the mouth of the cave to this very day.

rows.spanish: Y la capturaron aquel día, y la hirieron al filo de la espada; y a toda persona que había en ella la dedicaron a destrucción aquel día, conforme a todo lo que habían hecho a Laquis.
rows.current_english_pob: And they captured it that day and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person who was in it he devoted to destruction that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they captured it that day and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person who was in it they devoted to destruction that day, according to all that they had done to Lachish.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, estos son los reyes de la tierra a quienes hirieron los hijos de Israel, y de cuya tierra tomaron posesión al otro lado del Jordán, hacia la salida del sol, desde el uadi Arnón hasta el monte Hermón, y toda la Arabá hacia el este.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel struck down and whose land they took possession of beyond the Jordan, toward the sunrise, from the Wadi Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel struck down and whose land they took possession of beyond the Jordan, toward the sunrise, from the Wadi Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward.

rows.spanish: Josué era viejo, avanzado en años, y Yahvé le dijo: «Tú eres viejo, avanzado en años, y queda todavía muchísima tierra por poseer».
rows.current_english_pob: Joshua was old, advanced in years, and Yahweh said to him, “You are old, advanced in years, and very much of the land remains to be possessed.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Joshua was old, advanced in years, and Yahweh said to him, “You are old, advanced in years, and very much of the land remains to be possessed.”

rows.spanish: desde el Sijor, que está frente a Egipto, hasta la frontera de Ecrón, hacia el norte —se considera territorio cananeo—, los cinco gobernantes de los filisteos: el gazita, el asdodita, el ascalonita, el gatita y el ecronita, y los Avim.
rows.current_english_pob: from the Shihor, which is east of Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron to the north—it is counted as Canaanite territory—the five rulers of the Philistines: the Gazite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, and the Ekronite, and the Avvim.
rows.spanish_base_english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron northward—it is counted as Canaanite territory—the five rulers of the Philistines: the Gazite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, and the Ekronite, and the Avvim.

rows.spanish: desde Aroer, que está a la orilla del valle del Arnón, y la ciudad que está en medio del valle, y toda la meseta desde Medeba hasta Dibón.
rows.current_english_pob: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Arnon Valley, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland from Medeba to Dibon,
rows.spanish_base_english: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the Arnon Valley, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland from Medeba to Dibon,

rows.spanish: Pero los hijos de Israel no expulsaron a los gesuritas ni a los maacatitas, y Gesur y Maacat habitan en medio de Israel hasta este día.
rows.current_english_pob: But the sons of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath lived among Israel to this day.
rows.spanish_base_english: But the sons of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath dwell among Israel to this day.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, estas son las herencias que recibieron los hijos de Israel en la tierra de Canaán, las cuales les repartieron Eleazar el sacerdote, Josué hijo de Nun, y los jefes de las casas paternas de las tribus de los hijos de Israel.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the inheritances that the sons of Israel received in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now these are the inheritances that the sons of Israel received in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned to them.

rows.spanish: Mis hermanos que subieron conmigo hicieron que se derritiera el corazón del pueblo, pero yo seguí plenamente a Yahvé mi Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, while I wholly followed the LORD my God.
rows.spanish_base_english: But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

rows.spanish: Y ahora, he aquí, Yahvé me ha mantenido con vida, tal como él dijo, estos cuarenta y cinco años desde que Yahvé habló esta palabra a Moisés, mientras Israel andaba por el desierto. Y ahora, he aquí, hoy tengo ochenta y cinco años.
rows.current_english_pob: And now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, just as he said, these forty-five years since Yahweh spoke this word to Moses while Israel walked in the wilderness. And now, behold, today I am eighty-five years old.
rows.spanish_base_english: And now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, just as he said, these forty-five years since Yahweh spoke this word to Moses while Israel walked in the wilderness. And now, behold, today I am eighty-five years old.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, el nombre anterior de Hebrón era Quiriat-arbá; Arba fue el hombre más importante entre los anaquitas. Y la tierra tuvo descanso de la guerra.
rows.current_english_pob: The former name of Hebron was Kiriath-arba; Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the former name of Hebron was Kiriath-arba; Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.

rows.spanish: Y el límite oriental era el Mar Salado, hasta el extremo del Jordán. Y el límite del lado norte era desde la lengua del mar, desde el extremo del Jordán.
rows.current_english_pob: And the eastern border was the Salt Sea, as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border on the north side was from the tongue of the sea, from the mouth of the Jordan.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the eastern border was the Salt Sea, as far as the end of the Jordan. And the border on the north side was from the tongue of the sea, from the end of the Jordan.

rows.spanish: Eltolad, Chesil y Horma.
rows.current_english_pob: Eltolad, Kesil, and Hormah.
rows.spanish_base_english: Eltolad, Chesil, and Hormah.

rows.spanish: desde Ecrón hacia el oeste, todo lo que está junto a Asdod, y sus aldeas.
rows.current_english_pob: from Ekron westward, all that is beside Ashdod, and their villages.
rows.spanish_base_english: from Ekron westward, all that are by Ashdod, and their villages.

rows.spanish: Pero no expulsaron a los cananeos que habitaban en Gezer, y los cananeos han habitado en medio de Efraín hasta el día de hoy, y han sido sometidos a trabajo forzoso.
rows.current_english_pob: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day and became forced laborers.
rows.spanish_base_english: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, and the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day and have become forced laborers.

rows.spanish: La suerte tocó a la tribu de Manasés, porque él era el primogénito de José: a Macir, el primogénito de Manasés, el padre de Galaad, porque él era un hombre de guerra, le pertenecían Galaad y Basán.
rows.current_english_pob: The lot fell to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph: to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, there belonged Gilead and Bashan.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the lot fell to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph: to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, there belonged Gilead and Bashan.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, Zelofehad, hijo de Héfer, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Maquir, hijo de Manasés, no tenía hijos varones, sino solo hijas; y estos son los nombres de sus hijas: Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milca y Tirsa.
rows.current_english_pob: Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

rows.spanish: Pero los hijos de Manasés no pudieron desposeer a los habitantes de estas ciudades, y el cananeo estaba resuelto a habitar en esta tierra.
rows.current_english_pob: But the sons of Manasseh were not able to dispossess these cities, and the Canaanites persisted in dwelling in this land.
rows.spanish_base_english: But the sons of Manasseh were not able to dispossess these cities, and the Canaanites were determined to dwell in this land.

rows.spanish: Y la dividirán en siete porciones. Judá se mantendrá en su límite por el sur, y la casa de José se mantendrán en sus límites por el norte.
rows.current_english_pob: And they shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall remain at its border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain at their border on the north.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall stand at its border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stand at their border on the north.

rows.spanish: Y ustedes escribirán la tierra en siete porciones, y me la traerán aquí; y yo echaré lotes para ustedes aquí delante de Yahvé nuestro Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: And you shall write down the land in seven portions and bring it here to me, and I will cast the lot for you here before the LORD our God.
rows.spanish_base_english: And you shall write down the land in seven portions and bring it here to me, and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

rows.spanish: Y la suerte para la tribu de los hijos de Benjamín, por sus clanes, salió, y el límite de su suerte salió entre los hijos de Judá y los hijos de José.
rows.current_english_pob: And the lot for the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, by their clans, came up, and the territory of their lot came out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the lot for the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, by their clans, came up, and the boundary of their lot came out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

rows.spanish: Y su frontera subía hacia el occidente hasta Maralá, y llegaba a Dabeset, y llegaba al wadi que está frente a Jocneam.
rows.current_english_pob: And their border went up westward to Maralah, and touched Dabbesheth, and touched the wadi that is opposite Jokneam.
rows.spanish_base_english: And their border went up westward to Maralah, and reached Dabbesheth, and reached the wadi that is opposite Jokneam.

rows.spanish: Y de la tribu de Isacar: Kisión con sus tierras de pasto, y Daberat con sus tierras de pasto.
rows.current_english_pob: And from the tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasturelands, and Dabrath with its pasturelands.
rows.spanish_base_english: And from the tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasturelands, and Daberath with its pasturelands.

rows.spanish: Yahvé les dio descanso por todos lados, conforme a todo lo que había jurado a sus padres. Ningún hombre de entre todos sus enemigos se mantuvo en pie delante de ellos; Yahvé entregó a todos sus enemigos en manos de ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: And Yahweh gave them rest on every side, according to all that he had sworn to their fathers. Not one man from all their enemies stood before them; Yahweh gave all their enemies into their hand.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he had sworn to their fathers. Not one man from all their enemies stood before them; Yahweh gave all their enemies into their hand.

rows.spanish: Entonces, a una mitad de la tribu de Manasés Moisés había dado tierra en Basán, pero a la otra mitad Josué dio tierra con sus hermanos más allá del Jordán, hacia el occidente. Y cuando Josué los despidió para que regresaran a sus tiendas, los bendijo.
rows.current_english_pob: To the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, but to the other half Joshua gave land with their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, but to the other half Joshua gave land with their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them.

rows.spanish: ¿No fue Acán hijo de Zéraj quien actuó infielmente en lo dedicado a destrucción, y vino la ira sobre toda la congregación de Israel? Sin embargo, él no fue el único que pereció por su iniquidad.
rows.current_english_pob: Was it not Achan son of Zerah who acted unfaithfully in the matter of what was devoted to destruction, and wrath came upon all the congregation of Israel? Yet he was not the only man who perished in his iniquity.
rows.spanish_base_english: Was it not Achan son of Zerah who acted unfaithfully in the matter of what was devoted to destruction, and wrath came upon all the congregation of Israel? And that man did not perish alone in his iniquity.

rows.spanish: No, más bien, lo hicimos por una seria preocupación, pensando: «En el futuro, sus hijos podrían decirles a nuestros hijos: “¿Qué tienen ustedes que ver con Yahvé, el Dios de Israel?”».
rows.current_english_pob: No, rather, we did this out of anxious concern, saying, ‘In time to come your children may say to our children, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?”’
rows.spanish_base_english: No, rather, we did this out of concern for a reason, saying, ‘Tomorrow your children may say to our children, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?”’

rows.spanish: Porque es testigo entre nosotros y ustedes, y entre las generaciones que vendrán después de nosotros, para que realicemos el servicio de Yahvé delante de él, con nuestros holocaustos, nuestros sacrificios y nuestros sacrificios de paz, para que sus hijos no digan a nuestros hijos en el futuro: «No tienen parte en Yahvé».
rows.current_english_pob: Rather, it is a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our peace offerings, so that your children may not say to our children in time to come, ‘You have no share in the LORD.’
rows.spanish_base_english: For it is a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our peace offerings, so that your children may not say to our children in time to come, ‘You have no share in Yahweh.’

rows.spanish: Entonces dijimos: «Si en el porvenir nos dicen a nosotros o a nuestras generaciones, entonces diremos: “Miren el modelo del altar de Yahvé, que nuestros padres hicieron, no para holocausto ni para sacrificio, sino como testigo entre nosotros y ustedes”»
rows.current_english_pob: So we said, ‘If they should say to us or to our generations in time to come, then we will say: “Look at the pattern of the altar of Yahweh, which our fathers made—not for burnt offering and not for sacrifice, but it is a witness between us and you.”’
rows.spanish_base_english: So we said, ‘If they should say to us or to our generations in time to come, then we will say: “Look at the pattern of the altar of Yahweh, which our fathers made—not for burnt offering or for sacrifice, but as a witness between us and you.”’

rows.spanish: Miren, yo les he repartido estas naciones que quedan como herencia para sus tribus, desde el Jordán, junto con todas las naciones que he eliminado, hasta el Mar Grande, hacia donde se pone el sol.
rows.current_english_pob: See, I have allotted to you these nations that remain as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, along with all the nations that I have cut off, to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun.
rows.spanish_base_english: See, I have allotted to you these remaining nations as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun.

rows.spanish: Por tanto, tengan mucho cuidado de amar a Yahvé su Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, take great care to love Yahweh your God.
rows.spanish_base_english: So be very careful for your own selves to love Yahweh your God.

rows.spanish: Miren, hoy voy por el camino de toda la tierra. Ustedes saben con todo su corazón y con toda su alma que no ha fallado ni una sola de las buenas palabras que Yahvé su Dios habló acerca de ustedes. Todas se han cumplido; ni una sola ha fallado.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and with all your soul that not one word has fallen from all the good words that Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All of them have come to you; not one word from them has fallen.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and with all your soul that not one thing has failed of all the good things that Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All of them have come to you; not one thing of them has failed.

rows.spanish: Entonces clamaron a Yahvé, y él puso oscuridad entre ustedes y los egipcios, y trajo el mar sobre él y lo cubrió, y sus ojos vieron lo que hice en Egipto. Entonces vivieron en el desierto muchos días.
rows.current_english_pob: Then they cried out to Yahweh, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon him and covered him, and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. Then you lived in the wilderness many days.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then they cried out to Yahweh, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them and covered them, and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. Then you lived in the wilderness many days.

rows.spanish: Y les di una tierra en la cual no habían trabajado, y ciudades que no habían edificado, y ustedes habitan en ellas. Ustedes comen de los viñedos y de los olivos que no plantaron.
rows.current_english_pob: And I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities that you had not built, and you live in them. You are eating from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities that you had not built, and you dwell in them. You eat from vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant.

rows.spanish: Porque Yahvé nuestro Dios es el que nos hizo subir a nosotros y a nuestros padres de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavitud, y el que hizo estas grandes señales ante nuestros ojos, y nos guardó en todo el camino por el cual anduvimos, y entre todos los pueblos por en medio de los cuales pasamos.
rows.current_english_pob: For Yahweh our God is the one who brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, from the house of servants, and who did these great signs before our eyes, and kept us in all the way in which we walked, and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.
rows.spanish_base_english: For Yahweh our God is the one who brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery, and who did these great signs before our eyes, and kept us in all the way in which we walked, and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.

rows.spanish: Y Eleazar, hijo de Aarón, murió, y lo sepultaron en Gibeat-finees, lugar que había sido dado a su hijo, en la región montañosa de Efraín.
rows.current_english_pob: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him at Gibeath-phinehas, his son’s hill country, which had been given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him at Gibeath-phinehas, which had been given to his son in the hill country of Ephraim.

rows.spanish: Y Yahvé dijo: «Judá subirá. Mira, he dado la tierra en su mano».
rows.current_english_pob: And the LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Look, I have given the land into his hand.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have given the land into his hand.”

rows.spanish: Y los descendientes del queneo, suegro de Moisés, subieron de la Ciudad de las Palmeras con los descendientes de Judá al desierto de Judá, que está en el Néguev de Arad; y fue y se estableció con el pueblo.
rows.current_english_pob: And the descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the descendants of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the Negev of Arad; then he went and settled with the people.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the descendants of Judah to the wilderness of Judah, which is in the Negev of Arad; and he went and settled with the people.

rows.spanish: Degollará el novillo delante de Yahvé, y los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, presentarán la sangre y la arrojarán contra todos los lados del altar que está a la entrada de la tienda de reunión.
rows.current_english_pob: And he shall slaughter the young bull before Yahweh, and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and throw the blood against the altar all around, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he shall slaughter the bull before Yahweh, and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood on the altar all around, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

rows.spanish: Y si su ofrenda es del ganado menor, de las ovejas o de las cabras, para holocausto, ofrecerá un macho sin defecto.
rows.current_english_pob: And if his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer it, a male without blemish.
rows.spanish_base_english: And if his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without blemish.

rows.spanish: Y si presentas a Yahvé una ofrenda de primicias, presentarás tu ofrenda de primicias como grano fresco tostado al fuego, granos triturados del grano fresco.
rows.current_english_pob: And if you present to Yahweh an offering of firstfruits, you shall present your offering of firstfruits as fresh heads of grain roasted in the fire, crushed kernels from the fresh grain.
rows.spanish_base_english: And if you present to Yahweh an offering of firstfruits, you shall present your offering of firstfruits as fresh grain roasted in the fire, crushed kernels from the fresh grain.

rows.spanish: Será un estatuto perpetuo a lo largo de sus generaciones, en todas sus moradas: no comerán grasa ni sangre.
rows.current_english_pob: It shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations, in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither any fat nor any blood.
rows.spanish_base_english: It shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations, in all your dwellings: you shall eat neither fat nor blood.

rows.spanish: Y le quitará toda la grosura al toro del sacrificio por el pecado: la grosura que cubre las entrañas y toda la grosura que está sobre las entrañas.
rows.current_english_pob: And he shall remove from it all the fat of the sin offering bull: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
rows.spanish_base_english: And he shall remove from it all the fat of the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,

rows.spanish: y los dos riñones, y la grasa que está sobre ellos, la que está sobre los lomos, y el apéndice sobre el hígado, con los riñones, lo quitará.
rows.current_english_pob: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the appendage on the liver, along with the kidneys, he shall remove it.
rows.spanish_base_english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the appendage on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove it.

rows.spanish: Sacará todo el toro a un lugar limpio fuera del campamento, al depósito de cenizas, y lo quemará sobre madera en el fuego; será quemado en el depósito de cenizas.
rows.current_english_pob: He shall bring out the whole bull to a clean place outside the camp, to the ash dump, and burn it on wood in the fire; it shall be burned at the ash dump.
rows.spanish_base_english: He shall bring the whole bull outside the camp to a clean place, to the ash heap, and burn it on wood with fire; it shall be burned on the ash heap.

rows.spanish: y cuando el pecado que cometieron llegue a ser conocido, la asamblea ofrecerá un toro del ganado como sacrificio por el pecado, y lo traerá ante la tienda de reunión.
rows.current_english_pob: and the sin that they committed becomes known, then the assembly shall present a bull, a son of the herd, as a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.
rows.spanish_base_english: and the sin that they committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a bull, a son of the herd, as a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.

rows.spanish: Entonces el sacerdote mojará su dedo en la sangre y rociará parte de la sangre siete veces delante de Yahvé, delante de la cortina.
rows.current_english_pob: Then the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, in front of the curtain.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, in front of the curtain.

rows.spanish: Y si una persona del pueblo de la tierra peca inadvertidamente al hacer uno de los mandamientos de Yahvé que no deben hacerse, y se hace culpable,
rows.current_english_pob: And if one person from the common people sins unintentionally by doing one of Yahweh’s commandments that must not be done, and becomes guilty,
rows.spanish_base_english: And if one person from the people of the land sins unintentionally by doing one of Yahweh’s commandments that must not be done, and becomes guilty,

rows.spanish: Y quitará toda su grasa, como se quita la grasa del cordero del sacrificio de las ofrendas de paz; y el sacerdote la hará arder sobre el altar, sobre las ofrendas de alimento de Yahvé. Así el sacerdote hará expiación por él respecto al pecado que cometió, y será perdonado.
rows.current_english_pob: And he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall burn them on the altar, on the food offerings of Yahweh. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the sin that he committed, and he shall be forgiven.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the food offerings of Yahweh. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the sin that he committed, and he shall be forgiven.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, sucedió que, mientras él servía como sacerdote delante de Dios en el orden de su división,
rows.current_english_pob: It happened, while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened, while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division,

rows.spanish: Ahora, en el sexto mes, el ángel Gabriel fue enviado de parte de Dios a una ciudad de Galilea llamada Nazaret,
rows.current_english_pob: In the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

rows.spanish: a una virgen desposada con un hombre cuyo nombre era José, de la casa de David; y el nombre de la virgen era María.
rows.current_english_pob: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man whose name was Joseph, from the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
rows.spanish_base_english: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, from the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, concebirás en tu vientre y darás a luz un hijo, y le pondrás por nombre Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you will call his name Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you will call his name Jesus.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, Elisabet, tu pariente, también ha concebido un hijo en su vejez, y este es el sexto mes para ella, la que era llamada estéril.
rows.current_english_pob: And look, Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who was called barren.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who was called barren.

rows.spanish: María dijo: «He aquí la sierva de Yahvé. Que se haga en mí conforme a tu palabra». Y el ángel se apartó de ella.
rows.current_english_pob: And Mary said, “Behold, I am the Lord’s servant. May it happen to me according to your word.” And the angel departed from her.
rows.spanish_base_english: And Mary said, “Behold, I am the Lord’s servant. May it happen to me according to your word.” And the angel departed from her.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en aquellos días, María se levantó y se fue con prisa a la región montañosa, a una ciudad de Judá,
rows.current_english_pob: In those days Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country, to a town of Judah,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in those days Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country, to a town of Judah,

rows.spanish: Porque, he aquí, cuando llegó el sonido de tu saludo a mis oídos, el bebé saltó de alegría en mi vientre.
rows.current_english_pob: For behold, when the sound of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped for joy in my womb.
rows.spanish_base_english: For behold, when the sound of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped for joy in my womb.

rows.spanish: porque ha mirado la humilde condición de su esclava. Porque he aquí, desde ahora todas las generaciones me llamarán bienaventurada.
rows.current_english_pob: because he has looked upon the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed.
rows.spanish_base_english: because he has looked upon the humble state of his slave. For behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed.

rows.spanish: Y a Isabel se le cumplió el tiempo de dar a luz, y dio a luz un hijo.
rows.current_english_pob: The time was fulfilled for Elizabeth to give birth, and she bore a son.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the time was fulfilled for Elizabeth to give birth, and she bore a son.

rows.spanish: Entonces le hicieron señas a su padre qué quería que lo llamaran.
rows.current_english_pob: So they motioned to his father to find out what he wanted him to be called.
rows.spanish_base_english: So they motioned to his father what he wanted him to be called.

rows.spanish: Bendito sea Yahvé, el Dios de Israel, porque ha visitado a su pueblo y le ha traído redención.
rows.current_english_pob: Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has visited and brought redemption to his people,
rows.spanish_base_english: Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has visited his people and brought redemption,

rows.spanish: Sucedió que en aquellos días salió un decreto de César Augusto para que fuera inscrito todo el mundo habitado.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the inhabited world should be registered.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the inhabited world should be registered.

rows.spanish: Y José también subió de Galilea, de la ciudad de Nazaret, a Judea, a la ciudad de David, que se llama Belén, porque era de la casa y del linaje de David.
rows.current_english_pob: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the town of Nazareth, to Judea, to the city of David which is called Bethlehem, because he was from the house and family line of David,
rows.spanish_base_english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the town of Nazareth, to Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family line of David,

rows.spanish: Y todos los que oyeron se asombraron de lo que les habían dicho los pastores.
rows.current_english_pob: And all who heard it were amazed about what had been told to them by the shepherds,
rows.spanish_base_english: And all who heard were amazed at what had been told to them by the shepherds,

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, había en Jerusalén un hombre llamado Simeón, y este hombre era justo y piadoso, esperando la consolación de Israel, y el Espíritu Santo estaba sobre él.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

rows.spanish: Ahora despides a tu esclavo, Maestro, conforme a tu palabra, en paz.
rows.current_english_pob: Now you are dismissing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now you are dismissing your slave, Master, according to your word, in peace.

rows.spanish: Y Simeón los bendijo y dijo a María, su madre: «He aquí, este ha sido puesto para caída y levantamiento de muchos en Israel, y para señal a la que se opondrán»
rows.current_english_pob: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, “Look, this one is appointed for the fall and rise of many in Israel, and for a sign that is opposed,”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, “Behold, this one is appointed for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign that is opposed,”

rows.spanish: Y cuando lo vieron, se asombraron, y su madre le dijo: «Hijo, ¿por qué nos has hecho esto? Mira, tu padre y yo te hemos estado buscando con angustia».
rows.current_english_pob: And when they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Child, why have you done this to us? Look, your father and I have been anxiously looking for you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And when they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Child, why have you done this to us? Look, your father and I have been searching for you in distress.”

rows.spanish: En el año decimoquinto del reinado de Tiberio César, mientras Poncio Pilato gobernaba Judea, y Herodes era tetrarca de Galilea, y Felipe, su hermano, era tetrarca de la región de Iturea y Traconítide, y Lisanias era tetrarca de Abilene,
rows.current_english_pob: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governing Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, and Philip his brother was tetrarch of the region of Iturea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governing Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, and Philip his brother was tetrarch of the region of Iturea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, como el pueblo estaba en expectativa, y todos razonaban en sus corazones acerca de Juan, si quizá él mismo fuera el Mesías,
rows.current_english_pob: As the people were waiting expectantly, and all were reasoning in their hearts about John, whether perhaps he might be the Messiah,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now as the people were waiting expectantly, and all were reasoning in their hearts about John, whether perhaps he might be the Messiah,

rows.spanish: Aconteció, pues, que cuando todo el pueblo era bautizado, y Jesús también había sido bautizado y estaba orando, el cielo se abrió,
rows.current_english_pob: It happened that when all the people were baptized, and Jesus also had been baptized and was praying, heaven was opened,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that when all the people were baptized, and Jesus also had been baptized and was praying, heaven was opened,

rows.spanish: hijo de Josué, hijo de Eliezer, hijo de Jorim, hijo de Matat, hijo de Leví,
rows.current_english_pob: the son of Jeshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
rows.spanish_base_english: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

rows.spanish: el hijo de Jesé, el hijo de Obed, el hijo de Booz, el hijo de Sala, el hijo de Naasón,
rows.current_english_pob: the son of Jesse, the son of Jobed, the son of Boaz, the son of Sala, the son of Nahshon,
rows.spanish_base_english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Sala, the son of Nahshon,

rows.spanish: durante cuarenta días, siendo tentado por el diablo. Y no comió nada en aquellos días, y cuando terminaron, tuvo hambre.
rows.current_english_pob: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. And he ate nothing during those days, and when they were completed, he was hungry.
rows.spanish_base_english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. And he ate nothing during those days, and when they were ended, he was hungry.

rows.spanish: Pero en verdad les digo: había muchas viudas en Israel en los días de Elías, cuando se cerró el cielo por tres años y seis meses, cuando vino una gran hambre sobre toda la región.
rows.current_english_pob: But I tell you truly, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months, as a great famine came over all the land.
rows.spanish_base_english: But in truth I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months, as a great famine came over all the land.

rows.spanish: Y la noticia acerca de él se difundía por todos los lugares de la región circundante.
rows.current_english_pob: And news about him was spreading into every place in the surrounding region.
rows.spanish_base_english: And news about him was going out into every place of the surrounding region.

rows.spanish: Al ponerse el sol, todos los que tenían enfermos con diversas enfermedades los trajeron a él; y él, poniéndoles las manos a cada uno de ellos, los sanaba.
rows.current_english_pob: When the sun was setting, all who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on each one of them and healed them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the sun was setting, all who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on each one of them and healed them.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, sucedió que mientras la multitud se agolpaba sobre él y escuchaba la palabra de Dios, él estaba de pie junto al lago de Genesaret,
rows.current_english_pob: It happened that while the crowd was pressing in on him and listening to the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened that while the crowd was pressing in on him and listening to the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret,

rows.spanish: e igualmente también Jacobo y Juan, hijos de Zebedeo, quienes eran socios de Simón. Y Jesús dijo a Simón: «No tengas miedo; desde ahora pescarás personas».
rows.current_english_pob: and likewise also James and John, Zebedee’s sons, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, “Do not be afraid; from now on you will be catching people alive.”
rows.spanish_base_english: and likewise also James and John, Zebedee’s sons, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, “Do not be afraid; from now on you will be catching people.”

rows.spanish: Sucedió que, estando él en una de las ciudades, he aquí un hombre lleno de lepra. Y al ver a Jesús, cayó rostro en tierra y le rogó, diciendo: «Señor, si quieres, puedes limpiarme».
rows.current_english_pob: And it happened that while he was in one of the towns, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. And when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you are willing, you can cleanse me.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And it happened that while he was in one of the towns, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. And when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you are willing, you can cleanse me.”

rows.spanish: Y he aquí unos hombres que llevaban en una cama a un hombre que estaba paralizado, y procuraban introducirlo y ponerlo delante de él.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, men were carrying on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they were seeking to bring him in and set him before him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, men were carrying on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they were seeking to bring him in and set him before him.

rows.spanish: No he venido a llamar a los justos, sino a los pecadores a cambiar su manera de pensar.
rows.current_english_pob: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to a change of mind.
rows.spanish_base_english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, sucedió en un día de sábado que él iba pasando por los sembrados, y sus discípulos iban arrancando y comiendo las espigas, frotándolas con las manos.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened on a Sabbath that he was passing through grainfields, and his disciples were plucking and eating the heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened on a Sabbath that he was passing through grainfields, and his disciples were plucking and eating the heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands.

rows.spanish: Sucedió en otro sábado que él entró en la sinagoga y estaba enseñando. Y había allí un hombre que tenía la mano derecha atrofiada.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened on another Sabbath that he entered the synagogue and was teaching. And a man was there whose right hand was withered.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened on another Sabbath that he entered the synagogue and was teaching. And a man was there whose right hand was withered.

rows.spanish: En aquellos días sucedió que él salió al monte para orar, y pasó la noche entera en oración a Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: It happened in those days that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he spent the whole night in prayer to God.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now it happened in those days that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he spent the whole night in prayer to God.

rows.spanish: Alégrense en aquel día y salten de gozo, porque su recompensa es grande en el cielo; pues de la misma manera sus padres trataban a los profetas.
rows.current_english_pob: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for in the same way their fathers used to do to the prophets.
rows.spanish_base_english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for in the same way their fathers used to treat the prophets.

rows.spanish: Porque no hay árbol bueno que produzca fruto malo, ni tampoco árbol malo que produzca fruto bueno.
rows.current_english_pob: For there is no good tree producing rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree producing good fruit.
rows.spanish_base_english: For there is no good tree producing bad fruit, nor again a bad tree producing good fruit.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, el esclavo de cierto centurión, que estaba enfermo y a punto de morir, era muy estimado por él.
rows.current_english_pob: A certain centurion’s servant, who was sick and about to die, was highly valued by him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now a certain centurion’s slave, who was sick and about to die, was highly valued by him.

rows.spanish: Cuando oyó acerca de Jesús, le envió ancianos de los judíos, pidiéndole que viniera y salvara a su esclavo.
rows.current_english_pob: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
rows.spanish_base_english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his slave.

rows.spanish: Porque también yo soy un hombre puesto bajo autoridad, con soldados bajo mi mando; y digo a este: “Ve”, y va; y a otro: “Ven”, y viene; y a mi esclavo: “Haz esto”, y lo hace.
rows.current_english_pob: For I too am a man placed under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.
rows.spanish_base_english: For I too am a man placed under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my slave, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.

rows.spanish: Y cuando los que habían sido enviados regresaron a la casa, encontraron al esclavo sano.
rows.current_english_pob: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the servant healthy.
rows.spanish_base_english: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave healthy.

rows.spanish: Cuando se acercó a la puerta de la ciudad, he aquí que llevaban fuera a un muerto, el único hijo de su madre; y ella era viuda, y una multitud considerable de la ciudad iba con ella.
rows.current_english_pob: As he came near to the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow, and a considerable crowd from the city was with her.
rows.spanish_base_english: As he came near to the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow, and a considerable crowd from the city was with her.

rows.spanish: Este es de quien está escrito: «He aquí, yo envío a mi mensajero delante de tu rostro, quien preparará tu camino delante de ti».
rows.current_english_pob: This is he about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I am sending my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
rows.spanish_base_english: This is he about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I am sending my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

rows.spanish: ¿Con qué, pues, compararé a la gente de esta generación, y a qué se parecen?
rows.current_english_pob: To what, then, shall I compare the men of this generation, and what are they like?
rows.spanish_base_english: To what, then, shall I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?

rows.spanish: Y uno de los fariseos le estaba pidiendo que comiera con él; y, después de entrar en la casa del fariseo, se reclinó a la mesa.
rows.current_english_pob: One of the Pharisees was asking him to eat with him, and after entering the Pharisee’s house, he reclined at the table.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now one of the Pharisees was asking him to eat with him, and after entering the Pharisee’s house, he reclined at the table.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí una mujer en la ciudad, que era pecadora, y al enterarse de que él estaba recostado a la mesa en casa del fariseo, trajo un frasco de alabastro de perfume.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, having learned that he was reclining at table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of perfume.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, having learned that he was reclining at table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of perfume.

rows.spanish: Y Jesús respondió y le dijo: «Simón, tengo algo que decirte». Y él dijo: «Maestro, di».
rows.current_english_pob: And Jesus answered and said to him, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” And he said, “Teacher, say it.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Jesus answered and said to him, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” And he said, “Teacher, say it.”

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, esta es la parábola: la semilla es la palabra de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: This is the parable: the seed is the word of God.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now this is the parable: the seed is the word of God.

rows.spanish: Entonces les dijo: «¿Dónde está su fe?». Y tenían miedo y se maravillaban, diciéndose unos a otros: «¿Quién es entonces este, que aun a los vientos y al agua ordena, y le obedecen?»
rows.current_english_pob: Then he said to them, “Where is your faith?” And being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who then is this, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then he said to them, “Where is your faith?” And they were afraid and marveled, saying to one another, “Who then is this, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

rows.spanish: Y navegaron a la región de los Gerasenos, que está al otro lado de Galilea.
rows.current_english_pob: And they sailed down to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.

rows.spanish: Ahora había allí una gran piara de cerdos que se alimentaba en el monte; y le rogaron que les permitiera entrar en aquellos cerdos, y se lo permitió.
rows.current_english_pob: There was a large herd of pigs feeding there on the mountain, and they begged him to permit them to enter those pigs, and he permitted them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there was a large herd of pigs feeding there on the mountain, and they begged him to permit them to enter those pigs, and he permitted them.

rows.spanish: Entonces el hombre de quien habían salido los demonios le rogaba estar con él; pero Jesús lo envió, diciendo:
rows.current_english_pob: The man from whom the demons had gone out was begging him to be with him, but he sent him away, saying,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging him to be with him, but he sent him away, saying,

rows.spanish: Regresa a tu casa, y cuenta lo que Dios ha hecho por ti. Y él se fue, proclamando por toda la ciudad lo que Jesús había hecho por él.
rows.current_english_pob: Return to your house, and tell what great things God has done for you. And he went away, proclaiming throughout the whole city what Jesus had done for him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Return to your house, and tell what God has done for you. And he went away, proclaiming throughout the whole city what Jesus had done for him.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, cuando Jesús volvió, la multitud lo recibió, porque todos estaban esperándolo.
rows.current_english_pob: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

rows.spanish: Y Jesús dijo: «¿Quién es el que me tocó?». Y, mientras todos lo negaban, Pedro dijo: «Maestro, las multitudes te cercan y te presionan».
rows.current_english_pob: And Jesus said, “Who is the one who touched me?” And while everyone was denying it, Peter said, “Master, the crowds are hemming you in and pressing against you.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And Jesus said, “Who is the one who touched me?” And while everyone was denying it, Peter said, “Master, the crowds are hemming you in and pressing against you.”

rows.spanish: Y se reían de él, sabiendo que ella había muerto.
rows.current_english_pob: And they were laughing at him, because they knew that she had died.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they were laughing at him, knowing that she had died.

rows.spanish: Y en cualquier casa que entren, quédense allí y salgan de allí.
rows.current_english_pob: And whatever house you enter, stay there, and leave from there.
rows.spanish_base_english: And whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

rows.current_english_pob: Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, and he was perplexed because it was being said by some that John had been raised from the dead,

rows.current_english_pob: And they answered, “John the Baptist; but others, Elijah; and others, that some prophet of the ancients has risen.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And they answered, “John the Baptist; but others, Elijah; and others, that one of the ancient prophets has risen.”

rows.spanish: diciendo: «Es necesario que el Hijo del Hombre padezca muchas cosas y sea rechazado por los ancianos, los principales sacerdotes y los escribas, y lo maten, y al tercer día sea resucitado».
rows.current_english_pob: saying, “It is necessary for the Son of Man to suffer many things and to be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and on the third day to be raised.”
rows.spanish_base_english: saying, “It is necessary for the Son of Man to suffer many things and to be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and on the third day to be raised.”

rows.spanish: Ahora, unos ocho días después de estas palabras, tomó consigo a Pedro, a Juan y a Jacobo, y subió al monte para orar.
rows.current_english_pob: About eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James and went up on the mountain to pray.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now about eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James and went up on the mountain to pray.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, dos hombres hablaban con él, los cuales eran Moisés y Elías,
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

rows.spanish: quienes, apareciendo en gloria, hablaban de su partida, que estaba por llevar a cabo en Jerusalén.
rows.current_english_pob: who, appearing in glory, were speaking about his departure, which he was about to fulfill in Jerusalem.
rows.spanish_base_english: who, appearing in glory, were speaking about his departure, which he was about to accomplish in Jerusalem.

rows.spanish: Pedro y los que estaban con él estaban cargados de sueño; pero, al despertarse por completo, vieron su gloria y a los dos hombres que estaban de pie con él.
rows.current_english_pob: Peter and those with him were weighed down with sleep; but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Peter and those with him were weighed down with sleep; but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

rows.spanish: Mientras él decía estas cosas, apareció una nube y los cubrió con su sombra, y tuvieron miedo mientras entraban en la nube.
rows.current_english_pob: While he was saying these things, a cloud appeared and began to overshadow them; and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
rows.spanish_base_english: While he was saying these things, a cloud appeared and overshadowed them; and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, al día siguiente, cuando bajaron del monte, una gran multitud lo encontró.
rows.current_english_pob: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, un hombre de la multitud gritó, diciendo: «Maestro, te ruego que mires a mi hijo, porque es mi único hijo.»
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, a man from the crowd cried out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look upon my son, because he is my only child.”
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, a man from the crowd cried out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look upon my son, because he is my only child.”
