rows.spanish_base_english: Likewise also the second and the third, up to the seven.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en cuanto a la resurrección de los muertos, ¿no han leído lo que les fue dicho por Dios, diciendo:
rows.current_english_pob: Concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,

rows.spanish: Yo soy el Dios de Abraham, el Dios de Isaac y el Dios de Jacob. No es el Dios de los muertos, sino de los vivos.
rows.current_english_pob: ‘I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
rows.spanish_base_english: I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob. He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

rows.spanish: Y uno de ellos, un experto en la Ley, le preguntó, poniéndolo a prueba.
rows.current_english_pob: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And one of them, a lawyer, asked him, testing him.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, mientras los fariseos estaban reunidos, Jesús les preguntó,
rows.current_english_pob: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

rows.spanish: Y aman los lugares de honor en los banquetes y los asientos principales en las sinagogas.
rows.current_english_pob: And they love the place of honor at banquets and the seats of honor in the synagogues,
rows.spanish_base_english: And they love the places of honor at banquets and the best seats in the synagogues,

rows.spanish: No sean llamados instructores, porque tienen un solo instructor: el Mesías.
rows.current_english_pob: Do not be called instructors, for you have one instructor, the Messiah.
rows.spanish_base_english: And do not be called instructors, because your instructor is one—the Messiah.

rows.spanish: ¡Ay de ustedes, escribas y fariseos, hipócritas! Porque recorren mar y tierra para hacer un prosélito, y cuando llega a serlo, lo hacen hijo de Gehenna, el doble que ustedes.
rows.current_english_pob: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel over sea and land to make one convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
rows.spanish_base_english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you travel over sea and land to make one convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

rows.spanish: ¡Necios y ciegos! Porque ¿cuál es mayor: el oro, o el templo que santifica el oro?
rows.current_english_pob: You fools and blind men, for which is greater: the gold, or the temple that sanctified the gold?
rows.spanish_base_english: You fools and blind men, for which is greater: the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

rows.spanish: Por lo tanto, he aquí, yo les envío profetas, sabios y escribas. A algunos de ellos ustedes matarán y crucificarán, y a algunos de ellos azotarán en las sinagogas de ustedes y perseguirán de ciudad en ciudad.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore, look, I am sending you prophets and wise men and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from city to city.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore, behold, I am sending to you prophets and wise men and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from city to city.

rows.spanish: para que toda la sangre justa derramada sobre la tierra venga sobre ustedes, desde la sangre del justo Abel hasta la sangre de Zacarías, hijo de Berequías, a quien asesinaron entre el santuario y el altar.
rows.current_english_pob: so that all the righteous blood shed on the earth may come upon you, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.
rows.spanish_base_english: so that all the righteous blood poured out on the earth may come upon you, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.

rows.spanish: Y oirán de guerras y de noticias de guerras. Miren que no se alarmen, porque es necesario que suceda, pero todavía no es el fin.
rows.current_english_pob: And you are going to hear of wars and reports of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for it must happen, but the end is not yet.
rows.spanish_base_english: And you are going to hear of wars and reports of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for it must happen, but the end is not yet.

rows.spanish: Así que, cuando vean la abominación de la desolación, de la que se habló por medio de Daniel el profeta, de pie en un lugar santo, el que lee, entienda.
rows.current_english_pob: So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of through Daniel the prophet standing in the holy place—let the reader understand—
rows.spanish_base_english: So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of through Daniel the prophet standing in a holy place—let the reader understand—

rows.spanish: Pues entonces habrá una gran tribulación, como no la ha habido desde el comienzo del mundo hasta ahora, ni nunca la habrá.
rows.current_english_pob: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not happened from the beginning of the world until now, and never will happen again.
rows.spanish_base_english: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, and never will be.

rows.spanish: Miren, les he dicho de antemano.
rows.current_english_pob: Look, I have told you beforehand.
rows.spanish_base_english: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

rows.spanish: Porque así como el relámpago sale desde el oriente y se ve hasta el occidente, así será la venida del Hijo del Hombre.
rows.current_english_pob: For just as the lightning flashes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
rows.spanish_base_english: For just as the lightning comes from the east and is seen as far as the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

rows.spanish: Aprendan la parábola de la higuera: en cuanto su rama se pone tierna y brotan las hojas, saben que el verano está cerca.
rows.current_english_pob: Learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer is near.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out leaves, you know that summer is near.

rows.spanish: Así también ustedes, cuando vean todas estas cosas, sepan que está cerca, a las puertas.
rows.current_english_pob: So you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.
rows.spanish_base_english: So also you, when you see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.

rows.spanish: Y no supieron hasta que vino el diluvio y se los llevó a todos; así será la venida del Hijo del Hombre.
rows.current_english_pob: And they did not know until the flood came and swept them all away; so also will be the coming of the Son of Man.
rows.spanish_base_english: And they did not know until the flood came and took them all away; so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

rows.spanish: Entonces dos estarán en el campo; uno es tomado y uno es dejado.
rows.current_english_pob: Then two men will be in the field; one is taken and one is left.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then two will be in the field; one is taken and one is left.

rows.spanish: ¿Quién, entonces, es el esclavo fiel y prudente, a quien el amo ha nombrado encargado de su servidumbre para darles su comida a su tiempo?
rows.current_english_pob: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has appointed over his household to give them their food at the proper time?
rows.spanish_base_english: Who then is the faithful and wise slave, whom the master has appointed over his household to give them their food at the proper time?

rows.spanish: Bienaventurado aquel esclavo a quien su señor, cuando venga, hallará actuando así.
rows.current_english_pob: Blessed is that servant whom his lord, when he comes, will find doing so.
rows.spanish_base_english: Blessed is that servant whom his master, when he comes, will find doing so.

rows.spanish: y comienza a golpear a sus compañeros esclavos, y come y bebe con los borrachos,
rows.current_english_pob: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eats and drinks with drunkards,
rows.spanish_base_english: and begins to beat his fellow slaves, and eats and drinks with drunkards,

rows.spanish: vendrá el amo de aquel esclavo el día que no espera y a una hora que no sabe.
rows.current_english_pob: the master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know,
rows.spanish_base_english: the master of that slave will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know,

rows.spanish: Pero mientras el novio se demoraba, todas se adormecieron y se durmieron.
rows.current_english_pob: But while the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and slept.
rows.spanish_base_english: But while the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

rows.spanish: Más tarde, también vienen las otras vírgenes, diciendo: «Señor, señor, ábrenos».
rows.current_english_pob: Later, the other virgins also come, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
rows.spanish_base_english: Later, the other virgins also come, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us.’

rows.spanish: Porque será como un hombre que, al irse de viaje, llamó a sus propios esclavos y les confió sus bienes.
rows.current_english_pob: For it is like a man going on a journey, who called his own servants and entrusted his possessions to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: For it is like a man going on a journey, who called his own slaves and entrusted his possessions to them.

rows.spanish: Y a uno le dio cinco talentos, a otro dos, y a otro uno, a cada uno según su propia capacidad; y se fue inmediatamente.
rows.current_english_pob: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and one to another, to each according to his own ability; and he went away.
rows.spanish_base_english: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one, to each according to his own ability; and he went away immediately.

rows.spanish: El que había recibido los cinco talentos fue y trabajó con ellos, y ganó otros cinco.
rows.current_english_pob: Immediately, the one who had received the five talents went and worked with them, and gained another five.
rows.spanish_base_english: The one who had received the five talents went and worked with them, and gained another five.

rows.spanish: Después de mucho tiempo, viene el amo de aquellos esclavos y les pide cuentas.
rows.current_english_pob: After a long time, the master of those servants comes and settles accounts with them.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after a long time, the master of those slaves comes and settles accounts with them.

rows.spanish: Entonces también se acercó el que había recibido un talento y dijo: «Señor, sabía que eras un hombre duro, que siegas donde no sembraste y recoges de donde no esparciste».
rows.current_english_pob: Then the one who had received the one talent also came forward and said, ‘Lord, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering where you did not scatter.’
rows.spanish_base_english: Then the one who had received the one talent also came and said, ‘Lord, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering where you did not scatter.’

rows.spanish: Porque a todo el que tiene se le dará, y tendrá abundancia; pero del que no tiene, aun lo que tiene se le quitará.
rows.current_english_pob: For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have an abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away.
rows.spanish_base_english: For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have an abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

rows.spanish: Y arrojen al esclavo sin valor a la oscuridad exterior. Allí habrá llanto y rechinar de dientes.
rows.current_english_pob: And throw the worthless servant into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
rows.spanish_base_english: And throw the worthless slave into the outer darkness. In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

rows.spanish: Entonces ellos también responderán, diciendo: «Señor, ¿cuándo te vimos hambriento o sediento o forastero o desnudo o enfermo o en prisión, y no te atendimos?»
rows.current_english_pob: Then they too will answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and not serve you?’
rows.spanish_base_english: Then they too will answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and not minister to you?’

rows.spanish: Ustedes saben que después de dos días llega la Pascua, y el Hijo del Hombre es entregado para ser crucificado.
rows.current_english_pob: You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.
rows.spanish_base_english: You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man is being handed over to be crucified.

rows.spanish: y tramaron arrestar a Jesús en secreto y matarlo.
rows.current_english_pob: and they plotted to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
rows.spanish_base_english: and they conspired to seize Jesus by stealth and kill him.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, mientras Jesús estaba en Betania, en casa de Simón el leproso,
rows.current_english_pob: While Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now while Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

rows.spanish: Pero Jesús, al saber esto, les dijo: «¿Por qué están molestando a la mujer? Porque ella ha hecho una hermosa obra para mí».
rows.current_english_pob: But Jesus, knowing this, said to them, “Why are you causing trouble for the woman? For she has done a beautiful thing to me.
rows.spanish_base_english: But Jesus, knowing this, said to them, “Why are you troubling the woman? For she has done a beautiful work for me.”

rows.spanish: En verdad les digo, dondequiera que se proclame este evangelio en todo el mundo, también se hablará de lo que hizo esta mujer en memoria de ella.
rows.current_english_pob: Truly I tell you, wherever this good news is proclaimed in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of in memory of her.
rows.spanish_base_english: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is proclaimed in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of in memory of her.

rows.spanish: Él dijo: «¿Qué están dispuestos a darme, y yo se lo entregaré a ustedes?» Ellos le pesaron treinta piezas de plata.
rows.current_english_pob: He said, “What are you willing to give me if I hand him over to you?” And they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
rows.spanish_base_english: He said, “What are you willing to give me, and I will hand him over to you?” And they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

rows.spanish: Ahora, el primer día de los Panes sin levadura, los discípulos se acercaron a Jesús, diciendo: «¿Dónde quieres que te preparemos para que comas la Pascua?»
rows.current_english_pob: On the first day of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the first day of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

rows.spanish: El Hijo del Hombre, en efecto, va tal como está escrito acerca de él; pero ¡ay de aquel hombre por quien el Hijo del Hombre es traicionado! Más le habría valido no haber nacido aquel hombre.
rows.current_english_pob: The Son of Man indeed goes just as it is written about him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed. It would have been better for that man if he had not been born.
rows.spanish_base_english: The Son of Man indeed goes just as it is written about him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed. It would have been better for him if that man had not been born.

rows.spanish: Entonces Judas, el que lo traicionaba, respondió: «¿Acaso no soy yo, Rabí?». Él le dijo: «Tú lo has dicho».
rows.current_english_pob: Then Judas, who was betraying him, answered and said, “Surely I am not the one, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You have said so.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Then Judas, the one betraying him, answered and said, “Surely it is not I, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You have said so.”

rows.spanish: Levántense, vamos. Miren, ya se ha acercado el que me traiciona.
rows.current_english_pob: Get up, let us go. Look, my betrayer is near.
rows.spanish_base_english: Get up, let us go. Look, the one betraying me has come near.

rows.spanish: Y mientras aún hablaba, he aquí, Judas, uno de los doce, vino, y con él una gran multitud con espadas y garrotes, de los principales sacerdotes y ancianos del pueblo.
rows.current_english_pob: And while he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a large crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
rows.spanish_base_english: And while he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a large crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

rows.spanish: Pero el que lo traicionaba les había dado una señal, diciendo: «Aquel a quien yo bese, ese es; apresadlo».
rows.current_english_pob: The one betraying him had given them a sign, saying, “The one I kiss is he; seize him.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the one betraying him had given them a sign, saying, “The one I kiss is he; seize him.”

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, uno de los que estaban con Jesús extendió su mano, desenvainó su espada, golpeó al esclavo del sumo sacerdote, y le cortó la oreja.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, one of those with Jesus stretched out his hand, drew his sword, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his ear.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, one of those with Jesus stretched out his hand, drew his sword, and struck the high priest’s slave, and cut off his ear.

rows.spanish: Los que habían apresado a Jesús lo llevaron a Caifás, el sumo sacerdote, donde los escribas y los ancianos ya se habían reunido.
rows.current_english_pob: Those who had seized Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now those who had seized Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered.

rows.spanish: Y los principales sacerdotes y todo el concilio buscaban falso testimonio contra Jesús para darle muerte.
rows.current_english_pob: The chief priests and the whole council were seeking false testimony against Jesus so that they might put him to death,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the chief priests and the whole council were seeking false testimony against Jesus so that they might put him to death,

rows.spanish: Y el sumo sacerdote se puso de pie y le dijo: «¿No respondes nada? ¿Qué es lo que estos testifican contra ti?»
rows.current_english_pob: And the high priest stood up and said to him, “Do you give no answer? What are these men testifying against you?”
rows.spanish_base_english: And the high priest stood up and said to him, “Do you give no answer? What is it that these men are testifying against you?”

rows.spanish: Pedro estaba sentado fuera, en el patio, y se le acercó una criada, diciendo: «Tú también estabas con Jesús el Galileo».
rows.current_english_pob: Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him, saying, “You also were with Jesus the Galilean.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and one servant girl came up to him, saying, “You also were with Jesus the Galilean.”

rows.spanish: Al poco rato, los que estaban allí se acercaron y dijeron a Pedro: «Ciertamente tú también eres uno de ellos, porque tu acento lo hace evidente».
rows.current_english_pob: After a little while, those standing there came up and said to Peter, “Surely you also are one of them, for even your accent gives you away.”
rows.spanish_base_english: After a little while, those standing there came up and said to Peter, “Surely you also are one of them, for your accent makes it evident.”

rows.spanish: diciendo: «He pecado por haber entregado sangre inocente». Pero ellos dijeron: «¿Qué nos importa a nosotros? Tú verás».
rows.current_english_pob: saying, “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You will see to it.”
rows.spanish_base_english: saying, “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

rows.spanish: Por eso aquel campo ha sido llamado Campo de Sangre hasta el día de hoy.
rows.current_english_pob: Therefore that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
rows.spanish_base_english: Therefore that field has been called Field of Blood to this day.

rows.spanish: Jesús estuvo ante el gobernador, y el gobernador le preguntó, diciendo: «¿Tú eres el Rey de los judíos?». Jesús dijo: «Tú dices».
rows.current_english_pob: Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor questioned him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” And Jesus said, “You say so.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor questioned him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” And Jesus said, “You say so.”

rows.spanish: Y él no respondió a una sola acusación, de modo que el gobernador quedó muy asombrado.
rows.current_english_pob: And he did not answer even a single charge, so that the governor was greatly amazed.
rows.spanish_base_english: And he did not answer him with even one word, so that the governor was greatly amazed.

rows.spanish: En la fiesta, el gobernador tenía por costumbre poner en libertad a la multitud un preso, el que querían.
rows.current_english_pob: At the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the crowd one prisoner, whom they wanted.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the crowd one prisoner, whom they wanted.

rows.spanish: Ahora bien, en ese tiempo tenían un preso notorio, llamado Jesús Barrabás.
rows.current_english_pob: At that time they had a notorious prisoner called Jesus Barabbas.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now at that time they had a notorious prisoner called Jesus Barabbas.

rows.spanish: Pero los principales sacerdotes y los ancianos persuadieron a las multitudes para que pidieran a Barrabás, pero destruyeran a Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to destroy Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas, but to destroy Jesus.

rows.spanish: Después de trenzar una corona de espinas, la pusieron sobre su cabeza, y una caña en su mano derecha; y, arrodillándose delante de él, se burlaron de él, diciendo: «¡Salve, rey de los judíos! »
rows.current_english_pob: And after weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on his head and placed a reed in his right hand; and kneeling before him, they mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
rows.spanish_base_english: And after weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and kneeling before him, they mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

rows.spanish: Y cuando llegaron a un lugar llamado Gólgota —que significa Lugar de la Calavera—
rows.current_english_pob: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (which is called Place of a Skull),
rows.spanish_base_english: And when they came to a place called Golgotha (which means Place of a Skull),

rows.spanish: Entonces son crucificados con él dos ladrones, uno a la derecha y uno a la izquierda.
rows.current_english_pob: Then two robbers were crucified with him, one on the right and one on the left.
rows.spanish_base_english: Then two robbers are crucified with him, one on the right and one on the left.

rows.spanish: Ha confiado en Dios; que Dios lo rescate ahora, si lo quiere, pues dijo: «Soy el Hijo de Dios».
rows.current_english_pob: He trusts in God; let God rescue him now, if he delights in him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’
rows.spanish_base_english: He has trusted in God; let God rescue him now, if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’

rows.spanish: Desde la hora sexta hubo oscuridad sobre toda la región hasta la hora novena.
rows.current_english_pob: From the sixth hour darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now from the sixth hour darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.

rows.spanish: Como a la hora novena, Jesús exclamó con voz fuerte, diciendo: «¿Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?», es decir: «Dios mío, Dios mío, ¿por qué me has abandonado?»
rows.current_english_pob: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” that is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” that is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, la cortina del templo fue rasgada de arriba abajo en dos, y la tierra tembló, y las rocas se partieron.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom, and the earth shook, and the rocks were split.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom, and the earth shook, and the rocks were split.

rows.spanish: Y el centurión y los que estaban con él y custodiaban a Jesús, al ver el terremoto y las cosas que habían sucedido, tuvieron mucho miedo y dijeron: «Verdaderamente, este era Hijo de Dios».
rows.current_english_pob: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and the things that had happened, they were greatly afraid and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and the things that had happened, they were greatly afraid and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”

rows.spanish: Había allí muchas mujeres, que miraban desde lejos, quienes habían seguido a Jesús desde Galilea, sirviéndole.
rows.current_english_pob: There were many women there, watching from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now there were many women there, watching from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

rows.spanish: Al caer la tarde, vino un hombre rico de Arimatea, llamado José, que también él había llegado a ser discípulo de Jesús.
rows.current_english_pob: When evening had come, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself also had become a disciple of Jesus.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now when evening had come, a rich man from Arimathea came, named Joseph, who himself also had become a disciple of Jesus.

rows.spanish: Ahora estaban allí María Magdalena y la otra María, sentadas frente al sepulcro.
rows.current_english_pob: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting opposite the tomb.

rows.spanish: Al día siguiente, que es después del día de la Preparación, se reunieron los principales sacerdotes y los fariseos ante Pilato.
rows.current_english_pob: On the next day, which is after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate
rows.spanish_base_english: Now on the next day, which is after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate

rows.spanish: diciendo: «Señor, nos acordamos de que ese engañador dijo mientras aún vivía: “Después de tres días, yo resucito”».
rows.current_english_pob: saying, “Sir, we remember that that deceiver said while he was still alive, ‘After three days I rise.’”
rows.spanish_base_english: saying, “Lord, we remember that that deceiver said while he was still alive, ‘After three days I rise.’”

rows.spanish: Así que fueron con la guardia y aseguraron la tumba, sellando la piedra.
rows.current_english_pob: So they went with the guard and secured the tomb by sealing the stone.
rows.spanish_base_english: So they went and secured the tomb, sealing the stone with the guard.

rows.spanish: Pasado el sábado, al amanecer del primer día de la semana, vinieron María Magdalena y la otra María para ver el sepulcro.
rows.current_english_pob: After the Sabbath, as it was dawning toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now after the Sabbath, as it was dawning toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, hubo un gran terremoto, porque un ángel del Señor descendió del cielo, se acercó a la tumba, apartó la piedra y se sentó sobre ella.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, came to the tomb, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord had come down from heaven and approached and rolled away the stone and was sitting on it.

rows.spanish: Y vayan pronto y digan a sus discípulos: “Ha sido resucitado de entre los muertos, y miren, va delante de ustedes a Galilea. Allí lo verán”. Miren, se lo he dicho.
rows.current_english_pob: And go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has been raised from the dead, and look, he is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Look, I have told you.
rows.spanish_base_english: And go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has been raised from the dead, and behold, he is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.

rows.spanish: Y he aquí, Jesús salió a su encuentro y les dijo: «¡Saludos!» Ellas se acercaron, le tomaron los pies y lo adoraron.
rows.current_english_pob: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” And they came up, took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
rows.spanish_base_english: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” And they came up, took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

rows.spanish: Mientras iban, he aquí, algunos de la guardia entraron en la ciudad e informaron a los principales sacerdotes todo lo que había sucedido.
rows.current_english_pob: While they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
rows.spanish_base_english: While they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

rows.spanish: Y si esto llega a oídos del gobernador, nosotros lo convenceremos y los libraremos de problemas.
rows.current_english_pob: And if this comes to a hearing before the governor, we will persuade him and keep you out of trouble.
rows.spanish_base_english: And if this is heard by the governor, we will persuade him and keep you free from चिंता.

rows.spanish: Y los once discípulos fueron a Galilea, al monte donde Jesús les había indicado ir.
rows.current_english_pob: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them,
rows.spanish_base_english: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them,

rows.spanish: enseñándoles a guardar todo lo que les mandé. Y he aquí, yo estoy con ustedes todos los días, hasta el fin de la era.
rows.current_english_pob: teaching them to keep all that I commanded you. And behold, I am with you all the days, until the end of the age.
rows.spanish_base_english: teaching them to keep all that I commanded you. And behold, I am with you all the days, until the end of the age.

rows.spanish: Estos eran los llamados de la congregación, los líderes de las tribus de sus padres, los jefes de los millares de Israel.
rows.current_english_pob: These were the ones called from the congregation, the leaders of their fathers’ tribes, the heads of the thousands of Israel.
rows.spanish_base_english: These were the called ones of the congregation, the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the thousands of Israel.

rows.spanish: Los registrados de la tribu de Gad fueron cuarenta y cinco mil seiscientos cincuenta.
rows.current_english_pob: Those counted from the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
rows.spanish_base_english: Those counted from the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

rows.spanish: Pero los levitas, según la tribu de sus padres, no fueron contados entre ellos.
rows.current_english_pob: But the Levites, by their ancestral tribe, were not counted among them.
rows.spanish_base_english: But the Levites, by their fathers' tribe, were not counted among them.

rows.spanish: Los que acampan en el lado oriental, hacia la salida del sol, serán el estandarte del campamento de Judá, según sus divisiones; y el jefe de los hijos de Judá será Nahsón hijo de Amminadab.
rows.current_english_pob: Those who camp on the east side, toward the sunrise, shall be the banner of the camp of Judah by their divisions; and the leader of the sons of Judah shall be Nahshon son of Amminadab.
rows.spanish_base_english: Those who camp on the east side, toward the sunrise, shall be the standard of the camp of Judah by their divisions; and the leader of the sons of Judah shall be Nahshon son of Amminadab.

rows.spanish: Estas son las generaciones de Aarón y de Moisés, en el día en que Yahvé habló a Moisés en el monte Sinaí.
rows.current_english_pob: These are the generations of Aaron and Moses at the time when Yahweh spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
rows.spanish_base_english: These are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.

rows.spanish: Ellos cumplirán su responsabilidad y la responsabilidad de toda la congregación delante de la tienda de reunión, para hacer el servicio del tabernáculo.
rows.current_english_pob: They shall keep his charge and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to perform the service of the tabernacle.
rows.spanish_base_english: They shall keep his charge and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

rows.spanish: Y yo—he aquí—he tomado a los levitas de entre los hijos de Israel, en lugar de todo primogénito que abre el vientre entre los hijos de Israel, y los levitas serán míos.
rows.current_english_pob: And I—behold, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn that opens the womb among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
rows.spanish_base_english: And I—behold, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn that opens the womb among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

rows.spanish: Y el principal de los principales de los levitas fue Eleazar, hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, encargado de los que cumplían la custodia del santuario.
rows.current_english_pob: And the chief over the chiefs of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, having oversight of those who kept charge of the sanctuary.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the chief of the chiefs of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, having oversight of those who kept charge of the sanctuary.

rows.spanish: Pablo, esclavo de Mesías Jesús, llamado a ser apóstol, apartado para el evangelio de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: Paul, a servant of Messiah Jesus, called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God,
rows.spanish_base_english: Paul, a slave of Messiah Jesus, called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God,

rows.spanish: y que fue declarado Hijo de Dios con poder según el Espíritu de santidad por la resurrección de entre los muertos—Jesús Mesías, nuestro Señor.
rows.current_english_pob: and who was declared to be the Son of God in power according to the Spirit of holiness by the resurrection from the dead—Jesus the Messiah our Lord,
rows.spanish_base_english: and who was declared to be the Son of God in power according to the Spirit of holiness by the resurrection from the dead—Jesus Messiah our Lord,

rows.spanish: entre quienes también ustedes están, llamados de Jesús el Mesías,
rows.current_english_pob: among whom you also are, called of Jesus the Messiah,
rows.spanish_base_english: among whom you also are, called of Jesus Messiah,

rows.spanish: A todos los que están en Roma, amados por Dios y llamados santos: gracia a ustedes y paz de parte de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor Jesús Mesías.
rows.current_english_pob: To all those in Rome who are beloved by God and called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus the Messiah.
rows.spanish_base_english: To all those in Rome who are beloved by God and called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Messiah.

rows.spanish: Primero, doy gracias a mi Dios por medio de Jesús Mesías por todos ustedes, porque su fe es proclamada en todo el mundo.
rows.current_english_pob: First, I thank my God through Jesus the Messiah for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed throughout the whole world.
rows.spanish_base_english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Messiah for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed throughout the whole world.

rows.spanish: Y no quiero que ustedes ignoren, hermanos, que muchas veces me propuse ir a ustedes, pero se me impidió hasta ahora, para que tuviera algún fruto entre ustedes también, así como entre los demás gentiles.
rows.current_english_pob: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that I have often planned to come to you—but have been prevented until now—so that I might have some fruit among you also, just as among the rest of the Gentiles.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that I have often planned to come to you—but have been prevented until now—so that I might have some fruit among you also, just as among the rest of the Gentiles.

rows.spanish: porque lo que se conoce acerca de Dios es claro entre ellos, pues Dios se lo ha hecho evidente.
rows.current_english_pob: because what can be known about God is plain among them, for God has made it plain to them.
rows.spanish_base_english: because what is known about God is plain among them, for God has made it plain to them.

rows.spanish: quienes cambiaron la verdad de Dios por la mentira, y adoraron y sirvieron a la creación en lugar del Creador, quien es bendito para siempre. Amén.
rows.current_english_pob: who exchanged the truth of God for the lie, and revered and served the creation rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
rows.spanish_base_english: who exchanged the truth of God for the lie, and worshiped and served the creation rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

rows.spanish: Por esta razón, Dios los entregó a pasiones deshonrosas, pues aun sus mujeres cambiaron las relaciones naturales por lo que es contrario a la naturaleza,
rows.current_english_pob: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions, for even their women exchanged natural relations for what is contrary to nature,
rows.spanish_base_english: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions, for even their females exchanged the natural use for that which is contrary to nature,

rows.spanish: Pero por causa de tu dureza y de tu corazón impenitente, estás acumulando ira para ti mismo en el día de la ira y de la revelación del juicio justo de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: But because of your hardness and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath and the revelation of God’s righteous judgment,
rows.spanish_base_english: But because of your hardness and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath for yourself in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,

rows.spanish: vida eterna para los que, con perseverancia en buena obra, buscan gloria, honor e inmortalidad.
rows.current_english_pob: eternal life to those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory and honor and immortality.
rows.spanish_base_english: eternal life to those who by perseverance in good work seek glory and honor and immortality.

rows.spanish: Pero el judío lo es en lo interior, y la circuncisión es la del corazón, en espíritu, no en letra, cuya alabanza no proviene de las personas, sino de Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: But the Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart—by the Spirit, not by the letter—whose praise is not from people but from God.
rows.spanish_base_english: But the Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart—in spirit, not in letter—whose praise is not from people but from God.

rows.spanish: Pero si la verdad de Dios ha abundado por mi mentira para su gloria, ¿por qué todavía soy juzgado como pecador?
rows.current_english_pob: But if God’s truthfulness has abounded through my lie for his glory, why am I still being judged as a sinner?
rows.spanish_base_english: But if God’s truth has abounded through my lie for his glory, why am I still being judged as a sinner?

rows.spanish: Ahora sabemos que todo lo que la ley dice, lo habla a los que están bajo la ley, para que toda boca sea cerrada y todo el mundo llegue a estar sujeto a juicio ante Dios.
rows.current_english_pob: We know that whatever the law says, it speaks to those under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped and the whole world may become accountable to God.
rows.spanish_base_english: Now we know that whatever the law says, it speaks to those under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped and the whole world may become accountable to God.

rows.spanish: porque por obras de la ley nadie será justificado delante de él, pues por medio de la ley viene el conocimiento del pecado.
rows.current_english_pob: because by works of the law no one will be justified before him, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
rows.spanish_base_english: because by works of the law no flesh will be justified before him, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

rows.spanish: Pero ahora, aparte de la ley, se ha revelado la justicia de Dios, atestiguada por la Ley y los Profetas,
rows.current_english_pob: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, attested by the Law and the Prophets,
rows.spanish_base_english: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets,

rows.spanish: Y la justicia de Dios por medio de la fe en Jesús Mesías, para todos los que creen; porque no hay distinción.
rows.current_english_pob: And the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus the Messiah, for all who believe; for there is no distinction.
rows.spanish_base_english: And the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Messiah, for all who believe; for there is no distinction.

rows.spanish: a quien Dios presentó como propiciación por medio de la fe en su sangre, para demostrar su justicia, a causa de haber pasado por alto los pecados cometidos anteriormente.
rows.current_english_pob: whom God put forward as an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, to demonstrate his righteousness, because of the passing over of previously committed sins.
rows.spanish_base_english: whom God put forward as a propitiation through faith in his blood, to demonstrate his righteousness, because of the passing over of previously committed sins.

rows.spanish: ¿Dónde, entonces, está la jactancia? Ha sido excluida. ¿Mediante qué clase de ley? ¿Una ley de obras? No, sino mediante una ley de fe.
rows.current_english_pob: Where, then, is boasting? It has been excluded. Through what kind of law? A law of works? No, but through a law of faith.
rows.spanish_base_english: Where, then, is boasting? It has been excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
